description:
**Company Description**
 Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
   

  

**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**
 Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
   

  

 As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
   

  

**For everyone, everywhere.**
**Job Description**
 More about
 **our mission** 
 and
 **what we offer** 
 .
   

  

 As the Team Lead for KYC Operations on our newly established Deactivations Team, you will be at the forefront of strengthening Wise's commitment to regulatory compliance and protecting our financial ecosystem. Your mission is to build and guide a team of senior analysts who will become the authority in enhanced due diligence (EDD) and masters of risk assessment. You will lead your team who investigate complex KYC cases, empowering them with the duty to guarantee that every decision is compliant and accurate. It's a team that delivers justice and upholds our integrity when it matters the most.
   

  

 As this is a newly formed team at Wise, you won't just be following established guidelines \- you'll be a primary architect in their creation. You will lead the effort to shape the team's processes, enhance its tools, and develop its operational strategy. Your leadership, insights, and the feedback from your team will be crucial in building this function from the ground up.
   

  

 This is a unique opportunity for a sharp, inspiring leader who excels in high\-pressure situations and has a passion for developing expert investigators. If you are eager to build a team of subject matter experts in the comprehensive KYC/FinCrime arena and seek a position where your leadership will significantly influence our clients, enhance our reputation, and mentor the next wave of talent —then this opportunity is perfect for you.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Team Leadership Lead by example and drive a customer focused mindset across your team. Promote a culture of ownership and accountability. Build high\-performing teams that value knowledge sharing and continuous learning.
* People management Coach and develop a strong team of KYC Analysts. Come up with initiatives to help your team to grow their skills, behaviours, and competencies. Design and manage development plans on identified opportunities. Conducts career map check\-ins and makes recommendations for promotions, salary raises, and other decisions.
* Operational management Identify and propose opportunities for process improvements. Collaborate with central functions and other operational teams as needed to increase operational efficiency. Provide guidance and support on complex, high\-risk cases and escalations, which may include acting as a direct point of contact for customers via email, phone, or video call during sensitive inquiries, interviews, or escalations.
* Performance management Measure team KPIs and ensure performance targets and quality standards are met while maintaining focus on customer experience. Conduct regular one on one coaching sessions, usually on a weekly or biweekly basis. Run team meetings to ensure that your team is kept up to date with the latest information, share best practices and enhance overall team spirit.
* Expertise Sharing Be a subject matter expert in your area with the ability to train and coach your team on operational topics. Maintain a good understanding of our regulatory obligations, internal policies, and applying a risk\-based approach to deterring and preventing money laundering and financial crime. Able to perform deep dives, understand root causes of problematic cases and propose solutions to senior leadership.
* Planning and execution Ensure key performance indicators are being met and provide insights to other stakeholders. Take full accountability in delivering your own initiatives and making sure your team is making progress on their goals.
* Stakeholder management and communication Collaborate closely with your stakeholders ensuring clear communication and coordination of actions. You communicate mindfully and professionally while choosing the right formats and platforms to convey your message to a wider audience in a timely manner. Your initiatives and reports are well documented and it has a clear scope that includes potential impact in different areas.
* Quality assurance and control Implement and maintain a robust quality assurance framework for your team. Conduct regular checks and reviews of your team’s casework to ensure accuracy, consistency, and adherence to the highest standards of our policies and regulatory obligations. Provide targeted coaching and constructive feedback based on quality findings to drive continuous improvement. Analyse quality metrics to identify trends, address root causes of errors, and develop initiatives that enhance the team's overall performance and mitigate risk.


 Additional Information
   

  

 For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
   

  

 We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
   

  

 Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.
   

  

 If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.
   

  

 Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

description:
**It's more than a job**
 As a member of the Freight Forwarding team Kuehne\+Nagel, you will play a key role in transporting goods, optimising processes, and fulfilling our customers' promises. And by transporting medicines, toys and important machine parts, you are not only delivering goods, you are making small and big moments possible for people all around the world. At Kuehne\+Nagel, our contribution counts in more ways than we imagine.
   

  

 ‎
   

  

 You will be part of our Sea Logistics Team to add your expertise \+ skills to the delivery of Customer \+ Product Excellence.
   

  

 Your primary objective is to drive \+ grow the reefer product by developing a strategy to gain \+ retain customers.
   

  

**How you create impact**
* To ensure your local product strategy aligns with the regional strategy \+ fits the local market.
* To build a local operational structure with reefer dedication within the customer \+ operational care locations (CCL \+ OCC) that creates \+ maintains reefer expertise, aiming for zero operational failures for temperature sensitive cargo.
* To ensure profitability across the profit \+ loss statement (P\+L), proactively following up on discrepancies.
* To manage local carrier relationships; ensuring access to appropriate escalation channels.
* To take the lead in local reefer pricing in coordination with the regional reefer trade manager.
* To build a reefer development team and support the KAM team and field sales where needed.
* To take the lead in setting up or maintaining a GxP Pharma branch to ensure operational excellence for pharmaceutical clients where demand exists.
* To provide regular reefer training.


**What we would like you to bring**
* 10\+ years of experience in Sea Logistics / Ocean Freight, with strong Reefer exposure.
* Proven Business Development experience in Reefer, Perishables, and/or Healthcare/Pharma.
* Strong experience in customer acquisition, retention, and revenue growth.
* Hands\-on P\&L and profitability management experience.
* Strong ocean carrier management, including pricing, negotiations, and capacity.
* Experience leading and developing sales/product teams.
* Strong relationships with key customers, KAMs, and field sales teams.
* Good knowledge of Reefer operations and cold\-chain logistics.
* Ability to develop and execute a Pan\-India Reefer strategy.


**What's in it for you**
* Global Exposure: Step into a world of international opportunities with a presence in 100\+ countries.
* People\-Centric Culture: Join a team where your voice matters and people genuinely care.
* Learning \& Development: Grow with us personally and professionally through world\-class training and career pathways.
* Innovation \& Sustainability: Be part of a future\-focused company driving real change in logistics and the planet.
* Rewards \& Recognition: Get rewarded for your passion, performance, and potential.
* Stability with Agility: Enjoy the best of both worlds a trusted global brand with a startup spirit.


**Who we are**
 Logistics shapes everyday life \- from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne\+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.
   

  

 As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. Whether we help deliver life\-saving medicines, develop sustainable transportation solutions or support our local communities, your career will contribute to more than you can imagine.

title: Deputy Manager - Building Management Systems (BMS)
description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group** 
 : Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan\-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O \& M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
   

  

**Adani Airports Holding Limited** 
 : Adani Airports Holding Limited is reshaping the aviation landscape, transforming airports into dynamic hubs of connectivity, innovation, and service excellence. By prioritizing passenger experience, leveraging state\-of\-the\-art technology, and enhancing operational efficiency, we are redefining airport infrastructure across India. Our vision is to create world\-class airports that serve as gateways to regional development and global connectivity, positioning Adani Airports as a leader in the aviation sector with a focus on sustainable growth and community impact.
   

  

**Job Purpose:** 
 Executive \- Building Management Systems (BMS) is responsible for overseeing the engineering, maintenance, and operational management of all BMS systems within the airport. This includes ensuring the proper functioning, reliability, and performance of systems such as HVAC, lighting, fire alarm systems, access control, and other integrated mechanical, electrical, and civil systems that are controlled through BMS. The role ensures preventive and corrective maintenance, and manage troubleshooting for BMS\-related issues across airport facilities.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**BMS System Engineering \& Maintenance:**
 Lead the engineering, installation, commissioning, and maintenance of BMS systems, ensuring that they operate efficiently, reliably, and in compliance with airport standards.
   

  

 Oversee the day\-to\-day operation of BMS infrastructure, including HVAC, lighting, electrical systems, fire alarm systems, and access controls, ensuring their seamless integration with other airport systems.
   

  

 Ensure continuous monitoring, testing, and updating of BMS systems to maintain optimal performance levels across all facilities.
   

  

 Develop and execute maintenance schedules for BMS systems, ensuring proper preventive maintenance and minimal downtime.
   

  

**Troubleshooting And Fault Resolution**
 Lead troubleshooting efforts in case of system failures, quickly diagnosing faults within BMS\-related systems and resolving issues with minimal disruption to airport operations.
   

  

 Coordinate with engineering teams to repair or replace faulty components of BMS systems, ensuring efficient and timely resolutions.
   

  

 Implement diagnostic tools and technologies to identify potential issues before they impact the operations of the airport.
   

  

**Energy Efficiency And Sustainability**
 Monitor and optimize energy consumption across airport facilities by utilizing BMS for HVAC systems, lighting, and electrical load management.
   

  

 Implement energy\-saving initiatives through BMS systems, ensuring energy optimization and contributing to the airport’s sustainability goals.
   

  

 Evaluate the performance of BMS systems in managing energy usage, recommending improvements for greater cost savings and environmental benefits.
   

  

**Safety And Regulatory Compliance**
 Ensure that all BMS systems comply with airport\-specific safety standards, industry regulations, and local environmental health and safety guidelines.
   

  

 Conduct regular safety audits and inspections on BMS\-related systems, ensuring proper documentation and compliance with safety standards such as fire safety, electrical safety, and hazard control.
   

  

 Assist in the development and updating of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for BMS operation and maintenance to ensure a safe environment for all stakeholders.
   

  

**Budget Planning \& Forecasting**
 Develop and manage the annual budget for BMS operations, including system maintenance, upgrades, energy\-saving initiatives, and staffing.
   

  

 Prepare detailed budget forecasts, considering historical data, upcoming projects, and planned system enhancements to ensure adequate financial planning.
   

  

**BMS Performance Monitoring**
 Lead the monitoring of BMS data for system performance, energy usage, and operational efficiency, utilizing system dashboards and reports.
   

  

 Analyze system data to detect performance trends and inefficiencies, implementing corrective measures as necessary.
   

  

 Develop and track key performance indicators (KPIs) related to BMS system uptime, reliability, and energy consumption to ensure continuous improvement.
   

  

**Vendor And Contractor Management**
 Oversee relationships with third\-party vendors and contractors responsible for BMS system components or services, ensuring high\-quality service delivery and compliance with contractual obligations.
   

  

 Coordinate with vendors for the timely procurement of equipment, materials, and parts required for the maintenance and repair of BMS systems.
   

  

 Manage vendor service level agreements (SLAs) and ensure that maintenance and repair activities are performed within specified time frames and quality standards.
   

  

**Team Leadership And Development**
 Lead and supervise the BMS engineering and maintenance team, providing guidance, training, and mentorship to junior engineers and technicians.
   

  

 Develop and implement training programs to improve the technical skills and knowledge of the BMS team.
   

  

 Ensure proper documentation of maintenance activities and work orders, ensuring that team members follow industry best practices and safety guidelines.
   

  

**Project Management And System Upgrades**
 Lead BMS system upgrade projects, including design, installation, and commissioning, ensuring alignment with airport’s engineering objectives and timelines.
   

  

 Plan and manage engineering projects related to BMS integration with other airport systems, ensuring minimal disruption to ongoing operations during implementation.
   

  

 Assist in evaluating and selecting new BMS technologies and tools to enhance operational capabilities.
   

  

**Reporting And Documentation**
 Provide regular reports on the status and performance of BMS systems, including energy usage, maintenance activities, and system health.
   

  

 Maintain detailed records of system configurations, maintenance logs, troubleshooting reports, and compliance audits to ensure transparency and accountability.
   

  

 Document system updates, troubleshooting efforts, and any changes to BMS configurations, ensuring all data is current and easily accessible for future reference.
   

  

**Key Stakeholders \- Internal**
 Head \- Engineering Services
   

  

 Maintenance Team
   

  

 Facility Management Team
   

  

 Operations Team
   

  

 Procurement Team
   

  

 Safety and Compliance Team
   

  

 Project Management Team
   

  

 IT Support Team
   

  

**Key Stakeholders \- External**
 Clients/Building Owners
   

  

 Contractors and Subcontractors
   

  

 Equipment Vendors and Suppliers
   

  

 Regulatory Authorities
   

  

 Third\-Party Auditors
   

  

 Consultants and Design Engineers
   

  

 Service Providers for System Upgrades and Maintenance
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Educational Qualifications:**
 Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
   

  

 Certification in Building Management Systems (BMS) or similar, such as from the Building Controls Industry Association (BCIA) or equivalent
   

  

 Additional certifications in HVAC, electrical systems, or energy management are a plus
   

  

 Professional engineering license (depending on the country/region)
   

  

**Work Experience**
 10\+ years of experience working with BMS systems, including hands\-on installation, commissioning, and troubleshooting
   

  

 Proven experience in managing teams and leading projects within the BMS or building automation industry
   

  

 Strong background in working with control systems, HVAC, lighting, and energy management solutions
   

  

 Experience collaborating with contractors, clients, and other engineering teams on large\-scale building projects
   

  

 Familiarity with industry regulations, safety standards, and energy efficiency guidelines

title: Process Lead
description:
**Job Description**
**Process Lead\- Star 7 Line (Marvel)**
 This role helps ensure the sustained continuity of process expert and line leadership in manufacturing, by leading a key line of the business system or organizational process to deliver results defined by the compelling business need of the site. You ensure that key business results are achieved and for developing others to ensure the sustained continuity of process mastery on the manufacturing line.
   

  

**Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?**
**Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It With Pride.**
 This role helps ensure the sustained continuity of technical mastery and line leadership in manufacturing, by leading a key line of the business (technical, system or organizational) to deliver results defined by the compelling business need of the site. You ensure that key business results are achieved and for developing others to ensure the sustained continuity of technical mastery on the manufacturing line. Using a systematic approach, you use strategic thinking skills to ensure results are sustained over the long term.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute**
 In your likely first managerial role, you will ensure that Mondelēz International’s safety, quality, cost, delivery, sustainability and morale targets are achieved for the new lines through IIM methodology for which you are responsible by breaking down section targets into line and unit targets and ensuring that employees understand their individual performance goals related to the overall targets. In this role, you will also develop budgets and be responsible for costs control management, governance and compliance, loss elimination and workforce planning, including recruitment, retention, development, succession planning, and the identification of high potential team members. Without you, we would not be able to deliver high\-quality snacks to our customers.
   

  

**What You Will Bring**
 A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career. You will bring experience and knowledge in:
   

  

* Autonomous maintenance (AM) Step 4 systems
* Maintaining equipment at basic conditions independently, including the execution of AM ,QM and FI standards on dedicated equipment and area process.
* Six Sigma including qualification of AM steps 1\-6,


**How You Will Contribute**
* Line Performance \& Business Results


 Own end\-to\-end performance of new Star 7 Line against SQCDSM/GE, productivity, yield and service targets through IIM process.
   

  

 Translate site/business targets into clear line, unit and individual objectives.
   

  

 Establish robust daily management system and performance governance systems.
   

  

 Identify performance gaps and lead structured recovery plans.
   

  

 Drive continuous improvement and ensure gains are sustained.
   

  

* Safety \& Food Safety


 Demonstrate visible felt leadership and establish a strong zero\-incident safety culture by owning one safety standard.
   

  

 Ensure compliance with safety standards, LOTO, risk assessments, SWPs and critical controls.
   

  

 Strengthen food safety, GMP and quality culture across the line.
   

  

 Lead timely closure of safety and food\-safety actions.
   

  

* Loss Elimination \& Continuous Improvement


 Lead systematic identification and elimination of the Top Line Losses.
   

  

 Use IL6s, Six Sigma, PDCA, RCA, Kaizen and structured problem\-solving methodologies.
   

  

 Improve GE/OEE, yield, changeover performance, process capability and equipment availability.
   

  

 Ensure actions address systemic/root causes rather than short\-term fixes.
   

  

 Replicate successful improvements across other lines where applicable.
   

  

* Quality \& Process Excellence


 Ensure consistent delivery of product quality and process standards.
   

  

 Drive reduction of consumer complaints, internal defects, rework and process deviations.
   

  

 Strengthen process controls and adherence to standard operating procedures.
   

  

 Develop process capability and technical standards for the new Star 7 Marvel line.
   

  

 Ensure successful product/SKU and technology transitions.
   

  

* Cost \& Budget Management


 Own line\-level cost performance and drive productivity improvements.
   

  

 Develop and manage annual operating and maintenance budgets.
   

  

 Identify cost\-saving opportunities without compromising safety, quality or reliability.
   

  

* Ensure effective implementation of DMS, RTT/SWP, AM, GE and loss\-tree governance.


 Establish clear ownership for line KPIs and KAIs.
   

  

 Ensure compliance with Mondelēz standards, policies and manufacturing systems.
   

  

 Use data and digital tools to improve decision\-making and line performance.
   

  

 Establish strong routines for daily, weekly and monthly performance reviews.
   

  

* New Line / Marvel Start\-up Excellence


 IIM Methodology implementation and Governance during Project implementations for Star 7
   

  

 Building the operating model and line organization from the ground up.
   

  

 Establishing technical standards, SOPs, SWPs and operating parameters.
   

  

 Building operator and technician capability before and during ramp\-up through TT\&T work process
   

  

 Driving commissioning, stabilization and performance ramp\-up.
   

  

 Ensuring smooth transition from project/start\-up phase to sustainable operations.
   

  

 Delivering agreed ramp\-up milestones for Safety, Quality, GE, Yield, Cost and Volume.
   

  

**What You Will Bring**
 You will bring strong manufacturing leadership experience, technical expertise and a passion for developing people.
   

  

**Key experience and capabilities include:**
* Strong experience in manufacturing/production operations and line leadership.
* Knowledge of IL6s, AM, PM and Six Sigma methodologies.
* Experience with AM Step 4 and progression toward Steps 5–6\.
* Experience with PM Step 3 and equipment reliability improvement.

* Ability to manage challenging situations with maturity and tact.

 Our vision of building a world\-class product company from Asia is backed by marquee global investors like Microsoft, Salesforce, Sequoia Capital, and Lightspeed Venture Partners.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 We are seeking an experienced Delivery Assurance Manager to join our dynamic team and ensure that every Darwinbox Implementation delivers the desired transformational value to our enterprise users.
   

  

 The Delivery Assurance Manager serves as a key liaison between implementation teams, clients, and internal stakeholders, ensuring that all deliverables meet defined quality standards, timelines are adhered to, and client expectations are exceeded throughout the implementation lifecycle alongside ensuring their readiness to manage the system in the long run.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Project Delivery Management
   

  

* Oversee end\-to\-end Delivery Assurance for multiple concurrent Darwinbox Enterprise implementations across modules and geographies
* Ensure adherence to Darwinbox’s Implementation methodology ‘Inflexion’ and established best practices
* Drive timebound corrective actions via Client and Implementation Team leadership to ensure that the required resources with desired capabilities are available for the project.
* Serve as the strategic compass to ensure that Day 1 desired value is delivered on go\-live based upon the E3 methodology (Experience, Effectiveness and Efficiency).


 Quality Assurance and Risk Management
   

  

* Identify potential risks, issues, and bottlenecks early and develop mitigation strategies
* Ensure that regular delivery checkpoints and quality reviews are carried out and corrective actions completed in time throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Implement continuous improvement initiatives based on lessons learned and improvements loop closed with client, implementation teams and other internal stakeholders.
* Steer Risk Management and Mitigation discussions during Steering Committee Meetings and leadership connections.


 Client Relationship Management
   

  

* Serve as a trusted advisor to clients, providing expert guidance at every stage of the project and enabling the client to Champion the ‘Thriving in the Cloud’ approach.
* Handle escalations and work collaboratively with clients to resolve complex issues
* Drive client engagement initiatives and maintain strong relationships throughout the project duration
* Oversee Implementation Team to User handovers post\-implementation and ensure successful transition in conjunction with Darwinbox Customer Success Teams.


 Process Optimisation and Innovation
   

  

* Design and refine delivery processes, methodologies, and documentation; maintain and progressively improve delivery templates, checklists, and knowledge repositories
* Analyze delivery metrics and provide insights for organizational improvement
* Stay current with HR technology trends and integrate innovative approaches into delivery practices
* Act as custodian of the Delivery Scorecard and corresponding actions for Implementations teams.
* Lead special projects focused on integrating AI tools into Delivery Assurance Processes.


**Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of experience in HRMS/SaaS implementation (HR domain preferred), with 4\+ years in Darwinbox/Workday/similar global HCM platforms deployments
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, IT, or related. MBA degree preferred (MBA, MS in Technology Management or equivalent)
* Certifications like Darwinbox, PMP, PRINCE2, Six Sigma or Agile/Scrum Master preferred
* Deep understanding of HR Business Processes across multiple modules: Core HR, Talent Development and Management, Employee Engagement, Payroll, leave, attendance and others.


**Skills \& Competencies**

 Regeneron is founded on the belief that the right idea, combined with the right team, can lead to significant transformations. **Who are we and what do we do?**


BrowserStack is the world’s leading cloud\-based software testing platform, empowering over 50,000 customers—including Amazon, Microsoft, Meta, and Google—to deliver high\-quality software at speed. Founded in 2011 by Ritesh Arora and Nakul Aggarwal, the company has grown to support more than two million tests daily across 22 global data centers, providing instant access to 35,000\+ real devices and browsers.


With over 1,200 employees and a remote\-first approach, BrowserStack operates at the intersection of scale, reliability, and innovation. Its suite of products spans manual and automated testing, visual regression, accessibility, and test management—all designed to simplify the testing process for modern development teams. Behind the scenes, BrowserStack continues to push the boundaries with AI capabilities like smart test case generation and design, flakiness detection, auto\-healing and more —helping teams reduce maintenance overhead, debug faster, and catch issues earlier in the development lifecycle.


Recognized for its innovation and growth, BrowserStack has been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 list for four consecutive years. With backing from investors like Accel, Bond, and Insight Partners, the company continues to expand its product offerings and global footprint. Joining BrowserStack means being part of a mission\-driven team dedicated to shaping the future of software testing.

**Location:** **This is a remote position; however, the role requires the candidate to be based in Mumbai.**  

  

**Role in Nutshell:**


The sales operations function at BrowserStack owns the go\-to\-market strategy for the direct sales business and works with internal functions including Sales, Engineering, Product, Finance and HR to build and operationalise the GTM strategy. The scope of the function spans \- GTM strategy to drive expansion and growth, Systems/Tools/ Processes design, sales enablement, sales compensation, sales funnel optimisation \& BI and reporting.

 **What will you do?**

* Understand underlying systems and sales motions, and work with relevant stakeholders to build scalable sales processes
* Own individual projects, starting with a broad business problem in the sales domain, break it down into smaller actionable items and identify data\-driven solutions to drive impact
* Have a deep understanding of our sales tech stack which includes Salesforce, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo etc. and formulate plans for optimal adoption and usage
* Create insightful dashboards to track key metrics, identify potential risks and act as a key enabler to the sales force
* Work with relevant stakeholders including Finance, Engineering, and Product teams to drive the project roadmap, and implement the solution
* Build an understanding of the sales funnel, identify relevant metrics to track the health of the business, and use SQL queries / build SFDC dashboards to analyse and present key insights to stakeholders at different levels in the company
 **Desired Experience:**

* At least 4\+ years of relevant experience at management consulting firms or investment banks; or similar BizOps experience in the technology domain
* Structured thinking, strong problem\-solving skills \& a solid business sense
* Proficient in analytics and be able to develop actionable insights using data
* Be able to multitask, prioritise, rapidly iterate and manage communications with different functions in a fast\-paced startup environment
* Strong interpersonal, communication and presentation skills.
* Background and experience in technology is highly preferred
* Experience in SaaS and enterprise software is a plus
* An MBA from a class A institution and an IIT or technology qualification will be a strong plus
* Understanding of fundamental sales concepts such as pipeline, forecasting, account distribution, variable compensation is a plus
* Hands\-on experience on SalesForce \- ability to generate reports, drive sales\-specific analysis, and present actionable insights is a plus.

In addition to your total compensation, you will be eligible for following benefits, which will be governed by the Company policy:

description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**EY GDS – Assurance FAAS – Senior Manager**
 At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture, and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

 In a world that’s changing faster than ever, our purpose acts as our ‘North Star’ guiding our more than 300,000 people – providing the context and meaning for the work we do every day. In doing so, we play a critical role in building a better working world for our people, clients, and communities. Thanks to our innovative services in auditing, tax consulting as well as transaction and management consulting, we proudly drive our clients into the future.
   

  

 From small businesses to some of the world’s best\-known brands, our clients count on reliable financial statements, information, and processes to inform their ongoing strategies. More than ever, business is about interpreting and reacting to complex data — and they look to us for advice and services they can trust every time. You’ll use your professional skills and experience to make it happen, so whether you’re looking for a long\-term, or are interested in progressing on to other areas, this is a great place to be. As the only one of the Big 4 with a specialist cross‑border practice, we offer our clients seamless, consistent, and high‑quality services around the globe. With our Assurance Services, we strengthen public confidence in global capital markets and promote sustainable growth. If you’re looking to develop your individual skills whilst working in interdisciplinary and multicultural teams, come join us!
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are looking for an experienced professional to join EY FAAS, with deep expertise across FAAS solutions and a strong focus on engagements related to transactions and technical accounting governance.
   

  

 The Senior Manager will be responsible for leading a portfolio of complex, high‑impact client engagements, ensuring the timeliness, quality, and delivery of work in line with EY Global Standards. The role requires overseeing multiple engagement teams, driving technical excellence, and acting as a trusted advisor to clients on transaction‑related accounting matters.
   

  

 While the Senior Manager will be based out of one of our EY GDS locations globally, the individual will play a key role in supporting EY practices and clients across global markets, collaborating with onshore teams and senior stakeholders. The individual may also be required to travel internationally on short‑term assignments to support client engagements.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Client responsibilities**
* Lead consulting engagements focused on the planning and execution of Transactions initiatives (including planning and execution of IPOs, and/or the planning and execution of acquisitions and divestitures), looking at a company’s internal finance and accounting processes and advising clients on solutions to increase deal value / benefits, improve processing efficiency, drive automation or reengineer existing processes to better align with future state target operating models;
* Lead business development initiatives including service offering development and roll\-out, proposal development, responding to RFP’s and participating in oral presentations
* Stay informed of changing market conditions and new regulatory developments and their impacts on clients.
* Specialization in our Transactions service offering to provide subject matter expertise and relevant go\-to\-market activities in this area
* Manage the financial and commercial aspects of engagements by organizing staffing, tracking fees and communicating issues to project leaders; and
* Build strong internal relationships within our national and global FAAS practice and across EY’s service lines including Advisory, Tax and Assurance.
* Drive innovation by creating an environment that encourages innovation and being a leader in this area by implementing new and improved ways of working, delivery models and / or technological advancements


**People Management Responsibilities**
* Prioritize the development of people through effective coaching, constructive on\-the\-job feedback and mentoring
* Foster an innovative and inclusive team\-oriented work environment
* Effectively motivate teams with diverse skills and backgrounds
* Conduct performance reviews and contribute to performance feedback for staff
* Lead/contribute to people initiatives including recruiting, retaining and training FAAS professionals
* Maintain an educational program to continually develop personal skills
* Understand, follow, and lead by example as it relates to workplace policies and procedures


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Technical accounting experience in IFRS and US GAAP
* In\-depth knowledge in several of:
+ IPO readiness assessment and management of activities across the IPO lifecycle. Past participation / involvement in an IPO would be an asset
+ Planning and integration of acquisitions across all aspects of Organization / People, Process and Technology including both project management and execution
+ Planning and management of disposals across all aspects of Organization / People, Process and Technology including both project management and execution
+ Audit or business experience in financial statement close

* Highly developed analytical skills focused on business case
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with an ability to think critically and identify creative solutions outside of the box and thrive on new challenges
* Proven track record with a blue\-chip consulting firm in the field or significant equivalent industry experience would be an asset
* Experience in leading and delivering program/projects that cover the full life cycle of assessment, design and implementation support
* Strong spoken and written English skills
* Leading and driving high\-quality work products within expected timeframes and on budget
* The ability to lead and work collaboratively in a team environment
* Dedication to teamwork, people development and leadership, with experience in managing and/or mentoring junior staff and providing direction to team members
* Excellent communication skills including verbal, written, and presentation
* A high level of motivation and a self\-starting attitude
* A willingness to travel on short notice to meet client needs


**Professional experience:**
 Typical experience may include, whilst not limited to:
   

  

* Experience of working in a consulting role in financial accounting and advisory or transaction advisory, or a transformation role in industry,
* Advanced skills and experience with: M\&A support, SPAC transactions, IPO readiness support, Carve\-out, GAAP conversions etc.
* Hands\-on consulting experience at a Big 4, or top tier consulting firm, or leading change programmes in industry, or leading a line function in a finance or controllership environment.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Chartered Accountant (CA), CPA (US) or ACCA (UK)
* 10\-13 years (post qualification) in Assurance including 5 years of Financial Accounting and Advisory experience
* Candidates with prior Big 4/Big 10 experience would be an added advantage
* Exposure to AI, data analytics and visualization tools (an added advantage)


**What We Look For**
* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment
* An opportunity to be part of a market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team of 7200 \+ professionals, in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
* Opportunity to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are. You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees, and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

 Primary Channel

 Experience 
 14 years, with chat handling in logistics / last-mile / e-commerce 
 ABOUT THE ROLE 
 DentalKart is looking for a Chat Expert who thrives on live chat and can genuinely hold maximum concurrency multiple real conversations running at once without dropping quality, tone, or accuracy on any single one. This is a chat-first role, but we need someone whose skillset doesnt stop at chat: you should be equally comfortable jumping on a call or writing a clean email when a case needs it, and you should understand what happens end-to-end when an order or delivery goes wrong. 
 You will be the first serious line of resolution for our customers fast enough to keep multiple chats moving, and sharp enough to actually solve the problem instead of just replying quickly. 
 WHAT YOULL OWN 
 - Maximum concurrency chat handling: Running multiple live chats simultaneously at a high concurrency level, keeping every customer moving without generic copy-paste replies or long response gaps. 
 - End-to-end escalation handling: Owning a query from first message to final resolution order issues, delivery delays, refunds, or product concerns rather than handing it off after the first response. 
 - Voice and email fluency: Stepping onto a call when a chat needs a human voice to resolve faster, and writing precise, professional emails for cases that need a documented trail. 
 - Logistics and last-mile understanding: Applying real knowledge of last-mile delivery, courier partners, and e-commerce order flows to give customers accurate updates instead of vague reassurances. 
 - Judgment under load: Reading tone in a chat and adjusting your approach in real time slowing down, acknowledging, or escalating internally before a routine query turns into a complaint. 
 - Documentation: Keeping chat, voice, and email interactions logged clearly and consistently, so context is never lost if a case is picked up by someone else. 
 WHAT WERE LOOKING FOR 
 - 14 years in a live chat or blended support role, with proven experience managing high concurrency not single-chat or low-volume queues. 
 - Prior experience in logistics, last-mile delivery, courier, or e-commerce operations, with real understanding of how shipments, RTOs, and delivery exceptions work. 
 - Comfortable handling voice calls and writing emails, not chat-only. 
 - Expert-level typing speed and accuracy able to type fast and correctly under pressure across several open chats. 
 - Excellent written and spoken English, with the judgment to know when a chat should be escalated versus resolved directly. 
 - Comfortable owning a case end-to-end rather than passing it along at the first sign of difficulty. 
 GOOD TO HAVE 
 - Familiarity with Zoho Desk, Zoho SalesIQ, or a similar helpdesk/CRM platform. 
 - Exposure to dental, healthcare, or B2B e-commerce categories. 
 - A track record of consistently high CSAT or chat resolution scores in a previous role. 
 WHY THIS ROLE 
 Chat is the highest-volume, highest-visibility channel in our CX operation, and the people who excel here are the ones who move fastest into escalation and team lead tracks. If you can genuinely handle volume without losing quality, this role is built to grow with you.

Skill required: Talent Development - Learning Delivery Operations

 Designation: Instructor Associate Manager

 Qualifications: Any Graduation 

 Years of Experience: 10 to 14 years 

 What would you do 
 Deliver high-impact virtual leadership and communication training for employees of a US-based logistics company. This is a delivery-focused learning partner role, not an end-to-end course builder. The ideal candidate will:
 Conceptualize the right delivery approach for leadership and non-technical topics
 Advise on program structure and flow to maximize participant impact
 Engage confidently with senior client audiences while collaborating with the central design team
 Conduct comprehensive needs analysis and drive continuous improvement measurement
 Maintain strong customer relationships and demonstrate expertise through recognized LDP certifications
This role emphasizes world-class virtual delivery, customer partnership, and data-driven improvementleveraging pre-built curriculum and design support from the central team.
Talent Development involves creating and implementing programs to enhance employees skills and career growth. This includes training, mentoring, and performance management. The goal is to help employees reach their full potential and contribute effectively to the organization. Responsibilities also include identifying skill gaps and developing strategies to address them. This role is essential for fostering a skilled and motivated workforce.
Ensure successful delivery of learning solutions and review their effectiveness and applicability.

 What are we looking for 
 5-10 years of proven experience delivering leadership and communication training, preferably with US client exposure and scalable virtual delivery models.
 Minimum ONE recognized LDP certification (MBTI-trained facilitator, Hogan certified, DDI trained, CliftonStrengths certified, Five Behaviors facilitator, or equivalent industry-standard credential demonstrating specialized expertise).
 Demonstrated experience conducting needs analysis for training programs, including learner personas, organizational context assessment, and success metric definition.
 Multiple LDP certifications (e.g., MBTI + Hogan + CliftonStrengths combination) demonstrating depth of expertise.
 Experience with logistics-specific leadership challenges, frontline team motivation, operational decision-making, and supply chain context.
 Expertise in adaptive, blended, and personalized learning models; experience with learning technology and adaptive platforms.
 Track record of scaling training programs from pilot to enterprise level; experience managing multiple concurrent cohorts.
 Speaking experience at industry conferences, webinars, or training forums.
 Background in organizational development, change management, or executive coaching.

Essential Skills Competencies
1. Needs Analysis Discovery - Ability to conduct structured interviews, design assessment frameworks, analyze organizational contexts, and translate insights into delivery design.
2. Persona Development Adaptation - Skill in creating learner personas, adapting communication style, and customizing examples and activities based on audience profiles.
3. Measurement Data Analysis - Comfort with training metrics, survey design, data interpretation, and translating findings into recommendations.
4. Continuous Improvement Mindset - Proactive approach to identifying enhancement opportunities, iterating on delivery, and documenting learnings for scaling.
5. Customer Liaison Stakeholder Management - Comfort presenting to C-suite, gathering feedback, managing expectations, and building collaborative partnerships.
6. Virtual Facilitation Excellence - Mastery of virtual delivery techniques, participant engagement in distributed settings, time zone flexibility, and technical proficiency.

**Job Description:**
**About Us**
 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day. Being a Great Place to Work is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. This includes our commitment to being an inclusive workplace, attracting and developing exceptional talent, supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness, recognizing and rewarding performance, and how we make an impact in the communities we serve.
   

  

 Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture with specific requirements for office\-based attendance and which allows for an appropriate level of flexibility for our teammates and businesses based on role\-specific considerations.
   

  

 At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview**
 Global Markets Business Finance \& Control (BF\&C) is a division of Global Banking \& Markets (GBAM) Finance responsible for the production and independent validation of Global Markets' profit and loss and balance sheet. The team is also responsible for running valuation controls to ensure fair value of balance sheet in accordance with internal valuation methodology and regulatory requirements. This includes independent price verification of both vanilla securities/derivatives and complex/illiquid assets such as exotic derivatives and distressed assets. Additionally, the team also calculates relevant valuation adjustments including adjustments for illiquidity, concentration, model limitations etc. as applicable. The team is also responsible for calculating and reporting prudential valuation adjustments on a quarterly basis.
   

  

 The team works closely with front office, middle office, traders, valuation control and methodology (GVG) teams to drive the control agenda across the business.
   

  

**Job Description**
 IPV Center of Excellence forms part of the GBAM CFO Group and is a control and business advisory function. The team’s work primarily covers valuation controls for various asset classes across Global Banking and Markets, with a dynamic book of work providing opportunities to centralize, enhance and implement best practices for global valuation routines.
   

  

 We are looking to recruit an individual to work in the valuations control area for one of the asset classes within FICC Macro (Rates/FX/Commodities) / FICC Micro (Credit/Mortgages/Munis) / XVA / Equities businesses in Global Markets. The candidate’s main responsibility will be to perform Independent Price Verification, Valuation Adjustments, Prudent Valuations and Fair Value Hierarchy assessment, providing a high standard of analysis and explanation.
   

  

 The candidate will therefore have considerable interaction with the respective Front Office, Finance and Global Valuations Group (GVG) teams so good communication and time management skills are an essential requirement for this job. The team is also encouraged to take part in employee engagement and diversity and inclusion initiatives to help continue to make Bank of America a great place to work.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Performing the calculation and analysis of valuation controls including IPV, valuation adjustments and prudent valuation adjustments, as well as ownership for Fair Value Hierarchy levelling.
* Working with the Global Valuation Group to ensure ongoing review \& enhancement of valuation control methodologies and practices.
* Ensuring procedure documents are accurate and up to date.
* Assisting in the streamlining and enhancement valuation processes and becoming actively involved with system development ranging from technical enhancements and new product releases to automation of existing processes.
* Engaging with the key stakeholders including Front Line Units.
* A strong understanding of valuation controls, regulatory rules and governance including Independent Price Verification, Valuation Adjustments and Prudential Valuation.


**Requirements**
**Education :** 
 Qualified Chartered Accountant/CPA /CFA / MBA from Tier I/II institute with relevant experience in Valuation Control or Global Markets environment and organization of similar scale with US GAAP, IFRS, IAS reporting framework with an interest and aptitude for derivative products.
   

  

 Certifications If Any
   

  

* CFA / FRM certified candidates would be preferred.
* Advanced education and/or enhanced technical qualifications are a plus.
* Ability to use Access or VBA would enhance the candidate’s attractiveness significantly.


**Experience Range :** 
 7\+ years of experience in Global Markets Valuation Control or similar roles
   

  

**Foundational Skills**
* Alteryx / Tableau / Python knowledge would be an added advantage.
* Have the awareness to escalate potential issues to their supervisor in a timely manner.
* Candidate must have a proven track record of communicating effectively with personnel from various areas within an organization and at different management levels.
* Must be proactive and be a highly motivated self\-starter.

* Strong team player
* Ability to analyze issues independently and derive solutions

* Inherent sense of principles of control through experience and sound judgment
* Reliability

**Job Title**
 Security Officer
   

  

**Job Description Summary**
 Under the supervision of the Security Director, provide for the safety and protection of the building and premises by controlling access points, patrolling the site, monitoring activities and otherwise proactively preventing theft, illegal or unauthorized entry, vandalism and violence.
   

  

**Job Description**
 ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES
   

  

* Patrol the interior and exterior premises to prevent and detect signs of intrusion and ensure security of doors, windows, and gates
* Answer alarms and investigate disturbances
* Monitor and authorize entrance and departure of employees, visitors, and other persons to guard against theft and maintain the security of the premises using the on\-site system, data base and procedures
* Write reports of daily activities and irregularities, such as equipment or property damage, theft, presence of unauthorized persons or unusual occurrences
* Immediately notify the Security Director in cases of emergency, such as fire or presence of unauthorized persons and immediately report same to local Police and Fire departments
* Circulate among visitors, patrons, and employees to preserve order and protect property
* Answer telephone calls to take messages, answer questions and provide information during non\-business hours or when switchboard is closed
* Warn persons of rule infractions or violations and apprehend or evict violators from premises, using force when necessary and as instructed by the Director and pursuant to building policy and applicable laws
* May be required to operate detecting devices to screen individuals and prevent passage of prohibited articles into restricted areas
* Inspect and adjust security and life safety systems, equipment, and machinery to ensure operational use and to detect evidence of tampering
* Monitor and adjust controls that regulate building systems, such as air conditioning, furnace, or boiler
* While on post, be an ambassador for the property owner for visitors
* Assist with severe weather activities and ensure “Wet Floor’ signs are posted and notify Housekeeping if wet floors need to be addressed


 KEY COMPETENCIES
   

  

* Customer Focus
* Communication Proficiency (oral and written)


 IMPORTANT EDUCATION
   

  

* High School Diploma or GED equivalent


**Important Experience**
* A minimum of 2 years of prior security experience is required, preferably in a commercial or industrial setting

* CPR Certified
* Knowledge of Security State and Federal Laws and Regulations
* Ability to maintain applicable licensing requirements
* Ability to maintain a valid driver’s license
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
* Must be able to establish and maintain effective working relationships
* Must exercise a high degree of integrity and demonstrate a strong code of ethics


 WORK ENVIRONMENT
   

  

 This job operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines. Regularly required to travel outside between properties in varying weather conditions.
   

  

 PHYSICAL DEMANDS
   

  

 The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.
   

  

* Must have ability to stoop, stand, climb, frequently lift a minimum of 50 lbs. of equipment (pumps, tools, ladders) and safely install rigging/lifting devices
* Regularly required to crouch and reach to install/move equipment by bending forward at the waist or by bending legs and spine
* Involves movement between departments, floors, and properties to facilitate work
* Ability to speak clearly so others can understand you
* Ability to read and understand information presented orally and in writing
* Regularly required to utilize vision abilities, allowing reading of printed material, drawings, and schematics

As a SOC Manager, you will be responsible for leading a team of security professionals and managing all aspects of the Security Operations Center for client engagements. You will oversee the delivery of SOC services, ensure the effective detection and response to cybersecurity threats, and maintain strong client relationships. Leveraging your extensive experience and leadership skills, you will drive excellence in service delivery, implement best practices, and contribute to the overall success of the clients security program.

* Prepare and deliver comprehensive reports and presentations to clients on SOC performance and security metrics. Compliance and Risk Management
* Ensure that SOC operations comply with relevant regulatory requirements and industry standards.
* Conduct risk assessments and implement controls to mitigate security risks for client engagements. Training and Development
* Identify training needs and opportunities for skill development within the SOC team.
* Facilitate training sessions, workshops, and certifications to enhance technical and professional competencies.

 **Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* SIEM Management Penetration Testing (Good to have) Bachelors degree in computer science, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent experience. 10 to 13 years of experience in cybersecurity, with a focus on SOC operations, incident response, and client management.

* Strong technical expertise in security tools, technologies, and best practices.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or GIAC certifications are preferred.
* Educational background: Bachelors degree in computer science, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

* **Title** 
 : Delivery Lead — Social \& Search Ops
* **Location** 
 : Bengaluru, India (Work from Office, 5 days a week)
* **Timings** 
 : 2\-11 pm



  





**About Joveo** 




 As the global leader in AI\-powered recruitment marketing, we are transforming talent attraction and recruitment media buying for the world’s largest and smartest employers, staffing businesses, RPOs, and recruitment advertising agencies.
 



  





 The Joveo platform enables businesses to attract, source, engage, and hire the most relevant candidates on time, within their budget. Powering millions of jobs every day, our data\-driven recruitment marketing platform uses advanced data science and machine learning to dynamically manage and optimize talent sourcing and applications across all online channels while providing real\-time insights at every step of the job seeker journey, from click to hire.
 



  





**About the Role** 



* The Delivery Lead is the most senior role in the Social \& Search Operations team. You own the business — revenue, client outcomes, team performance, and the operating model that ties it all together.
* The team is structured in pods. Each pod is an Account Manager and one or more Associates. The AM owns the client relationship within their pod; the Associate owns campaign execution. You sit above all pods — accountable for what every pod delivers, for the commercial health of the client portfolio, and for the team's growth as professionals.
* This role exists because the team is scaling a significant mandate: taking over client\-facing campaign operations from a CS function, building toward full end\-to\-end ownership of enterprise recruitment advertising accounts. You will be the person who makes that transition work — credible with clients, trusted by your team, and commercially sharp with leadership.
* If you have spent your career executing campaigns for someone else's clients, this is not the right step. If you have owned outcomes — revenue targets, client retention, team results — and are ready to do that in a high\-growth environment, this is the role.



  





**What You Will Do** 



* Own the revenue number for the Social \& Search Operations practice — renewals, upsells, and new business contributions
* Oversee all client pods — review account health across the portfolio, identify risk accounts, and intervene when needed
* Step in as the senior escalation point for client issues that exceed AM\-level resolution
* Present portfolio\-level performance and strategy to senior client stakeholders (C\-suite, VP\-level) on key accounts
* Lead quarterly business reviews for strategic accounts alongside or on behalf of AMs
* Partner with Sales on enterprise pitches and proposals — you bring the performance marketing credibility
* Hire, onboard, and develop AMs and Associates — including defining role clarity, setting performance expectations, and running structured feedback
* Define and enforce operating standards across pods: SLA compliance, reporting quality, campaign health benchmarks
* Work with leadership to define which accounts receive full client\-facing ownership vs. CS\-supported delivery
* Report monthly to senior leadership on capacity utilisation, revenue performance, and team health



  





**What You Will Own** 



* The revenue performance of the Social \& Search Operations practice
* Client retention across all pod accounts — renewal rate, satisfaction, escalation resolution
* Team structure and headcount decisions — you define when a new pod is needed and what profile to hire
* Cross\-pod quality and consistency — every client gets the same standard regardless of which pod they sit in
* The operating model — you update and enforce the RoE, SLAs, and pod protocols as the team evolves



  





**What You Bring** 



* 7–12 years in performance marketing, with the last 3\+ years in a leadership role that included direct revenue or P\&L accountability
* Proven track record of owning client relationships at a senior level — you have presented to and retained enterprise clients, not just supported someone who did
* Direct team management experience — you have hired, developed, and if necessary, exited people
* Deep hands\-on knowledge of paid media (Meta, Google Ads, LinkedIn, programmatic) — you can review a campaign setup and identify problems, even if you no longer run accounts yourself
* Commercial acumen — you understand margin, renewal economics, upsell signals, and how to have a pricing or scope conversation with a client
* Experience running operations at scale — multiple clients, multiple channels, multiple team members simultaneously
* Strong executive communication — you are credible in a C\-suite room, and you can translate campaign performance into business outcomes without losing the audience
* Bangalore\-based or willing to relocate — this is a full\-time, in\-office leadership role



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Background in performance marketing agencies — multi\-client ops and client servicing discipline is a strong advantage
* Experience in recruitment advertising, employer branding, or HR tech — shortest ramp time into Joveo's client context
* P\&L ownership or revenue target accountability in a previous role — not just budget management
* Experience building or restructuring a team from the ground up
* Exposure to programmatic advertising platforms (DSPs, job boards, Joveo or similar)
* MBA or equivalent from a recognised institution — useful but never a substitute for the track record above



  





**Build the next chapter of Joveo. Apply now**

**Description**
 AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
   

  

 You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**About You**
 You will be a proven manager with experience managing teams of high performers. You will have the ability to refine and develop processes to optimize operational excellence in every area of your role. You will be able to drive performance levels to achieve the pace at which we build and operate Data Centers in India for Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (“ADSIPL”). You will have previous experience in Data Centers, either building or managing (or both) along with exposure to developing great relationships with both internal teams and external vendors.
   

  

 You will also have a passion for technology along with a desire to be the best at your job every day!
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Data Center Manager in ADSIPL, you will get to manage the world’s largest Cloud Computing Infrastructure in India. We encounter interesting, challenging \& complex problems every day, being a technical manager in ADSIPL means that you can innovate to solve these issues and help drive Operations Excellence in all areas of your role.
   

  

 Your day job at ADSIPL will include (but not limited to):
   

  

* Managing and developing teams of engineers, providing both technical and leadership expertise and ensuring highest levels of performance.
* Maintaining existing co\-located and in\-house Data Centers
* Helping build and bring online new Data Centers
* Constantly improving all our processes and procedures. We believe there is nothing we cannot improve
* Assisting \& managing relationships with external vendors \& contractors
* Liaising with internal teams \& management groups
* Ensuring we adhere to and exceed local Health \& Safety standards in all our Data Centers
* Creating and maintaining metrics on all aspects of our Data Centers and utilizing those metrics to drive positive changes
* Assisting in implementing service methodologies including incident management, problem management, change management, capacity management, etc.


 What are we looking for in a successful AWS Returner Data Centre Manager (DCM) candidate along with the technical knowledge and experience.
   

  

 People Management.
   

  

 As a successful candidate you will have managed a team of at least 5 individuals, over a period of at least 3 years. You will be able to demonstrate how you have continued to improve performance of an existing team along with displaying skills in creating or growing a team. Experience managing both high \& low performing employees will be of advantage along with conflict management.
   

  

 Incident Management.
   

  

 You will have a lot of experience dealing with high severity situations, show a clear understanding of the wider blast implications of any issue/outage and potential consequences of differing outcome scenarios. You will also have experience in Change Management \& Fault Management.
   

  

 Vendor Management.
   

  

 An Amazon, individual has to deal with vendors, contractors \& security companies. You will be able to prove you have experience dealing with external vendors and be able to display incidents of both problem \& conflict management when dealing with same.
   

  

 Process Improvement.
   

  

 You will be able to demonstrate an ability of taking both a good working process \& a bad process and improving. You will have experience in processes mapping, implementing remediation steps and how this affected the overall business you were working in. Experience in Kaizen/Lean/Six Sigma is preferable
   

  

 Health \& Safety.
   

  

 Health \& Safety should be at the forefront of every manager's mind. Managers should be able to positively influence the Safety culture of the Data Center organization.
   

  

**About The Team**
 About AWS
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of managing technical teams with significant personnel management experience and examples of developing engineers and building successful teams experience
* 7\+ years of managing large complex facilities organizations experience
* Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
* 4\+ years of data center engineering or operations experience

description:
**Summary**
 The India\-based Compliance Operations Manager will support the management and execution of the Corporate Compliance Program, with responsibility for coordinating, overseeing, and driving key compliance operations activities across the Legal, Privacy and Compliance function. This role will provide operational support for compliance training, including tracking, follow\-up, reporting, and related documentation as well as vendor oversight activities, including vendor compliance matters, site audit activities and follow\-up monitoring. The role is intended to strengthen execution, documentation, and accountability across the broader Corporate Compliance program and its key operational activities.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
* Provide operational support for Corporate Compliance Program activities, including compliance training, vendor oversight, auditing and monitoring, policy governance, compliance documentation, and related activities
* Support compliance management with training administration, including tracking completion status, preparing follow\-up reports, monitoring delinquency trends, maintaining supporting documentation, and coordinating reminders or escalations as needed
* Manage vendor oversight activities, including scheduling and documenting vendor tiering meetings, maintaining tiering trackers, coordinating site audit logistics, collecting audit evidence and tracking open follow\-up items through closure
* Coordinate client, vendor and third\-party audit requests, including oversight of documentation and evidence collection, deadline management, and follow\-up on outstanding requests and corrective action items
* Manage compliance program tracking and reporting, including dashboards, status reports, meeting documentation, and other management tools that provide visibility into compliance activities, priorities, and progress
* Coordinate with U.S. and India\-based stakeholders to support timely information gathering, issue escalation, documentation review, and completion of assigned compliance operations activities
* Assist with periodic reviews of compliance policies, procedures, and control documents by tracking review cycles, compiling feedback, and maintaining version control and approval documentation
* Lead the initial preparation of Compliance Committee materials, including drafting meeting agendas, minutes, follow\-up trackers, and coordinate review and finalization with Compliance leadership
* Identify and assess operational gaps, overdue items, documentation deficiencies and process inefficiencies, and drive appropriate escalation, follow\-up and resolution in coordination with Compliance leadership
* Maintain subject matter awareness of applicable compliance processes and internal requirements to support consistent execution of compliance operations activities
* Take on additional assignments and responsibilities as business needs dictate


**Required (Must Have)**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Arts/Sciences (B.A./B.S.) or commensurate work experience
* 7\+ years of experience in compliance, risk management, legal operations, privacy, audit, or a related field.
* Experience managing compliance programs, policies, and internal controls.
* Strong project management and operational excellence skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities.
* Experience leading compliance investigations, risk assessments, audits, and remediation activities.
* Ability to partner effectively across global, cross\-functional teams.
* Strong analytical, critical\-thinking, and problem\-solving skills.


**Preferred (Good To Have)**
* Experience in healthcare, healthcare technology, privacy, or other regulated industries.
* Knowledge of privacy and compliance frameworks, including HIPAA, GDPR, AI governance, and third\-party risk management.
* Experience supporting compliance operations in a global environment.
* Familiarity with governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) platforms such as OneTrust or similar tools.
