title: INP066: Sr. Specialist, Supply Chain Operations
description:
We are looking for an experienced Supervisor – Supply Chain Operations (Pharma Vertical in 3PL logistics ) with 10–15 years of experience in supply chain and logistics operations in India, with strong expertise in 3PL, contract logistics and customer\-centric supply chain operations.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience managing complex supply chain operations for Pharma and/or MedTech customers, with a strong understanding of the specific quality, compliance, service and operational requirements associated with these industries.
   

  

 The role will be responsible for managing end\-to\-end supply chain operations, driving operational excellence, improving productivity and service levels, ensuring compliance, managing customer relationships, and delivering sustainable cost and profitability improvements.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* End\-to\-End Supply Chain Operations
* Lead and manage day\-to\-day 3PL / contract logistics operations across assigned customer accounts or locations.
* Ensure smooth and efficient execution of warehousing, inventory, order fulfillment, distribution and transportation activities.
* Translate customer requirements and contractual commitments into effective operational plans.
* Ensure achievement of agreed SLAs, KPIs, service levels and operational targets.
* Monitor operational performance and take timely corrective actions for gaps and deviations.
* Manage operational capacity in line with business volumes, seasonality and customer growth.
* Ensure business continuity and effective contingency planning.
* Pharma \& MedTech Supply Chain Operations
* Manage supply chain operations for Pharma and MedTech customers, ensuring adherence to customer\-specific requirements and applicable quality standards.
* Develop a strong understanding of Pharma/MedTech supply chain requirements related to product handling, storage, inventory management, order fulfillment, distribution and traceability.
* Ensure compliance with relevant customer quality systems, SOPs and regulatory requirements.
* Work closely with Quality, Compliance and customer teams to manage deviations, CAPAs, audits and operational quality issues.
* Ensure appropriate handling and control of sensitive, high\-value or regulated products as applicable.
* Maintain strong focus on product integrity, inventory accuracy, order accuracy and traceability.
* Customer \& Stakeholder Management
* Act as a key operational point of contact for assigned customers and stakeholders.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with Pharma and MedTech customers.
* Conduct regular operational performance reviews and business reviews with customers.
* Understand customer priorities and proactively address service and operational concerns.
* Manage escalations effectively and ensure timely closure of customer issues.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer experience and strengthen long\-term partnerships.
* Work closely with Sales, Solution Design, Finance, Procurement, IT, Quality and other internal teams.
* Operational Excellence \& Productivity
* Drive continuous improvement across warehouse, transportation and supply chain processes.
* Identify opportunities to improve productivity, resource utilization, process efficiency and service quality.
* Establish and monitor productivity standards for key operational activities.
* Optimize manpower, equipment, warehouse capacity and other operational resources.
* Lead Lean, Kaizen, Six Sigma or other continuous improvement initiatives.
* Identify process bottlenecks and implement sustainable corrective and preventive actions.
* Drive automation, digitization and technology adoption wherever commercially and operationally viable.
* Inventory \& Order Management
* Ensure high levels of inventory accuracy and order fulfillment accuracy.
* Monitor inventory movements, cycle counts, stock reconciliation and inventory controls.
* Ensure timely and accurate order processing, picking, packing and dispatch.
* Monitor inventory variances, damages, losses, expiry and other inventory\-related risks.
* Establish effective controls to minimize errors, rework and operational losses.
* Ensure proper documentation and system transactions across the supply chain process.
* Performance Management \& Analytics
* Define, monitor and improve operational KPIs across customer accounts.
* Track metrics such as:
+ On\-Time In\-Full (OTIF)
+ Order Fulfillment Accuracy
+ Inventory Accuracy
+ Warehouse Productivity
+ Picking/Packing Accuracy
+ Dispatch Accuracy
+ Order Cycle Time
+ Dock\-to\-Stock Time
+ Cost per Order / Unit
+ Space Utilization
+ Manpower Productivity
+ Customer SLA Compliance

* Cost \& Profitability Management
* Manage operating costs for assigned supply chain operations.
* Identify opportunities for cost reduction, productivity improvement and margin enhancement.
* Monitor manpower, warehouse, transportation, equipment and other operating costs.
* Ensure operations perform in line with agreed financial and commercial objectives.
* Partner with Finance to monitor budget, actual costs, accruals and profitability.
* Develop and execute action plans to improve account profitability.
* Identify and implement value\-creation opportunities for customers and the business.
* 3PL \& Contract Logistics Management
* Manage and operate complex third\-party logistics and contract logistics environments.
* Ensure adherence to contractual obligations, SLAs, SOPs and commercial commitments.
* Review operational performance against contract requirements.
* Identify contractual gaps, scope changes and opportunities for operational/commercial improvement.
* Support contract renewals, business expansions, transition projects and new customer implementations.
* Ensure effective governance mechanisms are established with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Quality, Compliance \& Risk Management
* Ensure compliance with company policies, customer SOPs and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Support internal, customer and regulatory audits.
* Ensure timely closure of audit observations and corrective actions.
* Establish effective operational controls to minimize risks related to inventory, quality, safety and service.
* Promote a strong culture of quality, compliance and operational discipline.
* Ensure appropriate documentation, training and SOP adherence across operations.
* Team Leadership \& People Development
* Lead, develop and mentor operations teams across assigned locations/accounts.
* Establish clear performance objectives and productivity expectations.
* Build a culture of accountability, customer focus and continuous improvement.
* Identify capability gaps and develop training and development plans.
* Manage workforce planning and resource requirements in line with business volumes.
* Develop high\-performing teams and succession pipelines.
* Transformation \& New Business Implementation
* Support new customer onboarding, transition and implementation projects.
* Work with Solution Design and Business Development teams to translate proposed solutions into operational reality.
* Validate operational assumptions, capacity requirements, manpower plans and productivity targets.
* Lead operational readiness activities for new sites, customers, products and services.
* Ensure successful stabilization and handover of new operations to the BAU team.


**Required Qualifications \& Experience**
* MBA in Supply Chain, Logistics, Operations, Engineering, Business Administration or related discipline.
* 10–15 years of relevant experience in supply chain, logistics or operations in India.
* Strong experience in 3PL / third\-party contract logistics.
* Proven experience managing end\-to\-end supply chain or logistics operations.
* Relevant experience working with Pharma and/or MedTech customers within supply chain/logistics operations is strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of warehousing, inventory management, order fulfillment, transportation and distribution.
* Experience managing customer accounts and senior customer stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of operational KPIs, SLAs and contract logistics commercial models.
* Experience in productivity improvement, cost optimization and operational excellence.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience with WMS, TMS, ERP/SAP or other supply chain technology platforms is preferred.


**Preferred Industry Experience**
 Candidates from organizations providing
 **3PL / contract logistics services to Pharma, Healthcare, Medical Devices or Life Sciences customers** 
 would be strongly preferred.
   

  

**Experience With The Following Would Be An Advantage**
* Pharma distribution and logistics
* Medical device logistics
* Healthcare supply chains
* Temperature\-controlled / controlled\-condition logistics
* High\-value product handling
* Batch / lot / serial number traceability
* Expiry management
* FEFO / FIFO inventory management
* Regulatory and customer audits
* Reverse logistics
* Product recall / quarantine processes
* Customer\-specific quality and compliance requirements


 The Company
   

  

 FedEx Logistics provides e\-Commerce, freight forwarding, as well as import and export services that allow companies to reach markets throughout the world. They help customers of all sizes solve the intricacies of shipping goods globally by providing comprehensive international ocean and air freight forwarding, surface transportation and distribution, customs brokerage, trade and customs advisory services, and advanced e\-commerce and trade facilitation solutions.
   

  

 The Philosophy
   

  

 People–Service–Profit (P\-S\-P). We take care of our People so that they can deliver impeccable Service to our customers who will give us the Profit necessary for FedEx to be successful. Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P\-S\-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages employees to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for our employees' well\-being and value their contributions to the company.
   

  

 The Culture
   

  

 We honor innovation, integrity and diversity. We have many formal policies, procedures and programs to bring out the best in our staff, individually and in teams.
   

  

 The Mission
   

  

 We strive to be the Best Company to work for with the Best Service and the Best Brand in our industry.
   

  

 We're glad you stopped by and hope your job search experience with FedEx Logistics, Inc. will be rewarding. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Associate General Manager
description:
**Associate General Manager – Facility Management** 




**Location:** 
 Mumbai
 



  





**About Us** 




  





 StayVista is
 **India’s largest villa hospitality brand** 
 and has redefined group getaways. Our handpicked luxury villas are present in every famous holiday destination across the country. We curate unique experiences paired with top\-notch hospitality, creating unforgettable stays.
 **Here, you will be a part of our passionate team, dedicated to crafting exceptional getaways and curating one\-of\-a\-kind homes.** 
 We are a close\-knit tribe, united by a shared love for travel and on a mission to become the most loved hospitality brand in India.
 



  





**Why Work With Us?** 




  





 At StayVista, you're part of a community where your ideas and growth matter. We’re a fast\-growing team that values continuous improvement. With our skill upgrade programs, you’ll keep learning and evolving, just like we do. And hey, when you’re ready for a break, our villa discounts make it easy to enjoy the luxury you help create.
 



  





**Your Role** 




  





 As an
 **Associate General Manager at StayVista,** 
 you will be responsible for the development and operations of StayVista's Facility Management, creating frameworks for property maintenance, utilities, security, and other key services. Responsibilities include expanding the client base, managing contracts, implementing SOPs, and overseeing daily villa operations to ensure guest\-ready properties and high service standards. You’ll stay current on industry trends to drive continuous improvement and innovation.
 



  





**About You** 




  




* Overseeing Daily Operations\- Make sure everything in the resorts and villas works smoothly \- from the lights to the pools to the rooms. Ensure regular maintenance and repairs are done on time to avoid problems.
* Managing the Team\- Lead and support the staff who take care of maintenance, cleaning and security at all locations. Make sure everyone is properly trained and working well together.
* Budgeting and Cost Control\- Help create the budget for maintenance and repairs. Keep track of costs and make sure everything stays within budget.
* Safety and Compliance\- Ensure all facilities are safe for both staff and guests. Make sure the resorts meet local safety rules and regulations (like fire safety, health codes, etc.).
* Guest Satisfaction\- Ensure that the resort/villa's facilities are in top shape to make sure guests have a great experience. Handle any complaints related to maintenance or cleanliness.
* Renovation and Projects\- Help manage any big renovations or upgrades needed for the resorts and villas. Ensure new resorts or villas are set up properly.
* Using Technology\- Use tools and systems to track maintenance, staff schedules and costs. Implement energy\-saving measures to reduce costs and be more eco\-friendly.
* Reporting and Improvements\- Keep track of how well everything is running and report back to the Facility Head. Suggest ways to improve operations, based on what’s working and what isn’t.
* Sustainability\- Implement eco\-friendly practices, like saving water and energy and reducing waste.
* Travel\- Travel to different locations across India to ensure all the resorts and villas are in good condition. Fix major issues on\-site if needed.
* Do Regular Audits\- Visit each location to check if everything is clean, safe and working properly. Use a checklist to inspect things like rooms, kitchens, maintenance areas, gardens, etc.
* Support Quality Checks\- Help make sure all staff follow the company’s quality and cleanliness standards.
* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Business, Hospitality Management, Real Estate, or a related field.
* This position includes tasks supporting Owner and Guest Management, as determined by organizational needs.



  





**Bonus Points \- These are non\-essential, but a bonus if you have them!** 




  




* Experience managing multi\-location hospitality or luxury villa operations.
* Proficiency with facility management software and digital audit tools.



  





**Key Metrics: what you will drive and achieve** 




  




* Guest Experience % 3 star or below
* Owner Feedback Average should not be below 3 "FM Ops Tracker (AMC, R\&M, Inventory \& Supplies)"
* Completion of Ops tracker within the timeline. (Inventory, AMC, vendor payments, daily tracker) Track AMC and repair \& maintenance schedules (equipment upkeep, pool \& utility maintenance).
* Ensure adequate material/consumables
* .Mystery Audit Above 80% average of all properties (each property per month) Staffing of properties (inbound) Deployment within TAT (03 weeks)



  





**Our Core Values:** 
 Are you a
 ***CURATER?***




  




* **Curious** 
 : Here, your curiosity fuels innovation.
* **User\-Centric** 
 : You’ll anticipate the needs of all our stakeholders and exceed expectations.
* **Resourceful** 
 : You’ll creatively optimise our resources with solutions that elevate experiences in unexpected ways.
* **Aspire** 
 : Keep learning, keep growing—because we’re all about continuous improvement.
* **Trust** 
 : Trust is our foundation. You’ll work in a transparent, reliable, and fair environment.
* **Enjoy** 
 : We believe in having fun while building something extraordinary.



  





  





**StayVista Spirit: Our Behavioural Competencies – How We Work Together** 




  




* **Business Acumen:** 
 You know our services, business drivers, and industry trends inside out. You anticipate challenges in your area, weigh the impact of decisions, and track competitors to stay ahead, viewing risk as a chance to excel.
* **Change Management:** 
 You embrace change and actively look for opportunities to improve efficiency. You navigate ambiguity well, promote innovation within the team, and take ownership of implementing fresh ideas.

* **Teamwork:** 
 You actively seek input from others, work across departments, and leverage team diversity to drive success. By fostering an open environment, you encourage constructive criticism and share knowledge to achieve team goals.
* **Result Orientation:** 
 You set clear goals for yourself and your team, overcoming obstacles with a positive, solution\-focused mindset. You take ownership of outcomes and make informed decisions based on cost\-benefit analysis.

 You analyze information systematically, prioritize tasks, and delegate effectively. You optimize processes to drive efficiency and ensure compliance with organizational standards.

title: Manager - IT Office Operations
description:
Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond.


We partner with major global platforms such as Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Our B2B portfolio includes Precision, our specialist in travel fintech; Tripstack, our B2B Flights as a Service Provider and world leader in virtual interlining, serving as the gateway to Etraveli Group’s flight content and fulfillment services; Wenrix, the AI Infrastructure for profitable growth in air; and Flygresor.se, Sweden’s leading flight comparison site. We also operate our own online travel agency brands including Gotogate, Mytrip, and Flightnetwork.


Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 3200 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do.


Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay.


##### **The Role**


We're excited to be expanding our leadership team in India and are looking for an IT Manager to oversee our IT Office Operations across our Pune and Mumbai offices.


Reporting directly to the Senior Manager IT Office Operations (based in Gothenburg), you will lead and empower a dynamic team of 14 IT Engineers who are responsible for our global service desk, client security, user access management, and 24/7 on\-call support for Etraveli Group. The global ITOO team extends with an additional 12 IT Engineers in Sweden and Greece collaborating together on operations and continuous improvement.


As a people\-centric leader, you will balance line management with tactical execution, ensuring high service quality, operational efficiency, and a supportive team environment.


##### **Job Responsibility**


* **Line management for a team of 14 IT Engineers, handling yearly performance reviews cycle, driving personal development, and managing scheduling/rotas for global support and on\-call coverage.**
* Manage, prioritize, and monitor team workload and IT ticketing progress (Jira and JSM) to ensure timely resolution and high service standards across the global service desk.
* Serve as a key escalation path for complex IT issues, major incidents, and operational bottlenecks.
* Lead incident management, coordinating rapid response and mitigation when critical systems or operations are impacted.
* Oversee key functional domains within the team, including Client Security, User Access Management, and equipment lifecycle management.
* Manage local vendor relationships, service contracts, and IT asset procurement for the Pune and Mumbai offices.
* Continuously improve ways of working, operational routines, and technical documentation across global and local IT operations.
* Participate actively in global IT Office Operations meetings, different SME team meetings, and align local execution with global strategy.
* Ensure local office infrastructure (computers Win11, printers, meeting room AV/conferencing gear, mobile devices) is fully supported and operational.
* Coordination with the network and server infrastructure team for business continuity and uptime.
* Coordinate with the local operations team for the feedback, local/global deliveries and service improvements.

##### **Job Requirement**


* **8\-14 years of overall experience in IT Office Operations.**
* **Global experience preferred**
* **3\+ years of proven experience in line management/leadership roles within IT (mandatory).**
* Broad background in IT, ideally with significant experience in IT support or service desk management.
* Demonstrated experience tracking IT support metrics, managing ticketing workflows, and monitoring team progress.
* Strong business acumen to understand business impact and appropriately prioritize major incidents and problems.
* Solid conceptual understanding of IT server and network infrastructure principles (valuable).
* Fluent written and spoken English with excellent communication skills.

##### **Thorough On Boarding Process**


We are building a stellar onboarding adventure just for you, spanning your first 120 days, including access to learning resources, Q\&A sessions with our CEO and a buddy program.


##### **Competitive Benefits**


We pay fairly and align compensation with your role's impact on the company. Referral bonus, pension and insurances are also applicable, with some variations across our locations.


##### **Wellbeing \& Community**


In order to be the best version of you every day, you need an environment that provides for your wellbeing. From breakfast \& good coffee to start your day to healthcare, employee assistance plans and team bonding events we've got you covered!


##### **Opportunities for Development**


You will find extensive learning opportunities, team training and workshops connected to your role as well as guidance from renown leaders, all provided in a fast pace environment with flat hierarchies.


##### **Hybrid Work**


We want you to enjoy the best of all worlds and we know that doesn't always mean working at the office. We have a hybrid policy, including working from anywhere 2 weeks every year.


##### **Diversity disclaimer**


*At Etraveli Group we value diversity; we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds.* *During hiring, we are committed to ensure equality and promote diversity in the workplace at every selection stage. As such, we provide the same opportunities for all candidates regardless of race, religion or belief, gender, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic protected under any anti\-discrimination law or regulation.*

description:
Job Description

**Title:** Operations Manager – Clinics (Mumbai)  
**Reports to:** Cluster Manager  
**Direct reports:** Sr Ops – 1 per clinic × all clinics in Mumbai  
**Location:** Mumbai — field role, daily travel across clinic locations (own vehicle/two\-wheeler preferred; travel reimbursed)

About Pravaayu

Pravaayu is a Mumbai\-based specialty healthcare chain delivering non\-surgical, evidence\-based treatment for bone and joint pain, built on our proprietary CVRT® protocol (published in EJPMR). We're not a wellness or lifestyle\-Ayurveda brand — we run clinics with clinical rigor, measured outcomes (WOMAC, ROM, MMT), and an NPS of 91\.

Role Summary

This person owns day\-to\-day operational health across all Pravaayu clinics in Mumbai, managing the Sr Ops at each clinic and rolling up city\-level operational performance to the Cluster Manager. They are the layer between on\-ground execution (Sr Ops, clinic staff) and cluster\-level oversight — the person who ensures every clinic runs to protocol, every day, without needing the Cluster Manager to intervene on routine issues.

Key Responsibilities

**1\. Sr Ops Management \& Field Oversight**

* Direct management of Sr Ops (one per clinic) — daily check\-ins, weekly performance review, coaching against KRA/KPI framework
* Physical clinic visits on a fixed rotation across all 6 locations; unannounced spot\-checks in addition to scheduled visits
* Escalation point for any issue Sr Ops can't resolve at clinic level (staffing gaps, vendor failures, patient complaints, compliance flags)
* Own hiring/backfill TAT for Sr Ops role itself, in coordination with HR (Ritika)

**2\. Patient Experience Operations**

* Audit patient journey execution at each clinic (intake → consultation → therapy delivery → discharge) against CVRT® protocol and SOPs
* Own clinic\-level NPS and complaint resolution TAT; ensure Sr Ops are executing the patient experience standard consistently across all sites, not just the flagship clinic

**3\. Manpower Operations (via Sr Ops)**

* Ensure Sr Ops are maintaining attendance, roster adequacy, and shift coverage at each clinic
* Cross\-clinic staffing view — identify patterns (e.g., recurring gaps at one location) that a single Sr Ops might miss
* Backup staffing plan across clinics for leave clashes/attrition

**4\. Inventory, Equipment \& Facility Management**

* Consolidated stock and equipment\-uptime view across all clinics; hold Sr Ops accountable for zero stockouts and preventive maintenance adherence
* Vendor management for facility, equipment, and consumables at the city level — negotiate rates/SLAs centrally, Sr Ops execute locally
* Facility standard enforcement — clinics must read as premium/aspirational across all locations, not just where leadership visits most

**5\. Process, Compliance \& SOP Adherence**

* City\-wide compliance tracker (licenses, biomedical waste, fire safety, POSH, labour) — Sr Ops report status, Operations Manager owns zero\-lapse accountability
* Ensure Master Clinical Protocol (ICM: Assessment → Stratification → Intervention → Measurement → Iteration) documentation and outcome\-tracking discipline is uniform across all clinics
* Own and refine SOPs; when one clinic solves a problem well, institutionalize it across all via Sr Ops

**6\. Reporting to Cluster Manager**

* Own the daily/weekly city\-level ops dashboard (footfall, staffing, complaints, stockouts, compliance) across all clinics
* Weekly written report to Cluster Manager: RAG status per clinic, issues resolved at Operations Manager level, issues escalated upward, action plan

Success Metrics (First 6 Months)MetricTargetClinic NPS (across all)≥85, no single clinic below 80Stockout incidentsZeroStatutory compliance lapsesZeroSr Ops attrition\<10% in first 6 months (indicates coaching, not just enforcement)Weekly report to Cluster Manager100% on\-timeEquipment downtime resolution\<24 hrsRequirements

* 5–8 years in multi\-site operations management with **direct people management of location\-level managers/supervisors** — healthcare, diagnostics, wellness chains, retail, or QSR (healthcare/diagnostics preferred)
* Demonstrated experience managing a team of managers (not just individual contributors) across geographically spread sites
* Comfortable with heavy daily travel across Mumbai (own vehicle strongly preferred)
* Data\-literate — daily dashboard tracking across 6 sites simultaneously
* High ownership, low ego
* Bachelor's degree minimum; healthcare administration/operations background a plus

Nice\-to\-Have

* Prior experience in a specialty clinic chain, diagnostics chain (Metropolis/Thyrocare\-type), or physiotherapy/rehab network
* Exposure to NABH or clinical compliance frameworks
* Bilingual Hindi/Marathi/English

* Lead and facilitate performance management and career development processes with staff. Make decisions for staffing and provide training to staff.

description:
Job Opening: Production Manager – Protective Garments

**Industry:** Technical Textiles / PPE / Safety Garments / Protective Apparel Manufacturing  
**Department:** Production, Manufacturing \& Quality Coordination  
**Employment Type:** Full Time, Permanent  
**Role Category:** Production \& Manufacturing  
**Location:** Mumbai / Factory Location as Applicable  
**Experience:** 5\-6 years in garment, PPE, workwear, technical textile, or protective clothing manufacturing

Job Description

We are looking for an experienced **Production Manager** to manage end\-to\-end production of PPE, workwear, technical textile, or protective clothing manufacturing, manufactured as per applicable **International standards**. The candidate should have strong knowledge of garment production, technical textile handling, sewing operations, quality control, production planning, and compliance requirements for protective clothing used in industrial safety applications, preferably.

Key Responsibilities

· Lead complete production operations for protective garment components.

· Ensure manufacturing is carried out as per approved technical specifications, buyer requirements, production files, and applicable International standards for protective ensembles.

· Plan daily, weekly, and monthly production schedules based on order quantity, delivery timelines, machine capacity, manpower, and material availability.

· Coordinate with cutting, stitching, sealing, finishing, inspection, packing, stores, purchase, quality, and dispatch teams for smooth production flow.

· Monitor line efficiency, output, productivity, WIP, rejection levels, rework, and on\-time delivery performance.

· Ensure correct handling and usage of technical fabrics.

· Oversee critical operations such as layer matching, seam construction, reinforcement, attachment, closures, labelling, finishing, and final inspection.

· Maintain strict quality control at all production stages to meet safety, performance, and certification\-related requirements.

· Work closely with the Quality Assurance team for in\-line inspection, final inspection, testing coordination, documentation, and corrective action implementation.

· Identify production bottlenecks and implement recovery plans to meet delivery commitments.

· Train supervisors, line leaders, operators, and quality checkers on SOPs, workmanship standards, safety requirements, and product\-specific quality points.

· Maintain production reports, efficiency reports, rejection analysis, manpower planning, material consumption records, and order status updates.

· Ensure compliance with factory safety, housekeeping, 5S, and process discipline requirements.

· Support new product development, sampling, pilot runs, production trials, and bulk production approvals.

Team Management Responsibilities

· Lead, supervise, and motivate production supervisors, line leaders, operators, helpers, quality checkers, finishing staff, and packing teams.

title: Manager - IT Office Operations
description:
Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond.
   

  

 We partner with major global platforms such as Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Our B2B portfolio includes Precision, our specialist in travel fintech; Tripstack, our B2B Flights as a Service Provider and world leader in virtual interlining, serving as the gateway to Etraveli Group’s flight content and fulfillment services; Wenrix, the AI Infrastructure for profitable growth in air; and Flygresor.se, Sweden’s leading flight comparison site. We also operate our own online travel agency brands including Gotogate, Mytrip, and Flightnetwork.
   

  

 Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 3200 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do.
   

  

 Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay.
   

  

 The Role
   

  

 We're excited to be expanding our leadership team in India and are looking for an IT Manager to oversee our IT Office Operations across our Pune and Mumbai offices.
   

  

 Reporting directly to the Senior Manager IT Office Operations (based in Gothenburg), you will lead and empower a dynamic team of 14 IT Engineers who are responsible for our global service desk, client security, user access management, and 24/7 on\-call support for Etraveli Group. The global ITOO team extends with an additional 12 IT Engineers in Sweden and Greece collaborating together on operations and continuous improvement.
   

  

 As a people\-centric leader, you will balance line management with tactical execution, ensuring high service quality, operational efficiency, and a supportive team environment.
   

  

 Job Responsibility
   

  

* Line management for a team of 14 IT Engineers, handling yearly performance reviews cycle, driving personal development, and managing scheduling/rotas for global support and on\-call coverage.
* Manage, prioritize, and monitor team workload and IT ticketing progress (Jira and JSM) to ensure timely resolution and high service standards across the global service desk.
* Serve as a key escalation path for complex IT issues, major incidents, and operational bottlenecks.
* Lead incident management, coordinating rapid response and mitigation when critical systems or operations are impacted.
* Oversee key functional domains within the team, including Client Security, User Access Management, and equipment lifecycle management.
* Manage local vendor relationships, service contracts, and IT asset procurement for the Pune and Mumbai offices.
* Continuously improve ways of working, operational routines, and technical documentation across global and local IT operations.
* Participate actively in global IT Office Operations meetings, different SME team meetings, and align local execution with global strategy.
* Ensure local office infrastructure (computers Win11, printers, meeting room AV/conferencing gear, mobile devices) is fully supported and operational.
* Coordination with the network and server infrastructure team for business continuity and uptime.
* Coordinate with the local operations team for the feedback, local/global deliveries and service improvements.


 Job Requirement
   

  

* 8\-14 years of overall experience in IT Office Operations.
* Global experience preferred
* 3\+ years of proven experience in line management/leadership roles within IT (mandatory).
* Broad background in IT, ideally with significant experience in IT support or service desk management.
* Demonstrated experience tracking IT support metrics, managing ticketing workflows, and monitoring team progress.
* Strong business acumen to understand business impact and appropriately prioritize major incidents and problems.
* Solid conceptual understanding of IT server and network infrastructure principles (valuable).
* Fluent written and spoken English with excellent communication skills.


 Thorough On Boarding Process
   

  

 We are building a stellar onboarding adventure just for you, spanning your first 120 days, including access to learning resources, Q\&A sessions with our CEO and a buddy program.
   

  

 Competitive Benefits
   

  

 We pay fairly and align compensation with your role's impact on the company. Referral bonus, pension and insurances are also applicable, with some variations across our locations.
   

  

 Wellbeing \& Community
   

  

 In order to be the best version of you every day, you need an environment that provides for your wellbeing. From breakfast \& good coffee to start your day to healthcare, employee assistance plans and team bonding events we've got you covered!
   

  

 Opportunities for Development
   

  

 You will find extensive learning opportunities, team training and workshops connected to your role as well as guidance from renown leaders, all provided in a fast pace environment with flat hierarchies.
   

  

 Hybrid Work
   

  

 We want you to enjoy the best of all worlds and we know that doesn't always mean working at the office. We have a hybrid policy, including working from anywhere 2 weeks every year.
   

  

 Diversity disclaimer
   

  

*At Etraveli Group we value diversity; we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds.* 
*During hiring, we are committed to ensure equality and promote diversity in the workplace at every selection stage. As such, we provide the same opportunities for all candidates regardless of race, religion or belief, gender, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic protected under any anti\-discrimination law or regulation.*

 .

**Thought Leadership, External Representation \& Knowledge Sharing** 



* Represent Dharma Life in relevant education, technology, skilling and social\-sector forums. Provide thought leadership on technology\-enabled learning, responsible AI and programme innovation. Share programme evidence and learnings, strengthen sector visibility, and build relationships with government, funders, technology partners, academic institutions and networks.



  





**B. Learning Quality, Pedagogy \& Workforce Capability** 




 Own national standards for teaching, training and learning quality, ensuring that technology strengthens—not replaces—effective human facilitation.
 



**Teaching \& Training Standards** 



* Establish national teaching and training standards across LUYM, BSBC and JAYA, covering lesson preparation, facilitation, learner engagement, assessment and digital tools. Promote inclusive, learner\-centric blended learning, supported by classroom observation, quality assessment, coaching and continuous improvement mechanisms.

 to teachers and trainers across states for pedagogy, standards, quality and safeguarding.

* What are they learning? Where are learners dropping out?
* Which interventions are producing results?

* Use data to identify learning gaps, programme bottlenecks and opportunities for improvement.

**Leadership \& Board Reporting** 



* Consolidate national programme and impact information for senior leadership and Board reporting.
* Ensure that reporting moves beyond activity metrics towards outcomes, impact and evidence of effectiveness.

 Ensure that Dharmalife's use of technology and AI is safe, ethical, inclusive, responsible and compliant.
 



**AI in Education** 



* Own the responsible adoption of AI across LUYM, Quest, Preschool, Roshni AI and JAYA. Develop an organisational framework for responsible AI in education and skilling.
* Identify appropriate AI use cases such as:
* Personalised learning ; AI\-assisted tutoring ; Content creation
* Teacher support ; Assessment and feedback; Translation and localisation
* Learning analytics
* Establish human oversight for AI\-enabled learner interactions.
* Define guardrails for AI\-generated educational content and learner\-facing applications.
* Monitor risks relating to bias, inaccurate information, inappropriate content, exclusion and learner profiling.



**Safeguarding** 



* Own safeguarding standards for the teaching and training workforce and technology\-enabled learning environments. Design, mandate and monitor safeguarding training, including
 **POCSO and POSH** 
 , as applicable.
* Ensure safe and appropriate interactions between learners and teachers/trainers across online and offline environments. Establish clear reporting, escalation and response mechanisms for safeguarding concerns.



**Data Protection \& Privacy** 



* Establish practices for secure collection, storage, access, use, sharing and retention of learner data, including appropriate consent for minors.
* Implement role\-based access and data\-sharing protocols, and ensure partners comply with Dharmalife’s applicable data\-protection, privacy and safeguarding requirements.



  





**Cross\-Functional Work Coordination** 




 The role will operate across functions and will be expected to connect
 **technology, pedagogy, programme implementation, data and field realities** 
 .
 



 The Lead Manager will:
 


* Work closely with State Managers to align technology, staffing, training, devices, connectivity and content requirements.
* Work with the Deputy Manager – Content, Communication \& Skilling to align curriculum, content, communication and skilling priorities.
* Coordinate with teaching and training teams to ensure consistent standards nationally. Work with technology/product partners on platform development and issue resolution.
* Collaborate with programme and impact teams to connect programme implementation with learning outcomes.
* Provide regular updates to the Chief of Staff and senior leadership.



  





**Qualifications and Experience** 



* Postgraduate degree in Education, Educational Technology, Technology, Management, Social Sector Management, Public Policy or a related field.
* 8–12 years of progressive experience in education, EdTech, digital learning, technology\-enabled programme delivery or social\-sector transformation.
* Demonstrated experience leading technology\-enabled education or skilling programmes at scale.
* Experience managing geographically distributed or multi\-state teams.
* Experience translating educational/programme requirements into technology or product solutions.
* Strong understanding of pedagogy, learning outcomes, and digital learning models.
* Experience with programme data, dashboards, analytics and impact measurement.
* Experience working with government departments, schools or institutional stakeholders.
* Working knowledge of child safeguarding, including POCSO and POSH.

title: Administrative Manager
description:
**About the company:** 




 BDO is a global network of professional services firms with a presence in over 166 countries, revenue of over USD 14 billion, and experience of over 60 years. Its a leading service provider for the mid\-markets with client service at its heart.
 



  





 BDO India Services Private Limited (or BDO India) is the India member firm of BDO International. BDO India offers strategic, operational, accounting and tax, and regulatory advisory \& assistance for both domestic and international organizations across a range of industries. BDO India is led by more than 300\+ Partners \& Directors with a team of over 10,000 professionals operating across 14 cities and 20 offices. We expect to grow sizably in the coming 3\-5 years, adding various dimensions to our business and multiplying and increasing the current team size multi\-fold.
 



  





**Role Overview:** 




 The Manager – Administration will oversee workplace and facility operations to ensure a safe, efficient, compliant, and employee\-friendly office environment. The role will be responsible for office administration, facilities management, vendor governance, workplace services, security, maintenance, compliance, and employee support functions.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Workplace \& Facilities Management** 



* Manage day\-to\-day administration of office facilities, including workstations, cabins, meeting rooms, and common areas.
* Ensure optimal space utilization and workplace readiness.



  





**Employee Support \& Workplace Experience** 



* Coordinate onboarding and exit processes, including workspace setup and clearance activities.
* Partner with HR to enhance employee experience and support engagement initiatives.



  





**Events \& Employee Engagement** 



* Plan and execute townhalls, leadership meetings, employee engagement programs, and corporate events.



  





**Vendor \& Contract Staff Management** 



* Manage outsourced staff and facility vendors, ensuring service quality, productivity, and SLA compliance.
* Oversee housekeeping, pantry, security, pest control, and other soft services.



  





**Cafeteria Operations** 



* Manage canteen operations, hygiene standards, vendor performance, and employee feedback mechanisms.



  





**Compliance \& Regulatory Management** 



* Ensure adherence to statutory, administrative, and organizational compliance requirements.
* Coordinate with local authorities and regulatory bodies for approvals, inspections, and audits.



  





**Budgeting, Billing \& MIS** 



* Manage vendor billing, budget tracking, invoice verification, and administrative cost control.
* Prepare MIS reports, dashboards, and management reviews.



  





**Safety, Security \& Maintenance** 



* Oversee fire safety systems, emergency preparedness, mock drills, and statutory compliance.
* Manage physical security, access control, CCTV monitoring, and visitor management.
* Monitor preventive maintenance schedules and ensure timely resolution of facility\-related issues.



  





**Inventory \& Asset Management** 



* Maintain office assets, consumables, and inventory.
* Conduct periodic audits and ensure optimal stock availability.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 



* Graduate/Postgraduate in Administration, Facilities Management, Hospitality, Operations, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in Administration, Facilities Management, Workplace Operations, Corporate Services, or Office Management.
* Strong experience in facility operations, vendor management, office administration, and employee support services.
* Exposure to security, maintenance, compliance, and contract staff management preferred.
* Experience managing corporate office environments and multiple vendors will be an advantage.

title: Procurement Manager, CMO APAC
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose\-driven, world\-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
   

  

 Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
   

  

 Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance\-focused culture.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Procurement Manager, CMO APAC, is part of the Global Procurement organization and will be responsible for managing CMOs for South Asia OU. This critical role requires proven experience in people leadership, business partnership, developing strong external relationships, navigation through organizational complexity, handling escalation and associated business impact.
   

  

* Responsible for managing Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) for supply of our marketed products and future innovations.
* Accountable for creating and implementing Procurement strategies and initiatives which improve quality and service/ supply risk and deliver significant cost savings to the business unit
* Build relationships with CMO operations team, regional \& global direct procurement teams to drive synergies and support delivery of cost management targets.
* Collaborate with CMOs to deliver ambitions of cost, service, quality, lead time, working capital and innovation through robust supplier performance management programs.
* Collaborate and align with other Procurement leaders and teams within the region and/or globally to understand and adopt best practices
* Strategically engage with and understand the business requirements of stakeholders and business partners and to position the Procurement value proposition
* Build and implement robust risk management framework to ensure business continuity and ensuring seamless communication process between the business and CMO Team.
* Ensure Haleon Procurement policies, procedures, processes, systems and methodologies are utilized in a compliant manner in the area of responsibility


**Key Responsibilities:**
* Develop and implement effective ways of working across BU, Directs, Cross\-BU and cross functional team
* Develop a cost management strategy and be accountable for delivery of agreed cost reduction programs and associated targets. Accountable to develop medium to long term value pipeline for cost reduction through various value streams e.g. Value engineering, alternate sourcing, automation, capital restructuring etc.
* Deploy negotiation strategy standards across CMOs and Direct material suppliers by building a strong “should\-cost” foundation.
* Plan \& implement a robust and agile sourcing strategy to effectively support product innovation
* Be accountable for developing and implementing strategies for advancing supply relationships with CMOs \& material’s suppliers that address the ambitions for cost, service, quality, lead time, working capital and innovation.
* Support annual planning process with robust market insights to support budgeting principles leveraged for plan development
* Negotiate, create, execute and manage effective contracts with CMOs and suppliers that will allow Haleon to maximize opportunity.


**External supplier relationships:**
* Develop and Implement Operational excellence strategies and plans for KPI improvement for CMOs \& Direct material suppliers
* Build strategic relationships with CMOs \& suppliers at a senior level and lead processes to ensure value is driven from these relationships.
* Implement a robust supplier account management structure and regular performance assessment for superior supplier performance


**Supply chain \& risk management:**
* Transform the supply chain to release value and make Haleon more responsive to business and customer needs – for example in cost control, complexity reduction, simplification, automation, best practice procurement and KPI’s.
* Identify and manage significant risks in the supply chain. Ensure appropriate mitigation plans are in place and in use and that the risks are communicated appropriately within business units impacted


**Qualifications \& Skills:**
**Essential:**
* Preferred Level of Education: Master’s Degree/ MBA
* 10\+ years of Procurement experience preferably in Directs \& CMO space
* Area of Specialization: Procurement/Contract Manufacturing/ Supply Chain/ Engineering/ Science/ Business/ Finance


**Preferred:**
* Deep expertise in CMO procurement with well\-rounded exposure to direct materials procurement, including raw materials and packaging, to support end\-to\-end supply chain decision\-making.
* Excellent knowledge of Procurement tools such as sourcing, RFQ, RFIs, Contract negotiation, supplier review, supplier development and others
* Proven track record of strong cost reduction programs \& experience of supplier performance and relationship management across complex supply chains
* Demonstrated leadership and ability to work in partnership with others to drive, implement and support change
* Experience in Implementing new product launches and the integration of new businesses and business models.
* Demonstrated Procurement experience operating in a cGMP OTC and FMCG environment. Sourcing strategy and Procurement skills including supplier relationship management, supplier development, continuous improvement, negotiation, and the ability to understand and implement complex contractual arrangements preferred.
* Strong interpersonal skills and ability to influence a complex and diverse matrix of stakeholders and peers across regional and category teams.
* Knowledge of Risk analysis and option analysis tools and techniques.

 2026\-10\-07

 Opportunities to work with EY Risk \-Internal Audit practices global with leading businesses across a range of industries

Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:

 The illustrious Hero Group, boasting a diverse portfolio of businesses with a combined value of US$5 billion, spans sectors such as automotive manufacturing, finance, renewable energy, electronics manufacturing, and education. Under the umbrella of the Hero Group (BML Munjalfamily), you'll find renowned names like Hero MotoCorp, Hero FinCorp, Hero Future Energies, Rockman Industries, Hero Electronix, Hero Mindmine, and BML Munjal University.
 



  





**Job Title:**

 Gurugram Sector 42
 



**Job Type:** 
 Full Time
 



**Work Type:** 
 Work from Office
 



**Department:** 
 Revenue \& Operations
 



**Experience Level:** 
 6 to 10 Years
 



  





**Role Summary**




 We are seeking a commercially sharp and operationally excellent
 **RevOps Lead** 
 to own and drive Hero Vired's revenue performance and operational rigour. The role comes with direct management responsibility over a team of Revenue Managers and the Operations function. The RevOps Lead will serve as the connective tissue between revenue strategy and day\-to\-day execution — designing the systems, metrics, and processes that ensure the business performs predictably and at scale.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**




**Operational Excellence \& Process Design** 




 Driving operational excellence is the core mandate of this role. You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and continuously improving the processes and systems that underpin revenue generation and business performance. This includes building robust standard operating procedures for revenue reporting, pipeline management, CRM hygiene, and cross\-functional workflows.
 



  





**KPI Design, Tracking\& Delivery** 




 You will own the design and governance of the KPI framework for the revenue and operations functions. This involves definingthe right metricsfor each team and businessunit, building the infrastructure to track them in real time, and holding teams accountable for delivery against targets. You will conduct regular performance reviews, diagnose underperformance, and work with team leads to implement corrective actions
 



  





**Data Analytics \& Insights** 




 Data is at the heart of how this role operates. You will leverage advanced data analytics to generate deep, actionable insights into revenue performance, operational efficiency, and business health. This requires hands\-on proficiency in SQL and Python to build models, automate reportingpipelines, and conductboth descriptive and predictive analyses. You will design and maintain dashboards that give the leadership team a clear, real\-time view of the business, and will proactively surface insights that drive better decisions. Your analytical outputs will set the standard for data\-driven decision\-making across the organization.
 



  





**Team Leadership — Revenue Managers** 




 You will directly lead and develop a team of Revenue Managers, setting clear performance goals, providing regular coaching and feedback, and building a culture of analytical rigour andcommercial accountability. You will ensurethat the revenueteam operates as a cohesive unit with well\-defined ownership and robust processes. You will identify capability gaps within the team and invest in their professional development, building a strong and capable revenue function that can scale with the business.
 



  





**Team Leadership — Operations** 




 You will hold direct leadership responsibility over the Operations team, overseeing the systems, processes, and workflows that underpin revenue generation and business performance. This includes managing sales operations, CRM hygiene, revenue reporting infrastructure, and the tooling and processes that enable the revenue team to perform at its best. You will set operational KPIs, monitor team performance, and drive continuous process improvement to ensure that the revenue engine runs with efficiency and precision.
 



  





**Revenue \& Operations Integration** 




 You will integrate revenue and operations thinking into a unified, end\-to\-end view of the business. This means identifying and resolving gaps at the intersection of sales, revenue,and operations — ensuring that commercial momentum is never lost due to process or tooling failures. You will design integrated workflows that connect revenue targets with operational capacity, and build the feedback loops that allow the organization to course\-correct quickly and effectively.
 



  





**Revenue Strategy \& P\&L Oversight** 




 You will contribute to the development and execution of Hero Vired's revenue strategy, working closely with the business leadership to set targets, evaluate pricing and monetization approaches, and identifygrowth opportunities. You will maintaina working understanding of the revenue P\&L, track performance against targets, and flag material variances with supporting analysis. While P\&L ownership is shared with the broader leadership team, your data\-driven perspective will be an important input into commercial decision\-making.
 



  





**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**




 You will work closely with sales, marketing, product, finance, and university partnerships to align teams around shared revenue and operational goals. You will partner with sales leadership on incentive structures and pipeline management, collaborate with marketing on acquisition metrics, and work with the product team to ensure that tooling and systems support operational needs. Your ability to build strong working relationships and drive alignment across functions will be critical to translating strategy into execution.
 



  





**Qualifications and Skills**




**Experience \& Education**



* Candidates should have 6\-10 years of progressive experience in revenueoperations, business operations, strategy, or analytics, with a demonstrated track record of leading teams and driving measurable business outcomes.
* Prior experience managing a combined revenue and operations function is strongly preferred. Experience in the EdTech, SaaS, or consumer internet industry is a significant advantage.
* A Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Engineering, or a related field is required. An MBA is preferred.



  





**Core Competencies:**




**Operational Excellence:** 
 Deep expertise in process design,workflow optimization, and operational governance. A track record of building scalable, high\-quality operational systems in a fast\-paced environment.
 



**Data Proficiency:** 
 Proficiency in SQL and Excel for data analysis, modeling, and automation. Ability to build complexanalytical models and reporting infrastructure from the ground up.
 



**KPI Design\& Performance Management:** 
 Proven ability to design meaningful KPI frameworks, build the infrastructure to track them, and drive consistent delivery across teams. Experience conducting structured performance reviews and implementing data\-backed corrective actions.
 



**People Leadership:** 
 Proven ability to lead, develop, and inspire multi\-functional teams. Experience managingmanagers and buildinghigh\-performing teams in a high\-growth environment.
 



**Commercial Acumen:** 
 Solid understanding of revenue strategy, pricing, and P\&L dynamics. Ability to connect operational decisions to commercial outcomes.
 



**Stakeholder Management:** 
 Strong ability to build relationships with and influence stakeholders across functions. Clear and confident communicator who can present complex analytical findings to diverse audiences.
 



**Problem\-Solving \& Structured Thinking:** 
 Ability to break down ambiguous, complex problems into structured frameworks and develop practical, data\-backed solutions. Comfortable operating in conditions of uncertainty and rapid change

It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance\-focused culture.
   

  

**Location: Indore**
**About The Role**
 The Shift Leader \- Process Area is accountable for safe, compliant and efficient manufacturing execution during the assigned shift and provides frontline leadership to Process Technician Associates and other Process team members.
   

  

 The role leads daily production delivery, GMP and EHS compliance, process control, shift coordination, people deployment, capability building and performance improvement within the Process area.
   

  

 The incumbent partners with Packaging, Quality, Maintenance, Engineering, Warehouse and HAPS teams to deliver right\-first\-time production, reliable supply and effective resolution of operational issues.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead Process operations during the assigned shift and deliver the approved production plan against Safety, Quality, Service, Cost and People objectives.
* Allocate people and resources, confirm shift readiness and ensure raw materials, equipment, documentation and utilities are available for production.
* Ensure start\-up, shutdown, product changeover, cleaning, sanitization and process execution are completed in accordance with SOPs, batch instructions and validated parameters.
* Monitor critical process parameters, cycle performance, yield, waste, equipment condition and schedule adherence, and take timely action on abnormalities.
* Ensure accurate completion and review of batch manufacturing records, cleaning records, equipment logs, electronic entries and shift documentation.
* Lead immediate containment and escalation of safety events, process deviations, quality risks, equipment failures and material issues.
* Support investigations, root\-cause analysis, CAPA, change controls, risk assessments and verification of sustainable corrective actions.
* Lead structured shift handovers and Daily Direction Setting, maintaining clear priorities, escalation, action ownership and performance visibility.
* Coach, train and qualify Process Technician Associates, provide performance feedback and support multi\-skilling and succession development.
* Partner with Maintenance and Engineering on breakdown response, preventive maintenance, basic equipment care and restoration of equipment base condition.
* Support commissioning, qualification, validation, engineering trials, technology transfer and operational\-readiness activities.
* Drive HAPS, 5S, visual management, loss elimination, waste reduction and continuous improvement within the Process area.
* Maintain the Process area in a safe, compliant, orderly and inspection\-ready condition and support internal and external audits


**Qualification And Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in electrical/mechanical engineering or a closely related engineering discipline from a reputed institution preferably IIT/NIT etc.
* Relevant training in GMP, process operations, safety, Lean or frontline leadership is desirable.
* 6\-10 years of manufacturing or process\-operations experience, including 2\-3 years leading shop\-floor teams or shifts.
* Experience in FMCG, consumer healthcare, pharmaceuticals, food or another regulated manufacturing environment is preferred.
* Exposure to greenfield commissioning, qualification, validation or manufacturing start\-up is desirable.


**Technical Skills**
* Process manufacturing operations, equipment and material flow.
* GMP, batch documentation, data integrity, cleaning and in\-process control.
* Production planning, shift execution, process parameters, yield and schedule adherence.
* First\-line troubleshooting, root\-cause analysis and CAPA support.
* DDS/DMS, HAPS, 5S, visual management and continuous improvement.
* Working knowledge of SAP, MES, SCADA, Power BI or related manufacturing systems is desirable.


**Leadership Skills**
* Frontline leadership, coaching and capability development.
* Clear decision\-making and escalation under operational pressure.
* Strong communication and effective shift handover.
* Collaboration across Operations, Quality, Maintenance and Engineering.
* Ownership, accountability and a strong safety and compliance mindset.
* Fair people deployment, constructive feedback and respectful conflict resolution.


**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
* Safety \& Compliance \- Safe shift execution, GMP adherence, training compliance and timely closure of assigned actions.
* Quality \- Right\-first\-time performance (RFT), documentation accuracy, process adherence and deviation reduction and defect reductions.
* Service \& Productivity \- Production\-plan attainment, schedule adherence, cycle performance, yield, waste and labour productivity.
* Reliability \- Effective breakdown response, equipment\-care compliance and reduction of recurring process losses. Plant maintenance compliances and autonomous maintenance Compliance.
* People \& HAPS \- Role qualification, multi\-skilling, engagement, DDS effectiveness and delivery of improvement actions.
* Effective CAPA closer and conducting root cause analysis and problem solving.
* Cost Management, Productivity, and overtime cost savings through continues improvements. Waste, Scrap and rework reduction.

 2026\-09\-30

It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. title: Logistic Team Lead
description:
**About Dermatouch:\-** 




  





 Dermatouch is a fast\-growing D2C skincare brand focused on delivering science\-backed, dermatologist\-inspired skincare solutions. With a growing presence across
 **D2C, marketplaces, and offline retail** 
 , Dermatouch operates in a dynamic, high\-volume environment where efficient supply chain and logistics are critical to business growth.
 



 As our logistics operations scale, we are looking for a
 **Logistics Lead** 
 who can build efficient processes, optimize inventory movement, manage 3PL and warehouse operations, and ensure seamless order fulfillment across channels.
 



  





**Job Description :\-** 




**Role Overview** 




 The
 **Logistics Lead** 
 will oversee the end\-to\-end logistics, supply chain, and inventory operations for Dermatouch. This role involves managing warehouse activities, coordinating with third\-party logistics (3PL) partners, optimizing inventory flow, and ensuring timely delivery to customers and retail partners. The ideal candidate is analytical, organized, and has strong leadership and vendor management skills.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Manage and oversee daily logistics operations, including inbound and outbound shipments.
* Coordinate with warehouse teams, distributors, and courier partners to ensure timely order fulfillment.
* Monitor and optimize inventory levels across channels (D2C, marketplaces, retail).
* Ensure smooth coordination with production and procurement teams for stock planning.
* Evaluate and onboard 3PL partners; negotiate contracts and service\-level agreements (SLAs).
* Track logistics KPIs (TAT, damages, delivery accuracy, etc.) and report performance to management.
* Implement cost\-saving strategies while maintaining service quality.
* Ensure compliance with GST, e\-way bills, and other logistics documentation.
* Manage reverse logistics and return processes effectively.
* Maintain accurate inventory and shipment records in ERP systems.



  





**Requirements** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, or related field (MBA preferred).
* 4\-5 years of experience in logistics/supply chain management, preferably in FMCG, cosmetics, or e\-commerce.

title: BIM Lead / VP – Production
description:
BIM Lead / VP – Production
 



  





**Location:** 
 Ahmedabad, Gujarat — 100% In\-Office (Candidates from anywhere in India welcome to apply; relocation to Ahmedabad required)
 **Experience:** 
 8\+ Years (Multi\-Discipline BIM Production \& Team Leadership)
 **Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time \| Minimum 2\.5\-Year Service Commitment (Employment Bond \+ Strict NDA applicable)
 **Reports To:** 
 Founder / CEO
 



  





 About Us
 



  





**BIM Expert Studio** 
 is a fast\-growing BIM and CAD outsourcing company based in Ahmedabad, India, delivering Architecture, Structural, MEPF, and Scan\-to\-BIM production services to Architecture, Engineering \& Construction (AEC) firms, building surveyors, and MEPF/General Contractors across the United States. We work across multiple project types and disciplines with a production team built to scale.
 



 We're looking for a hands\-on BIM Lead / VP – Production to own end\-to\-end technical delivery, build and lead our modeling team, and become the technical backbone of the company as we scale production capacity.
 



  





 Role Summary
 



  





 This is a senior, hands\-on leadership role — not a purely managerial one. You will be the final technical authority across every discipline we serve (Architecture, Structural, MEPF, Scan\-to\-BIM), responsible for making sure any project that comes in from a US client — regardless of discipline or project type — can be delivered correctly, on time, and to US AEC documentation standards. You will also build out the production bench itself: hiring, training, and developing modelers and drafters as the team scales.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  




1. Own end\-to\-end technical delivery across all disciplines — Architecture, Structural, MEPF, and Scan\-to\-BIM — for every incoming client project, regardless of discipline or project type.
2. Review incoming project scopes from US clients and determine discipline, LOD, staffing, and timeline requirements.
3. Set up and enforce BIM Execution Plans (BEPs), modeling standards, and QA/QC checkpoints for every project.
4. Directly model, troubleshoot, or unblock any discipline when the team hits a technical wall — you should be able to open any file and solve the problem yourself.
5. Hire, onboard, and train BIM modelers and drafters across disciplines as the team scales; build internal training/SOP material for new hires.
6. Allocate resources and manage capacity planning across multiple concurrent projects and deadlines.
7. Run multi\-discipline coordination and clash detection reviews before deliverables go out.
8. Act as the primary technical point of contact for US clients on project\-specific queries, scope clarifications, and escalations.
9. Standardize templates, families, and content libraries across disciplines to improve production speed and consistency.
10. Mentor and develop team leads under you so the production team can eventually run with less day\-to\-day involvement from you.
11. Track and report production KPIs (turnaround time, rework rate, capacity utilization) to leadership.
12. Maintain strict confidentiality of client data, drawings, and business information at all times.



  





 Technical Skills Required
 



  





 1\. Architectural BIM
 



  




1. Full concept\-to\-Construction Documents (CD) production: floor plans, elevations, sections, RCPs, schedules, and detailing
2. Experience across multiple project types — residential (multi\-family/single\-family), commercial, hospitality, healthcare, education, and industrial
3. Revit family creation and library management across LOD 100–500
4. Working knowledge of US code frameworks (IBC, ADA) as they apply to documentation accuracy
5. Renovation, addition, and adaptive\-reuse modeling from existing/as\-built conditions
6. Interior architecture and tenant improvement (TI) documentation



  





 2\. Structural BIM
 



  




1. Steel, concrete, wood\-frame, and light\-gauge structural modeling
2. Rebar detailing and structural shop drawing coordination
3. Framing plans, connections, and structural detailing
4. Translating structural engineers' design intent and calculations into accurate models
5. Foundation, podium, and structural steel detailing
6. Structural clash resolution against architectural and MEPF models



  





 3\. MEPF (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, Fire Protection)
 



  




1. HVAC ductwork, piping, and equipment modeling
2. Electrical power, lighting, low\-voltage systems, and panel schedule modeling
3. Plumbing supply, waste, and vent system modeling
4. Fire protection and sprinkler system layout and modeling
5. Multi\-system MEPF coordination for clash\-free installation
6. Spool and fabrication drawing generation to support prefabrication workflows



  





 4\. Scan\-to\-BIM / Reality Capture
 



  




1. Point cloud registration and cleanup (Recap, Cyclone, or equivalent)
2. As\-built modeling directly from point cloud/laser scan data
3. Existing conditions documentation for renovation and retrofit projects
4. Accuracy validation and QA of scan\-derived models against source data
5. Integrating scan\-based models into ongoing design/coordination workflows



  





 5\. Software \& Platform Proficiency
 



  




1. Autodesk Revit (Architecture, Structure, MEP)
2. AutoCAD / AutoCAD MEP
3. Navisworks Manage (clash detection and 4D sequencing)
4. Autodesk Recap / Recap Pro (point cloud processing)
5. BIM 360 / Autodesk Construction Cloud
6. Civil 3D (added advantage)
7. Dynamo or other BIM automation/scripting tools (added advantage)
8. MS Project and Excel for scheduling and resource tracking



  





 6\. Standards, Process \& Coordination
 



  




1. BIM Execution Plan (BEP) development and enforcement
2. LOD (Level of Development) specification, assignment, and QA
3. Familiarity with US AEC documentation standards (AIA/NCS conventions)
4. Working exposure to ISO 19650 principles
5. Multi\-discipline clash detection and resolution workflows
6. Standardizing templates and content libraries across projects and disciplines



  





 7\. Leadership \& Team Management
 



  




1. Hiring, onboarding, and training BIM modelers and drafters
2. Resource allocation and capacity planning across concurrent projects
3. Production quality control and deadline/SLA management
4. Direct client\-facing communication with US\-based AEC clients
5. Mentoring team leads and building internal training material/SOPs
6. Managing any vendor or subcontracted production resources, if applicable



  





 Requirements
 



  




* Minimum 8 years of hands\-on BIM/CAD production experience, with demonstrated exposure across
 **at least three** 
 of the four core disciplines (Architecture, Structural, MEPF, Scan\-to\-BIM)
* Prior experience leading or building a production team (hiring, training, and managing modelers/drafters)
* Experience working with or delivering to US\-based AEC clients strongly preferred
* Strong written and verbal English communication for direct client interaction
* Based in or willing to relocate to Ahmedabad for a 100% in\-office role
* Willing to commit to a minimum 2\.5\-year tenure, backed by an employment bond and a strict NDA (given direct exposure to client data and production processes)



  





 What We Offer
 



  




* A senior leadership role shaping production strategy at a company built for scale
* Direct, ongoing exposure to the US AEC market across a wide range of disciplines and project types
* Competitive fixed compensation plus performance\-linked incentives
* A clear growth path into senior/company leadership as the team and client base expand
