title: Merchandise Manager
description:
**Company Description** 




 Toram Creators Private Limited is a knitwear and apparel manufacturer based in Tirupur, Tamil Nadu. Founded in 2003, we operate across multiple production units with end\-to\-end capabilities spanning product development, sampling, quality control, and finishing.
 



 We serve a strong portfolio of domestic retail and export brands — including Walmart, GAP, and Fruit of the Loom — delivering across inner garments, knitwear, and lifestyle apparel. Our facilities are certified for SEDEX, BCI, and Disney FAMA.
 



 We are in an active phase of organisational growth — building systems, strengthening our team, and investing in the people and processes that will define the next chapter of Toram. This role is part of that build.
 



  





  





**Role Description** 




 We are looking for a Merchandising Manager to own the day\-to\-day execution of our brand accounts and lead our merchandising team.
 



 Toram currently runs three active brand accounts, each managed by a senior merchandiser. This role exists to sit above that team — to see across all three accounts simultaneously, hold the merchandisers accountable to TNA and quality standards, own buyer communication at the execution level, and ensure that nothing falls through the gap between an order landing and a shipment going out.
 



 Our Managing Director owns the strategic buyer relationship — new orders, quarterly reviews, and account\-level commercial decisions. You own everything in between. The daily and weekly execution rhythm that determines whether buyers stay, grow, and reorder is your accountability.
 



*If you are someone who has spent years in merchandising and has now moved — or is ready to move — from doing the work to managing the function, this role was built for you.* 




  





  





**Experience** 




 ● 8–12 years in garment or knitwear merchandising, with at least 3 years in a senior or managerial role managing a team and multiple accounts simultaneously.
 



 ● Direct experience with domestic retail brand accounts — Westside, Zudio, Max, Myntra, Clovia, DaMensch, or comparable. You understand how domestic retail buyers operate, what their timelines look like, and how their teams are structured.
 



 ● Strong TNA management — you have built TNA calendars, tracked them across concurrent orders, and held your team accountable against them. You know what a missed milestone costs.
 



 ● ERP comfort — you are used to working within a system and understand that what is not in the system does not exist.
 



  





**The kind of person we are looking for** 




 ● You manage the function, not just the accounts. You are not the person chasing fabric or writing every buyer email — you are the person who ensures your team does those things correctly and on time.
 



 ● You communicate clearly and do not leave room for misunderstanding — with buyers, with the factory, and with your team. You know when to call versus email, and your emails can be forwarded without editing.
 



 ● You are comfortable holding difficult buyer conversations — delivering bad news, managing a delay, proposing a solution — without escalating to your manager first.
 



 ● You are disciplined about documentation. If you left tomorrow, your team could pick up your accounts from what is in the system.
 



 ● You are based in Tirupur or genuinely willing to relocate. This is an on\-site role.
 



  





**What We Offer** 




 ● A direct reporting line to the Managing Director — not a VP layer above you. Your decisions matter and your inputs are heard.
 



 ● Three active brand accounts already running, a merchandising team already in place, and a clear mandate to improve how the function performs — you are not starting from zero.
 



 ● A company genuinely in growth mode — new buyers, new product categories, improving systems — and a role that will grow with it.
 



 ● Competitive compensation discussed at interview. We are serious about this hire and will pay accordingly.

 Making visions come true
   

  

 You’ll develop big ideas that will spark the effective management and successful execution of all phases of a project—from initiating, designing, planning, controlling, executing, monitoring, and closing. You’ll need to carefully identify and take note of our clients’ needs, and figure out what exactly needs to be done. This involves defining the scope of the work and expected outcome, while also detailing all the necessary objectives to get there.
   

  

 While you do all of these, you’ll need to keep tabs on company resources used in the projects, and to allocate these resources to complete the project within the budget. You’ll also need to help clients organize and analyze all tender and procurement for all contractors and suppliers; and represent them from the beginning to the end of a project.
   

  

 Building strong teams and business reputation
   

  

 One of your priorities will be to produce high\-performing teams that drive successful project execution. You’ll also represent and promote the company throughout projects and in pursuit of more project opportunities.
   

  

 Keeping risks at bay
   

  

 How do you deal with risks? You’ll need to identify any potential risks in the MEP/CIVIL field and report them to the Project Manager. It will be critical to design a risk management and solution provision, particularly to identify health \& safety issues. You will understand why this is your responsibility.
   

  

**Sound like you? To apply you need to be:**
 An MEP/CIVIL pro
   

  

 You have a degree in MEP/CIVIL engineering\-related discipline or related field, and five years of combined educational and work experience. You also need to have sufficient experience in construction site management, as well as a strong understanding of all aspects of development management including, financial appraisal, risk management, negotiation, etc.
   

  

 Do you have a strong background of all aspects of MEP/CIVIL\-related management—including the development of MEP/CIVIL project plan and procedures and construction schedules? Are you familiar with HVAC, electrical engineering, and BMS? Do you have knowledge of security system, AV system, and IT system? If your answers are yes, let’s talk.
   

  

 A business savvy leader who can walk the talk
   

  

 You understand the business well enough, particularly in terms of the systems and tools to use, the best practices and the safety requirements. You’re also knowledgeable of key industries and local market, with the real estate and construction business above all. You also have a basic understanding of the key drivers that push the projects forward, while also considering the client’s business requirements.
   

  

 You’ll back up your business know\-hows with the necessary communication skills, as you need to regularly do business development presentations to potential clients in both English and Chinese. You’ll also manage site activities, negotiate with contractors, review the legal aspects of contracts, contribute to market analysis, and manage change orders.
   

  

 A flexible leader with superb interpersonal skills
   

  

 Are you a people person with superb interpersonal skills? You’ll need to create a proactive working environment that not only motivates your employees, but also encourages them to maintain good relationship with clients, communicate effectively with each other, and contribute enthusiastically to the project. You also need to be a results\-oriented leader with good problem\-solving skills, as well as someone who can nurture positive relationships with all stakeholders involved, including your team members and clients.

description:
Job Description IPD Manager Position: IPD Manager
 Department: In-Patient Department (IPD)
 Location: Pune
 Industry: Healthcare / Hospital Operations Key Responsibilities Responsible for the development, operational efficiency, and overall functioning of the IPD . Ensure that all departmental protocols, SOPs, and hospital policies are consistently followed. Conduct daily IPD rounds , interact with patients across wards, understand their concerns, and address their queries with patience and empathy. Coordinate effectively with Billing, Insurance, Nursing, Housekeeping, Doctors, Admission Desk, Maintenance, and other support departments to ensure smooth IPD operations. Monitor, address, and resolve IPD patient grievances and service-related concerns in a timely manner. Track Admission and Discharge TAT and establish effective coordination with the Admission Desk Team to improve operational efficiency. Personally follow up on pending cases wherever required to expedite admission and discharge processes . Ensure that hygiene, cleanliness, and sanitation standards are consistently maintained across all wards. Monitor compliance with the Room Readiness Checklist and ensure prompt shifting of patients to and from the ward areas. Identify and coordinate the resolution of maintenance-related issues affecting IPD operations. Ensure that preventive maintenance activities are carried out regularly to minimise operational disruptions. Ensure adherence to hospital financial policies, including the 80% advance payment policy , wherever applicable. Ensure that all hospital staff maintain cordial, helpful, respectful, and empathetic communication with patients and their caregivers. Review outstanding/due payment cases with the Recovery Coordinator and escalate critical cases to the appropriate authorities. Resolve concession-related financial matters in coordination with consultants and senior management authorities. Conduct daily follow-up with the Financial Recovery Executive regarding outstanding IPD dues; ensure daily dues are reviewed and communicated to patient relatives, and highlight significant outstanding amounts to the Head of Hospital. Accompany the Chairman and Head of Hospital during daily rounds and ensure timely closure of observations and action points. Facilitate bed availability for new admissions by optimising room allocation, including conversion of single-occupancy rooms to semi-private/general categories when required and as per hospital policy. Personally counsel patients and caregivers, wherever appropriate, to facilitate timely physical discharge and improve bed availability. Handle VIP, influential, and other sensitive patient cases discreetly and professionally, particularly with regard to financial and service-related matters. Address and counsel patients/caregivers regarding billing-related queries , coordinating with the Billing Department wherever required. Make necessary arrangements and coordinate IPD requirements for health camps, academic courses, examinations, inspections, audits, and other institutional activities . Take responsibility for training and development programmes for IPD staff to enhance service quality, operational knowledge, and patient experience. Attend meetings at various healthcare offices, regulatory bodies, or external/internal forums as directed by management. Ensure timely closure of IPD concession cases in coordination with the concerned departments and authorities. Ensure completion of IPD-related HR and manpower activities , including shift changes, leave management, swipe/attendance requests, and duty rosters. Prepare and present the annual departmental budget to management, with a focus on cost optimisation, operational efficiency, revenue enhancement, and contributing to the organisation's profitability. Key Performance Focus Patient Experience & Grievance Resolution Admission & Discharge TAT Bed Utilisation & Availability IPD Operational Efficiency Financial Recovery & Outstanding Dues Quality, Hygiene & Compliance Staff Productivity & Training Cost Optimisation & Budget Management Cross-functional Coordination Continuous Process Improvement Ideal Candidate We are looking for a strong hospital operations professional with excellent leadership, communication, patient-handling, coordination, problem-solving, and financial-management capabilities, along with hands-on experience in managing IPD operations in a hospital environment .

title: Practice Sr Manager - Regional Commercial Operations
description:
COMPANY PROFILE Bain & Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world s most ambitious changemakers define the future. Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefining industries. We complement our tailored, integrated expertise with a vibrant ecosystem of digital innovators to deliver better, faster, and more enduring outcomes. The firm established several functions in the Indian market early 2000s and its remit across functions has expanded over time. Since 2019, these functions have become part of Global Business Services (GBS). Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals - serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics - who support our offices globally. Our mantra of shared innovation, seamless execution, underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally. WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world s best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally. WHO YOU LL WORK WITH Over the past two decades, Bain has formalized industry and capability areas, internally known as "Practices", integral to how Bain wins and delivers results to its clients. A practice is considered a business unit of Bain. The primary role of a Practice is to drive growth for Bain in a particular industry or capability, together with offices, and boosting Bains expertise and commercial excellence. The Strategy & Transformation Practice is one of the largest practices at Bain, and at the heart of some of our biggest client success stories. We re constantly pushing the boundaries of innovation, with new hooks, points of view, products, tools and delivery models that bring together the best thinking from our most successful client heads and senior strategists, to stretch our client s definition of full potential, embed change within their organizations, and deliver results.  About Krishitek Krishitek Industries Pvt. Ltd. is an Indian manufacturer of agricultural machinery, focused on developing practical, reliable and farmer-oriented mechanization solutions. We are looking for an experienced Manager – Technical & Operations who can lead our Design & Development and Production functions while driving effective cross-functional coordination across Purchase, Quality, Dispatch, After-Sales Service (technical support) and OEM/technical partners. This is a senior, hands-on role for a professional who understands the complete product lifecycle — Design Development Manufacturing Quality Field Performance Product Improvement . 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Design & Product Development Lead the Design & Development function and manage engineering priorities. Lead new product development and existing product improvement initiatives. Review and guide engineering drawings, BOMs, specifications and design changes. Ensure products are practical, reliable, cost-effective and manufacturable. Drive Design for Manufacturing (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA). Coordinate prototype development, testing, validation and implementation. Convert field/customer requirements into meaningful product improvements. Build engineering standards, documentation and design processes. 2. Production & Manufacturing Lead and coordinate with the Production team to achieve production targets. Identify and resolve production bottlenecks. Improve productivity, manufacturing processes and resource utilization. Ensure smooth transition of new/modified products from Design to Production. Coordinate with fabrication, machining, assembly and outsourced manufacturing partners. Reduce rejection, rework, downtime and production losses. Ensure manufacturability is considered during product development. 3. Purchase & Vendor Technical Coordination Define technical specifications for critical components and materials. Technically evaluate and develop vendors. Support Purchase in vendor selection and technical evaluation. Identify alternate materials/components for cost, quality and availability improvement. Resolve technical issues with suppliers. Drive technical development of critical suppliers. 4. Quality & Root Cause Analysis Work closely with Quality and Production teams to identify root causes of product/process issues. Lead technical Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and corrective actions. Eliminate recurring quality problems. Analyse rejection, rework and field-failure trends. Drive continuous improvement in product and process quality. 5. After-Sales & Product Performance Provide technical support for major product/service issues. Analyse field failures and identify design, manufacturing or process-related root causes. Establish a feedback loop from Customer Service Design Production . Drive product improvements based on field performance. Reduce recurring technical complaints and warranty issues. 6. OEM & External Technical Coordination Coordinate technical discussions with OEMs, technology partners and external agencies. Understand OEM requirements and translate them into internal execution. Lead technical trials, modifications and product integration. Manage technical communication with external partners. 7. Process & Cost Improvement Identify opportunities for product and manufacturing cost reduction. Improve material utilization, process efficiency and product design. Evaluate make-vs-buy opportunities. Reduce unnecessary components, processes and manufacturing complexity. Drive continuous improvement initiatives. 8. Management & Strategic Support Provide the Managing Director with technical and operational insights for decision-making. Analyse production constraints, product costs, technical risks, supplier issues and capacity requirements. Support strategic decisions related to new products, manufacturing and process improvement. Lead cross-functional projects involving multiple departments. 
 Candidate Profile We are specifically looking for a cross-functional engineering and operations professional , not a conventional Design Manager or Production Manager. Mandatory Requirements 10–15 years of total professional experience. 35 years of age or above. Minimum 3–4 years of relevant experience in Agricultural Machinery / Tractor / Farm Equipment / Tractor Implements or closely related manufacturing. Strong cross-functional experience across multiple functions such as: Design & Development Production / Manufacturing Quality Vendor Development / Purchase After-Sales / Field Support Operations Engineering degree in Mechanical / Production / Industrial Engineering preferred. Experience in mechanical product design and manufacturing. Experience leading teams and cross-functional projects. Strong understanding of engineering drawings, BOMs, materials and manufacturing processes. Strong problem-solving and decision-making ability. Hands-on approach with both engineering and shop-floor teams. 
 Career Stability We value long-term commitment and organizational stability . Preference will be given to candidates who have demonstrated: 5+ year tenure in at least one organization. Experience across 1–2 organizations rather than frequent job changes. Progressive increase in responsibility during their career. 
 We Are Looking For Someone Who Can move comfortably between: Design Office Factory Floor Vendor Quality Service (technical support) Management The ideal candidate should be able to understand not only how a product is designed , but also how it is manufactured, how it performs in the field, what it costs, why it fails and how it can be improved. + Turn quantitative analysis and qualitative feedback into actionable insights across the business to improve our processes and strategy.

* Systems \& Tools:
+ Help define and maintain the full marketing to sales funnel process, data, systems and workflows.
+ Enable \& maintain the Consumer Sales system stack and roadmap, with tools like Salesforce and more while always keeping an eye out for what’s the next best thing.

* 4\+ Years of Overall experience, preferably in Revenue/ Sales Operations, PnL, Ops \& Strategy or other related fields

* Highly Preferred \- Salesforce system admin experience, experience with configuring and using sales technologies (e.g. CRM \- Salesforce,Hubspot, Telephony Tools etc.)
* Proficient in using analytical tools like Excel, SQL to derive actionable insights from data

* Demonstrated capabilities of working in a high growth, ambiguous startup environment
* Comfort with ambiguity, a positive attitude, and a drive to manage projects to completion.
* Comfort with numbers and analysis with a desire to build on analytical skills.
* Exceptional written and oral communication skills.
* High standards of accuracy and strong attention to detail with a drive to get things right.
* Ability to work cross\-functionally in a fast paced and dynamic environment \- preferably comes with experience in B2C/ D2C startups

 We are an equal opportunity employer. description:
**Role:** 
 HR \& Finance Manager
 



**Function:** 
 Human Resources \& Finance
 



**Location:** 
 Bangalore
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Industry:** 
 Information Technology \& Services, Artificial Intelligence, Critical Infrastructure
 



  





**About Company** 




 A research\-first AI company incubated at the Indian Institute of Science (IISc). It builds advanced AI for the planning and operations of critical networks.
 



 Its core technology is a World Model that augments LLMs to reason about network state and dependencies — even with incomplete information. The founding team has raised over $100M in prior ventures and published at leading AI research venues.
 



 The company has just closed its seed round and is at the zero\-to\-one stage of building.
 



  





**Position Overview** 




 This is a hands\-on, dual\-function role that builds and runs the people and finance backbone of the company. Reporting directly to the founders, you will independently own HR operations, payroll, statutory compliance, and day\-to\-day accounting — creating the systems and processes that let the technical team focus on frontier AI. At a company of this stage, you won't inherit a playbook; you'll write it.
 



  





**Role \& Responsibilities** 



* Own the full employee lifecycle — onboarding, records management, leave/attendance tracking, and offboarding — ensuring a seamless experience at every stage.
* Process monthly payroll accurately and on time; manage all statutory filings and compliance for PF, ESI, PT, and TDS without exception.
* Maintain books of accounts in Tally — covering invoicing, vendor bills, accounts payable/receivable, and monthly bank reconciliations.
* Support monthly MIS preparation, cash\-flow tracking, budgeting inputs, GST filings, and coordination with statutory auditors.
* Coordinate recruitment logistics, HR policy rollout, performance management tracking, and employee engagement initiatives.
* Manage office administration, vendor contracts, and relationships with external stakeholders including legal teams, banks, and the Company Secretary.
* Build scalable HR and finance systems and documentation (policy guidebooks, trackers, SOPs) in partnership with the founders.



  





**Must Have Criteria** 



* 2–6 years of experience in an HR generalist or HR operations role with direct exposure to finance and accounts.
* Hands\-on working knowledge of Tally for day\-to\-day bookkeeping — invoicing, AP/AR, and bank reconciliations.
* Demonstrated ability to independently process payroll and manage statutory compliance filings: PF, ESI, PT, and TDS.
* Bachelor's degree in Commerce (B.Com) or a related field.
* Prior experience setting up or maintaining HR systems — attendance/leave trackers, onboarding/offboarding workflows, and compliance records — in a lean team environment.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* M.Com or MBA (HR or Finance) preferred.
* Prior experience in a startup or early\-stage company where you operated across both HR and finance functions simultaneously.
* Familiarity with GST filing processes and coordination with statutory auditors.
* Exposure to building HR/finance documentation from scratch — policy guidebooks, SOPs, or process playbooks.



  





**What We Offer** 



* Direct access and reporting line to the founders — high visibility and influence over how the company is built.
* Opportunity to design and own the people and finance function from the ground up at a seed\-stage, IISc\-incubated AI company.
* Work at the intersection of frontier AI and critical infrastructure — a mission with long\-term national and global significance.
* Lean, high\-ownership environment where your work has immediate, measurable impact on the organisation.

With a €11\.4 billion economic revenue in 2023, a global network of 152 plants and 40 R\&D centers, OPmobility relies on its 40,300 employees to meet the challenges of transforming mobility.
  
  

Our ambition? Provide automakers with cutting\-edge equipment and solutions to develop tomorrow’s clean and connected car.
  
  

As part of the Global IS Operations Team, the Regional IS operations Manager for APAC is responsible to
  
  

Manage IS Operations service delivery within the APAC region, in coordination with Global IS Product Operation Manager and Central Services Teams, ensuring operational stability, performance, and customer satisfaction.
  
Act as the primary regional contact for major incident management, urgent standard change coordination, SLA/KPI tracking, and communication.
  
Manage the alignment of APAC regional operations with global governance and contributes to the Build\-to\-Run transition for projects and evolutions.
  
  

He/she promotes and support the deployment of Group IS/IT policies, standards, and procedures at APAC level and drives operational excellence and continuous improvement of IT services delivered in the APAC region, identifying risks, bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities in operational processes.
  
  

**Main activities:**  

**Support and Corrective maintenance:**  

Oversee and manage major IS incidents impacting the APAC region, ensuring rapid response, escalation, and resolution.
  
Act as the IS APAC escalation point for critical incidents and service disruptions.
  
Maintain clear communication with stakeholders throughout incident lifecycle (major incident bridge management).
  
Ensure effective IS post\-incident reviews and root cause analysis follow\-up.
  
Provide regular reporting on IS incident metrics, SLA breaches, and corrective action plans (in coordination with IS Product Operation manager and Central Services Teams).
  
  

**Administration \& Supervision:**  

Ensure APAC project and evolution handovers are executed following the Build\-to\-Run framework.
  
Support local testing, acceptance, and onboarding of new services into operations.
  
Manage relationships with external vendors and service partners at APAC level (in coordination with IS Product Operation Manager and Central Services Teams).
  
Monitor and optimize APAC IS resources to support operational efficiency (in coordination with IS Product Operation Manager and Central Services Teams).
  
  

**Standard Change Management:**  

Manage urgent standard changes within the APAC region, ensuring risk assessment, coordination, and timely execution.
  
Validate APAC operational readiness for change implementations.
  
Ensure all changes follow Group IT/IS governance, approval, and documentation standards.
  
Support communication and scheduling changes with affected Business.
  
Track and report regional change performance, identifying areas for improvement.
  
  

**Required profile and experience:**  

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in information systems, Computer Science, or equivalent.
  
ITIL V3 or 4 certification (Service Operations or Service Management) preferred.
  
Project Management or Service Delivery Management certification (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2\) is an advantage.
  
At least 6–8 years of IT Operations experience, including 3 years in service delivery management.

description:
Job Summary 
 Job Title: Benefits Case Specialist - Global Benefits Operations Level: L5C Reports To: Manager - Global Benefits Operations (Bangalore) 
 
 About the Function 
 Human Resources is about shaping the experience of working at Diageo and helping our people learn and grow every day. From attracting talent to developing careers, this team plays a central role in building a culture where people feel supported, challenged and able to grow. They work closely with teams across the business, bringing insight, care and commercial understanding to everything they do. You'll help create an environment where different perspectives are valued and where people can learn new skills and thrive, unlocking potential across a truly global organisation. 
 
 Context/Scope 
 As part of the Group Reward and Benefits Operations team, you will play a crucial role in developing a high-performing and highly engaged Global Benefits Operations team. Reporting directly to the Assistant Manager - Global Reward and Benefits Operations, your responsibilities will include leading critical activities such as Benefits Purchase Order creation, invoice management and reconciliation, vendor management, report generation and distribution, and query management. Your outstanding customer management, financial control, governance application, and execution skills will be key to the success of these projects. Applying extensive experience in HR and payroll operations, or HR and payroll service delivery, process engineering, and process simplification, you will implement best practices processes and data management strategies to enhance operational efficiency and accuracy across multiple regions and time zones. Proficiency in employee communications for benefits programs, ensuring clear and effective dissemination of information. Skilled in benefits process design to optimize efficiency and effectiveness of program administration. Strong analytical skills to assess and improve benefits program performance and outcomes. Expertise in vendor management, encompassing performance monitoring, invoice and payment management, issue resolution, relationship management, and service review and improvement. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 a) Financial Ensure timely and accurate completion of all in-scope reporting activities. Regularly review and update Process Steps, Maps, Work Instructions, Benefits Matrices, Benefit Guides, Factsheets, and FAQs. Make them available to relevant teams, conduct necessary training, and ensure consistency and accuracy in all communications materials. Perform all CARM controls and data reconciliations, resolving any issues. Review and reconcile vendor invoices within agreed timelines to ensure payments are made as per the agreed SLAs. 
 
 Leadership Responsibilities 
 Leverage insights to find opportunities for process and workflow improvements. Apply strong social skills to motivate multiple teams, business processes, and data and technical governance. Drive significant simplification and efficiency in processes and systems to support the global productivity agenda. Ensure all controls and processes meet internal and external regulatory requirements. Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams across Diageo and with vendor teams. 
 
 About this role 
 Purpose of Role The Global Reward Operations (GRO) team supports various benefit processes (e.g., product allowance, car allowance, health insurance) for European markets. The Junior Manager will define, document, and improve both online and offline benefit processes and ensure a successful annual benefit enrollment for the entire European population. The role aims to scope out, document, and enhance the respective processes across Europe, reviewing and updating procedures in accordance with new legislation and regulatory requirements. 
 
 You will be responsible for 
 Top 3-7 Accountabilities Ensure all in-scope reporting activities are completed accurately and on time. Regularly review and update Step Maps, Work Instructions, Benefits Matrices, Benefit Guides, Factsheets, and FAQs, making them accessible to appropriate teams, and ensuring consistency and accuracy in communications materials. Perform all CARM controls and data reconciliations, resolving any issues. Continuously find opportunities to improve operational efficiency and effectiveness. Implement process improvements and automation initiatives to streamline operations and drive business results. Demonstrate strong experience with Workday operations, ensuring all required actions are implemented in the system to facilitate benefits administration and other processes. Ensures continuous improvement by developing effective benefits process designs to optimize efficiency and effectiveness in program administration. Responsible for applying strong analytical skills to assess and enhance benefits program performance and outcomes. Demonstrates strong vendor management skills overseeing performance monitoring to ensure optimal outcomes. 
 
 Experience/Skills Required 
 
 Qualifications and Experience Required 
 Strong understanding of HR processes and data management Payroll experience is highly valued. Strong analytical, numerical, and problem-solving skills. Vendor management skills Employee communication Strong analytical skills Process designing Methodical, logical, organized, and flexible approach to work. Excellent English language skills. High attention to detail. Advanced MS Excel skills, including formulas and pivot tables. Experience in process mapping. Experience in extracting and reconciling data from various sources. Barriers to Success in Role Inability to lead change within the business. Difficulty in quickly establishing links and leading mixed business and partner teams. Failure to apply a continuous improvement mentality. Lack of credibility with internal and external stakeholders. Lack of business situational awareness. Inability to collaborate in line with Diageo's dial-up behaviors. Hesitating or waiting for perfect conditions before implementing bold, exciting ideas. Suppressing dissent to achieve team unity. Disengaging when disagreeing with a decision. Adding extensive checkpoints to the process to mitigate risk.

title: Manager, Supply Chain Planning & Operations
description:
Job Summary 
 The Supply Chain Network Modeling Manager is responsible for leading the development and application of advanced supply chain network models that support operational decision-making across the enterprise. This role combines hands-on modeling expertise with people leadership responsibilities, managing a team of supply chain modelers and analysts while ensuring delivery of high-quality network design, transportation optimization, capacity planning, inventory optimization, and business continuity initiatives. The Manager translates business challenges into analytical solutions that optimize cost, service, capacity, inventory, risk, and growth objectives. The role is accountable for developing team capabilities, establishing modeling standards and best practices, and ensuring successful execution of a portfolio of modeling projects aligned with organizational priorities. 
 
 Primary Duties and Responsibilities 
 
 People Leadership Talent Development 
 Lead, coach, mentor, and develop a team of Supply Chain Modelers and Analysts. Conduct performance management, career development planning, and succession planning activities. Support hiring, onboarding, training, and capability development of modeling resources. Establish technical competency standards and promote continuous learning across the team. Foster collaboration, innovation, and a high-performance culture. 
 
 Project Portfolio Leadership 
 Manage a portfolio of network modeling, transportation optimization, simulation, and supply chain strategy projects. Prioritize initiatives based on business value, resource availability, and organizational objectives. Provide project oversight, quality assurance, and governance throughout project lifecycles. Ensure project deliverables are completed on schedule and align with stakeholder expectations. Present recommendations and business cases to senior leadership and executive stakeholders. 
 
 Supply Chain Modeling Optimization 
 Lead the design, development, maintenance, and enhancement of end-to-end supply chain network models. Evaluate scenarios including network expansion, consolidation, facility location, inventory positioning, manufacturing footprint changes, transportation strategies, and capacity investments. Analyze tradeoffs between cost, service levels, inventory, risk, resilience, sustainability, and growth. Develop transportation optimization and cost-to-serve models. Support long-range planning, annual operating planning, and capital investment decisions through scenario analysis. Drive adoption of advanced analytics, optimization, simulation, AI, and emerging technologies. 
 
 Stakeholder Management Consulting 
 Partner with business leaders to identify opportunities for analytics-driven decision making. Translate complex business problems into quantitative analyses and actionable recommendations. Facilitate workshops to define objectives, assumptions, constraints, and decision criteria. Communicate findings through executive presentations, dashboards, visualizations, and storytelling. Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders. 
 
 Process Capability Development 
 Establish and maintain modeling methodologies, governance processes, and best practices. Improve data quality, model documentation standards, and model validation procedures. Develop reusable templates, tools, and frameworks to improve efficiency and consistency. Support the evolution of Network Modeling as a Service (NMaaS) and consulting capabilities. Identify opportunities for automation and process improvement. 
 
 Work Experience 
 5+ years of experience in Supply Chain Analytics Optimization. 2+ years of team management/leadership experience. Expertise translating business rules into modeling requirements and scenarios Expertise in network modeling, optimization, transportation, and operations research. Experience with supply chain network modeling tools, data analytics and visualization. Hands-on with network optimization tools (Optilogic, Llamasoft, Coupa, PowerBI, Alteryx, Databricks). Strong knowledge of supply chain design, inventory, warehousing, and capacity planning. Exposure to Operations and different supply chain strategies (store, crossdock, import, buy/lease, etc) Experience coaching and training modelers 
 
 Education Qualification 
 Bachelor s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or any other related discipline or equivalent related experience. 
 
 Technical Skills 
 Network optimization tools (Optilogic, Llamasoft, Coupa, or similar) Supply chain simulation and modeling tools Advanced Excel, SQL, Python, Power BI, and analytics platforms Statistical analysis, optimization, and scenario planning Supply chain design, inventory, transportation, warehousing, and capacity planning 
 
 Leadership Competencies 
 Strategic thinking Influencing without authority Executive communication Coaching and talent development Project and portfolio management Change leadership Analytical problem-solving 
 
 Success Measures (KPIs) 
 On-time delivery of modeling projects Stakeholder satisfaction Team engagement and capability growth Business value from recommendations Cost savings, service improvements, and capacity optimization Adoption of modeling tools and best practices Reduced analysis cycle time through automation and standardization

 Operations Manager 
 
About the Role 
Skyria is looking for a proactive and organised Operations Manager to manage the day-to-day operational activities of the brand. The role will primarily involve inventory management, marketplace operations, product listings and catalogue management, along with coordination of routine business activities. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Inventory Management 
 Maintain and monitor inventory across different sales channels. Track SKU-wise stock availability and identify low-stock or out-of-stock products. Coordinate inventory movement between the warehouse, marketplaces and other locations. Maintain accurate inventory records and reconcile discrepancies. Coordinate with production and warehouse teams regarding stock requirements. Prepare regular inventory reports and highlight products requiring replenishment. 
 Marketplace & Product Listing Management 
 Manage product listings across the various online channels where Skyria sells. Create and update product listings, including titles, descriptions, sizes, colours, images, pricing and other attributes. Ensure SKUs, barcodes, inventory and catalogue information are correctly mapped across platforms. Monitor listing errors, catalogue issues and inventory-related problems. Coordinate with marketplace support teams for resolution of operational issues. Assist with onboarding new products and launching existing products on additional channels. 
 Order & Marketplace Operations 
 Monitor day-to-day marketplace operations. Coordinate with warehouse and fulfilment teams for timely order processing. Track operational issues that may affect order fulfilment or marketplace SLAs. Maintain reports related to orders, inventory, returns and marketplace operations. Follow up with marketplaces, logistics partners and internal teams wherever required. 
 Candidate Requirements

Payroll Operations Manager
description:
**Job Description**
 The Payroll Operations Manager is responsible for the end\-to\-end multi\-country payroll service delivery through the Payroll Central India (PCI). This position will be directly managing and responsible for the output of country\-grouped processing pods, consisting of pod Leads, Processors \& Administration team members, working as part of a scalable operation to ensure the accurate and timely payroll processing of all countries serviced through the PCI.
   

  

 The incumbent is responsible for ensuring quality control and compliance of payroll provision, underpinned by strict SLA/KPI service measures that ensure accuracy, efficiency and customer satisfaction. Will lead and manage all PCI Team members, ensuring they are appropriately trained and developed for continuous improvement across the different levels of processing competency with an ongoing focus on business continuity through cross coverage to ensure the demands of the PCI payment cycles are always met.
   

  

 The Payroll Operations Manager will be the subject matter expert for payroll processing within our ADP systems and form a strong collaboration with ADP Service Management to ensure smooth delivery between parties and appropriate upskilling of the PCI Team when it comes to working with our Global payroll partner ADP. Partner closely with Regional Payroll \& Technology Specialists, in maintaining \& optimizing the overall payroll and compliance landscape that governs the capabilities and attribute of the PCI. Also, will work in close partnership with the wider HR Function and other key stakeholders in the payroll process, such as Finance, Tax \& Treasury teams, as necessary to fulfill the operational requirements of the PCI.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Oversee on\-cycle \& off\-cycle payroll runs as per strict country calendars, ensuring processing methodology and agreed controls are adhered to as part of daily operations across all pods.
* Ensure quality control measures are complied with as part of the standard payroll sign off process, with appropriate checklists, controlling and reconciliation processes at each stage of the payroll cycle.
* Coordinate with ADP support teams and internal stakeholders for issue resolution and compliance adherence that impact payroll delivery.
* Manage risk mitigation to anything that impacts the delivery of individual payroll cycles or pay days and embed changes to future practices to avoid further recurrences.
* Provide optimization planning for each pending cycle to ensure special measures or activities, such as special projects or legislative updates, are undertaken in addition to the standard processing practices.
* Manage and ensure execution of the annual calendar of activities, such as tax year end, compensation and benefit renewals.
* Ensure comprehensive process documentation, robust process coverage, and effective contingency plans for uninterrupted payroll delivery.
* Conducts variance analysis and ensure reconciliation accuracy across pods to monitor performance and efficiencies.
* Drive standardization, operational excellence, and continuous improvement across the payroll hub.
* Manage pod teams to ensure they are appropriately staffed and upskilled (technical \& service orientation) to meet the demands of all country pay cycles.
* Provide direction, coaching, and performance oversight to Leads, Supervisors, Processors, \& Administrators.
* Ensure Team performance is measured and monitored in line with service delivery SLAs \& KPIs and acted upon where performance is substandard.
* Create a culture of high performance and high collaboration across pods, with a focus on cross training and contingency.
* Maintain manpower planning to ensure Payroll Central India is always staffed and can manage natural attrition without service disruptions.
* Ensure all activities undertaken by the PCI are all tracked \& documented to ensure 100% compliance with audit all controls.
* Ensure all payroll country requirements, including internal \& external compliance, as managed and advised by Regional Payroll Specialists are reflected in processing operations within the PCI to ensure ADP \& other systems and processing operations are always 100% compliant.
* Ensure all aspects of the PCI are documented within the appropriate Knowledge Base for ongoing reference by customers, stakeholders \& team members.
* Ensure Payroll Request Management is used effectively to manage team workload and also used to drive business insight for improvements and priorities.


**Requirements**
* 5\+ years of multi country payroll delivery experience.
* Proven managerial experience of Payroll Teams in a multinational organization.
* Experience with centralized, shared services, or captive payroll models.
* Strong background working with ADP (or similar) payroll platforms.
* Multi\-country payroll operations and statutory compliance knowledge.
* Country migration and parallel payroll experience.
* Payroll governance, controls and audit awareness.
* Strong experience with using Enterprise Payroll Software or working with a payroll vendor such as ADP.
* Strong experience with payroll systems development such as interfaces to Timekeeping \& HCM.
* Strong communication and influencing skills.
* Ability to manage ambiguity and complex stakeholder environments.
* Structured, detail\-oriented and outcome\-focused mindset.

title: Operations Manager
description:
**WHO ARE WE?** 




  





**WE CONNECT PEOPLE AND WORK** 




  





**TrueBlue** 
 (NYSE: TBI) is a leading staffing, recruiting and workforce management company. The company fills individual positions on demand, staffs entire facilities, and manages outsourced recruiting processes and staffing vendor programs for a wide variety of clients. The company's specialized workforce solutions meet clients' needs for a reliable, efficient workforce in a wide variety of industries including \- construction, manufacturing, financial services, pharmaceuticals, transportation, aviation, and energy. TrueBlue assigns as many as 100,000 people to work each day, drawing from a data base of hundreds of thousands of candidates, and places more than 250,000 people in permanent positions each year.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are seeking an experienced
 **Operations Manager** 
 to lead and manage a high\-performing recruitment delivery team in a fast\-paced, high\-volume environment. This role will have end\-to\-end ownership of operational performance, team productivity, service delivery, stakeholder management, and continuous process improvement.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Lead and manage team, driving performance, engagement, productivity, and professional development.
* Own the recruitment delivery function end\-to\-end, ensuring achievement of productivity, quality, SLA, and operational targets.
* Monitor key performance indicators and implement appropriate action plans to address performance gaps.
* Participate in business reviews, governance meetings, and stakeholder discussions, providing operational insights and updates to senior stakeholders.
* Manage escalations and complex operational issues, ensuring timely resolution and effective stakeholder communication.
* Identify process gaps and opportunities for improvement, and implement process optimization, automation, and workflow enhancements.
* Coach and mentor team members, build leadership capability, and develop succession plans and career growth opportunities.
* Drive a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and high\-quality service delivery.
* Support change management initiatives and ensure effective implementation of new processes and operational strategies.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and cost effectiveness across recruitment operations.



  





**Required Qualifications \& Experience** 



* Experience in RPO, staffing, recruitment operations, or another high\-volume, fast\-paced operational environment.
* Strong experience in people management, performance management, coaching, and team development.
* Demonstrated experience managing business reviews, escalations, and senior stakeholder interactions.
* Strong understanding of KPIs, SLAs, productivity, quality, and operational metrics, preferably within an RPO environment.
* Hands\-on experience in process improvement, automation, workflow optimization, or cost\-efficiency initiatives.
* Experience in team building, succession planning, and managing organizational or process changes.

title: Operations Manager - E-commerce & Supply Chain
description:
ROLE DETAILS
 



 Industry: Apparel \& Fashion / E\-commerce
 



 Function: Operations / Supply Chain
 



 Employment Type: Full\-time
 



 Experience: 8\+ years
 



 Compensation: Fixed \+ Variable \+ ESOP (ESOP structure to be confirmed)
 



 Location: Okhla, New Delhi
 



 Work Mode: Work from Office
 



 Work Schedule: Monday–Saturday
 



  





 THE ROLE
 



 We are looking for an experienced Operations Manager to own and drive our client's end\-to\-end operational ecosystem across inventory, supply chain, warehouse, fulfilment, logistics and marketplace operations.
 



  





 This is a business\-critical role that goes beyond day\-to\-day warehouse management. You will be responsible for building a predictable, efficient and scalable operating system that enables them to grow across channels without compromising on availability, speed, accuracy, cost or customer experience.
 



 You will work closely with production, warehouse, customer service, finance, marketplaces, technology and external logistics partners, acting as the central point of ownership for operational execution.
 



 The ideal candidate is someone who can think strategically, plan ahead and still get into the details when required — someone who can identify operational gaps, build processes around them and take complete ownership of outcomes.
 



  





 WHAT YOU'RE LOOKING FOR
 



 • An experienced operations professional with strong exposure to e\-commerce, D2C, marketplace or multi\-channel businesses.
 



 • Someone who understands operations end\-to\-end, from demand planning and inventory procurement through warehouse fulfilment, dispatch, logistics, returns and reconciliation.
 



 • Strong understanding of inventory planning, forecasting, stock availability, inventory ageing and working capital efficiency.
 



 • Ability to translate business and sales forecasts into operational capacity and inventory plans.
 



 • Strong experience managing and coordinating with 3PL, courier and logistics partners.
 



 • Someone who can work cross\-functionally and drive closure across production, warehouse, customer service, finance and corporate teams.
 



 • Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability with a data\-driven approach to operational decision\-making.
 



 • A process builder who can establish SOPs, KPIs, MIS and operating rhythms rather than simply manage existing processes.
 



 • Strong ownership mindset with the ability to independently identify issues, prioritise them and drive solutions.
 



 • Comfortable operating in a high\-growth environment where processes and systems are continuously evolving.
 



 • Clear and effective communication with both ground\-level teams and senior management.
 



  





 WHAT YOU'LL OWN
 



 END\-TO\-END OPERATIONS
 



 • Own the overall operational flow across inventory, warehouse, fulfilment, logistics and order management.
 



 • Ensure seamless movement of products from production/inbound through storage, fulfilment, dispatch, delivery and returns.
 



 • Establish operational plans aligned with business growth, sales targets and channel requirements.
 



 • Monitor operational performance and proactively identify risks, bottlenecks and capacity constraints.
 



 • Ensure operational SLAs are consistently achieved across functions and partners.
 



 • Build a scalable operating model that can support significant growth in orders, SKUs and sales channels.
 



  





 SUPPLY CHAIN \& INVENTORY PLANNING
 



 • Own inventory planning and forecasting across Salty's D2C and marketplace channels.
 



 • Analyse historical sales, demand trends, channel performance and upcoming business requirements to plan inventory.
 



 • Ensure optimum inventory availability while controlling overstock, stock\-outs and working capital blockage.
 



 • Monitor stock movements, replenishment, transfers and inventory allocation across channels.
 



 • Track inventory ageing, slow\-moving and dead stock and drive corrective actions.
 



 • Coordinate with production and relevant stakeholders to ensure timely availability of inventory.
 



 • Establish inventory planning and replenishment processes that can scale with business growth.
 



  





 WAREHOUSE \& FULFILMENT MANAGEMENT
 



 • Oversee warehouse operations including inbound, put\-away, storage, picking, packing, dispatch, returns and stock reconciliation.
 



 • Set and monitor productivity, accuracy, turnaround time and fulfilment SLAs.
 



 • Identify warehouse capacity requirements based on projected business volumes.
 



 • Ensure efficient utilisation of manpower, space and operational resources.
 



 • Drive improvements in warehouse processes, layouts, workflows and productivity.
 



 • Ensure high inventory accuracy through systematic audits, cycle counts and reconciliation.
 



 • Work with warehouse teams to resolve operational bottlenecks and recurring issues.
 



  





 LOGISTICS \& 3PL MANAGEMENT
 



 • Own relationships and operational coordination with 3PL, courier and logistics partners.
 



 • Monitor dispatch, delivery, RTO, NDR, returns and other logistics performance metrics.
 



 • Establish and monitor partner SLAs and ensure service levels are maintained.
 



 • Identify recurring logistics issues and work with partners to improve performance.
 



 • Evaluate operational performance and identify opportunities for cost optimisation and service improvement.
 



 • Ensure timely escalation and resolution of delivery and fulfilment issues.
 



  





 MARKETPLACE \& MULTI\-CHANNEL OPERATIONS
 



 • Oversee operational execution across the D2C website and marketplaces such as Amazon, Flipkart and Myntra.
 



 • Ensure accurate channel\-wise inventory availability and order flow.
 



 • Monitor marketplace fulfilment requirements, operational SLAs and inventory commitments.
 



 • Coordinate with internal teams and marketplace stakeholders to resolve operational issues.
 



 • Ensure systems accurately reflect orders, inventory, dispatches, cancellations and returns across channels.
 



 • Identify operational challenges arising from multi\-channel selling and build processes to address them.
 



  





 SYSTEMS, WMS/OMS \& DATA
 



 • Own the operational usage and effectiveness of WMS, OMS and inventory/order management systems.
 



 • Ensure accurate data flow between sales channels, inventory systems, warehouse and logistics partners.
 



 • Work with technology/internal teams to identify system gaps and improve operational workflows.
 



 • Drive automation wherever possible to reduce manual intervention and operational errors.
 



 • Build dashboards and reporting mechanisms to provide management with clear visibility into operational performance.
 



  





 PROCESS EXCELLENCE \& SOPs
 



 • Build, document and continuously improve SOPs and operational processes across the supply chain.
 



 • Identify process gaps, root causes and recurring operational inefficiencies.
 



 • Implement systems and controls to improve speed, accuracy, cost and scalability.
 



 • Establish clear ownership and escalation mechanisms across operational functions.
 



 • Build processes that reduce dependency on individual team members and enable consistent execution.
 



  





 MIS, KPIs \& MANAGEMENT REPORTING
 



 • Establish and track key operational KPIs across inventory, fulfilment, warehouse and logistics.
 



 • Prepare regular MIS and performance reports for management.
 



 Track metrics such as:
 



 • Order fulfilment TAT
 



 • Inventory accuracy
 



 • Stock availability
 



 • Inventory ageing
 



 • Warehouse productivity
 



 • Dispatch SLA
 



 • RTO / NDR
 



 • Return rates
 



 • Logistics performance
 



 • Cost per order
 



 • Operational losses
 



 • Use data to identify trends, anticipate problems and recommend corrective actions to management.
 



  





 CROSS\-FUNCTIONAL LEADERSHIP
 



 • Act as the central operational link between production, procurement, warehouse, customer service, finance, technology, marketplaces and logistics partners.
 



 • Ensure dependencies between teams are proactively identified and resolved.
 



 • Work with leadership to translate business plans into operational requirements.
 



 • Drive accountability across internal teams and external partners.
 



 • Ensure operational issues are owned through to closure rather than being passed between functions.
 



  





 COST \& OPERATIONAL EFFICIENCY
 



 • Identify opportunities to reduce operational costs without compromising service quality.
 



 • Optimise warehouse, logistics, manpower and fulfilment costs.
 



 • Analyse operational spends and identify inefficiencies or leakages.
 



 • Work towards improving cost per order, inventory turns and overall operational productivity.
 



 • Build processes that allow the business to scale volumes without proportionately increasing operational costs.
 



  





 REQUIREMENTS
 



 • 8\+ years of experience in operations, supply chain, e\-commerce operations, fulfilment or a related field.
 



 • Strong experience in D2C, e\-commerce, marketplace or multi\-channel businesses.
 



 • Proven experience managing end\-to\-end operations, not just warehouse operations.
 



 • Strong experience in inventory planning, forecasting, stock management and supply chain coordination.
 



 • Experience managing warehouse operations and fulfilment at scale.
 



 • Experience working with 3PL, courier and logistics partners.
 



 • Strong understanding of marketplace and D2C operational workflows.
 



 • Experience working with WMS/OMS and inventory/order management systems.
 



 • Strong analytical, planning, problem\-solving and stakeholder\-management skills.
 



 • Demonstrated ability to build processes, SOPs, KPIs and reporting systems.
 



 • Ability to manage ambiguity and operate effectively in a fast\-growing startup environment.
 



 • Must be willing to work from office in Okhla, New Delhi.
 



  





 GOOD TO HAVE
 



 • Experience managing operations for a high\-growth D2C/e\-commerce brand.
 



 • Experience handling Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra and D2C website operations.
 



 • Prior experience with Unicommerce/Uniware or similar WMS/OMS platforms.
 



 • Experience managing high\-SKU and high\-order\-volume environments.
 



 • Experience in inventory optimisation and working\-capital management.
 



 • Experience in logistics cost optimisation and 3PL performance management.
 



 • Experience building operations from an early\-stage/high\-growth environment.
 



 • Exposure to automation, integrations and technology\-led operational improvements.

title: Technology Operations Manager
description:
**About this role:**


Wells Fargo is seeking a Technology Operations Manager

 **In this role, you will:**

* Manage and develop team of individual contributors with low to moderate complexity and risk in Technology Operations
* Manage the operational outcomes of key IT services delivered by network services and operations, database services, infrastructure services including server and storage services
* Identify and recommend opportunities for technology operations process improvement and development
* Leverage metrics to support infrastructure associated with applications that are highly automated, and latency sensitive, client facing and internal applications consumed by the Business
* Leverage enterprise tools to digitize work\-flows as appropriate, asset and configuration management, metrics and measurement of services including availability SLAs, OLAs, mean time to recovery, repeat incidents and issues
* Instill repeatable processes that consistently meet SLAs and OLAs
* Manage backups, recovery and ensure recovery includes periodic tests to ensure business continuity
* Work with IT risk management, compliance and all lines of defense, including Audit, to ensure platform risks are proactively managed
* Institute controls in partnership with Operation Risks to ensure risk management is sustainable
* Manage the costs, demand and resource capacity for the team resources, leveraging external resources as needed
* Make decisions and resolve issues regarding resources, objectives and operations of technology operations to meet business objectives
* Interpret and develop policies and procedures
* Collaborate with and consult with peers, colleagues and multiple level managers
* Manage allocation of people and financial resources for technology operations
* Mentor and guide talent development of direct reports and assist in hiring talent

 **Required Qualifications:**

* 5\+ years of Technology Operations experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
* 2\+ years of Leadership experience

 **Desired Qualifications:**

* TIL Foundation or ITIL Managing Professional certification.
* Experience leading large enterprise Service Desk operations supporting 10,000\+ users.
* Exposure to AI\-powered support solutions, chatbot technologies, and automation platforms.
* Experience with Knowledge Management frameworks and self\-service strategies.
* PMP, Six Sigma, Lean, or Agile certifications are advantageous.
* Financial services industry experience preferred.
* Strong understanding of ITIL processes and service management best practices.
* Knowledge of ServiceNow or other ITSM platforms.
* Experience managing vendors, outsourced service providers, and geographically dispersed global teams.

 **Job Expectations:**

* The IT Service Desk Operations Manager is responsible for leading enterprise\-wide IT support operations, delivering exceptional employee experience through a combination of people, process, technology, and automation. This role owns service delivery across multiple support channels, including phone, chat, email, virtual agents, self\-service portals, and emerging AI\-driven platforms.
* The ideal candidate is a dynamic leader who demonstrates strong ownership, accountability, and operational discipline while driving service excellence, automation, digital transformation, and workforce optimization. The role requires expertise in ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow, CCaaS technologies, omnichannel support models, self\-heal solutions, knowledge management, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Service Desk Operations**

* Manage 24x7 IT Service Desk operations supporting enterprise users globally.
* Ensure achievement of Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Operational Level Agreements (OLAs), and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
* Oversee incident, service request, and major incident support processes.
* Drive First Contact Resolution (FCR) and reduce Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR).
* Monitor operational performance and implement corrective actions as needed.

**Team Leadership \& People Management**

* Lead, coach, and develop Service Desk supervisors, leads, and support analysts.
* Conduct performance reviews, talent assessments, succession planning, and career development activities.
* Foster a high\-performance and customer\-centric culture.
* Drive employee engagement, retention, and recognition initiatives.

**Vendor \& Partner Management**

* Manage outsourced service providers and vendor teams.
* Conduct monthly and quarterly business reviews.
* Monitor contractual obligations, SLA adherence, and financial commitments.
* Drive vendor performance improvement initiatives and optimization opportunities.

**Service Quality \& Customer Experience**

* Establish quality assurance frameworks and monitoring programs.
* Analyze customer feedback and CSAT trends.
* Identify service improvement opportunities and implement action plans.
* Ensure consistent user experience across all support channels.

**Process Governance \& ITSM**

* Ensure adherence to ITIL\-aligned Incident, Request, Knowledge, Problem, and Change Management processes.
* Drive operational process standardization and compliance.
* Partner with risk, compliance, and audit teams to address findings and controls.
* Maintain operational readiness for audits and regulatory reviews.

**Automation \& Digital Transformation**

* Drive adoption of AI, automation, self\-service, chatbots, virtual agents, and knowledge management solutions.
* Drive improvements in call routing, IVR effectiveness, chatbot containment, and agent productivity.
* Implement ticket deflection and shift\-left strategies.
* Identify opportunities to improve productivity and reduce operational costs.
* Champion self\-heal and self\-remediation solutions that proactively resolve common user issues.
* Lead digital transformation initiatives that enhance employee experience.

**Reporting \& Analytics**

* Develop operational dashboards and executive\-level performance reports.
* Analyze service trends, ticket volumes, demand patterns, and workforce utilization.
* Present operational reviews to senior leadership.
* Use data\-driven insights to recommend strategic improvements.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Collaborate with Infrastructure, Application Support, Security, Network, and Workplace Technology teams.
* Serve as the escalation point for critical service interruptions.
* Build strong relationships with business leaders and technology stakeholders.
* Communicate operational risks, performance, and improvement plans effectively.

**Posting End Date:**


16 Sep 2026* ***Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.***

**We Value Equal Opportunity**


Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.


Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance\-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.


Candidates applying to job openings posted in Canada: Applications for employment are encouraged from all qualified candidates, including women, persons with disabilities, aboriginal peoples and visible minorities. Accommodation for applicants with disabilities is available upon request in connection with the recruitment process.

**Applicants with Disabilities**


To request a medical accommodation during the application or interview process, visit Disability Inclusion at Wells Fargo.

**Drug and Alcohol Policy**

  

Wells Fargo maintains a drug free workplace. Please see our Drug and Alcohol Policy to learn more.

**Wells Fargo Recruitment and Hiring Requirements:**


a. Third\-Party recordings are prohibited unless authorized by Wells Fargo.


b. Wells Fargo requires you to directly represent your own experiences during the recruiting and hiring process.

title: Event Operations Manager
description:
Job Overview
 
 We are looking for an
 **Event Operations Manager** 
 who can take ownership of the end\-to\-end execution and operational management of events. The role will be responsible for ensuring that every event is delivered smoothly, on time, within budget, and to the expected quality standards.
 



 The ideal candidate should be highly organised, solution\-oriented, hands\-on, and comfortable managing multiple stakeholders, vendors, teams, and deadlines simultaneously.
   




 Key Responsibilities
 
**Event Planning \& Execution** 



* Manage end\-to\-end event operations from planning and pre\-production to on\-ground execution and closure.
* Develop detailed event execution plans, timelines, checklists, and operational schedules.
* Coordinate with internal teams including Creative, Client Servicing, Production, Design, and Accounts.
* Ensure all event requirements, deliverables, manpower, materials, and technical elements are planned well in advance.
* Manage event setup, rehearsals, show flow, event\-day execution, and dismantling.
* Be the primary operational point of contact during event execution.



**Vendor \& Partner Management** 



* Identify, brief, coordinate, and manage external vendors and production partners.
* Negotiate with vendors and ensure commercial terms are aligned with approved budgets.
* Track vendor deliverables, timelines, quality, and payments.
* Build and maintain a reliable network of event vendors, fabricators, technicians, manpower agencies, AV partners, decorators, and other service providers.



**On\-Ground Operations** 



* Lead and supervise event\-day operations and execution teams.
* Conduct venue recce and assess logistical, technical, and operational requirements.
* Coordinate venue access, permissions, loading/unloading, setup, branding, seating, AV, lighting, power, backstage, hospitality, and other event requirements.
* Ensure all production elements are installed and tested within timelines.
* Troubleshoot operational issues quickly and implement contingency plans wherever required.
* Ensure smooth coordination between all teams during live events.



**Budget \& Cost Management** 



* Work closely with Accounts/Finance to manage event budgets and operational costs.
* Obtain and compare vendor quotations.
* Track production and operational expenses against approved budgets.
* Identify opportunities for cost optimisation without compromising event quality.
* Ensure timely submission and closure of vendor bills and event\-related expenses.



**Team Management** 



* Allocate responsibilities to internal and external teams based on event requirements.
* Brief teams clearly on timelines, responsibilities, escalation points, and event protocols.
* Manage freelancers, event crew, technicians, and temporary manpower where required.
* Ensure teams adhere to timelines, quality standards, and safety protocols.



**Client \& Stakeholder Coordination** 



* Coordinate with clients and stakeholders on operational requirements whenever required.
* Translate client requirements into actionable operational plans.
* Provide regular updates on event readiness, production status, risks, and dependencies.
* Manage last\-minute changes and ensure they are executed with minimum disruption.



**Post\-Event Closure** 



* Oversee dismantling and material movement after the event.
* Ensure venue handover is completed smoothly.
* Track pending vendor deliverables, payments, and documentation.
* Conduct post\-event reviews and document learnings for future events.
* Maintain event reports, vendor records, checklists, and operational documentation.


 Key Skills \& Competencies
 * Strong event planning and execution skills.
* Excellent vendor and stakeholder management.
* Strong negotiation and budgeting skills.
* Ability to manage multiple events/projects simultaneously.
* Excellent communication and coordination skills.
* Strong problem\-solving and crisis\-management abilities.
* Highly organised with strong attention to detail.
* Ability to work under pressure and manage tight deadlines.
* Hands\-on approach to event execution.
* Strong understanding of event production, logistics, AV, fabrication, branding, and venue operations.
* Proficiency in MS Office / Google Workspace and basic project\-management tools.


 Experience
 * **4–7 years of experience** 
 in event operations, event production, experiential marketing, or event management.
* Experience handling corporate events, brand activations, conferences, launches, exhibitions, or large\-scale experiences is preferred.
* Proven experience in managing vendors, production teams, budgets, and on\-ground execution.


 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
 * Timely and smooth execution of events.
* Adherence to approved event budgets.
* Vendor performance and cost efficiency.
* Quality of event execution and production.
* Timely completion of pre\-event deliverables.
* Effective management of event\-day issues and escalations.
* Client/stakeholder satisfaction.
* Successful post\-event closure and documentation.
