 Client On\-Boarding team’s goal, is to ensure a global and consistent “first service” is rendered to the clients. Ensure practices are adhered to bank’s standard procedures and guidelines with an emphasis in the area of compliance. Keeping abreast with the changes in regulations (site, regional, global, HO), assess its impact.
   

  

 This role requires a strong leader with expertise in client data management, regulatory compliance, name screening, and operational risk mitigation. The incumbent will drive process efficiency, team performance, and adherence to global and local regulations while maintaining audit\-ready records and fostering collaboration with Relationship Managers, Compliance, and Legal teams.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Direct Responsibilities
   

  

* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of Client Onboarding Specialists, ensuring high performance, compliance, and operational excellence.
* Set clear team objectives, KPIs, and SLAs aligned with BNP Paribas Wealth Management’s policies and regulatory requirements.
* Conduct regular performance reviews, provide coaching, and implement training programs to enhance team skills.
* Drive continuous improvement in client onboarding processes, including SOP updates, control plans, and automation initiatives.
* Identify process bottlenecks and propose efficiency\-enhancing solutions (e.g., reducing false positives in name screening).
* Support the execution of controls and tasks required in the Client‑Onboarding – Data‑Maintenance \& Banking‑Services process, ensuring that client documentation, data‑capture activities and banking services meet the Bank’s policies, standards and all applicable local legal‑regulatory requirements.
* Perform daily and name‑screening checks (on‑boarding and periodic re‑screening). Keep watch‑lists, match‑thresholds and screening parameters up‑to‑date, investigate alerts, assign risk ratings, document decisions, and promptly escalate high‑risk matches. Maintain complete audit trails and respond to internal‑ and external‑audit queries. Work closely with Relationship Management, Legal and Compliance to resolve exceptions and drive process‑improvement/automation initiatives.
* Provide end‑to‑end support to internal customers for the onboarding of new clients, including linking clients to banking‑service tools (e.g., direct advisory‑desk access, dormant/deceased accounts, block/unblock requests).
* Maintain sound work processes, data‑integrity and the secure storage of client documents (electronic, scanned‑image or paper).
* Stay abreast of regulatory changes (site, regional, global, head‑office) and assess their impact on local workflows (SG/HK).
* Verify that controls are in place for the safe custody of account documentation and for mitigating operational risks arising from user requests to access databases containing sensitive client data, signatures or document images.
* Contribute to the design, implementation and continuous improvement of permanent‑control policies, procedures and control‑plans for daily operations; assist with updating SOPs.
* Comply with regulatory requirements, internal guidelines and operational‑risk procedures; promptly escalate incidents to Management, Permanent‑Control or Compliance as appropriate.
* Report all incidents through the Incident‑Management System and help minimise operational failures (including fraud) by applying regular controls.
* Ensure the integrity of client‑data creation and maintenance while meeting SLA/KPI targets; manage account‑closure processes.
* Prepare regular management reports (daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly/periodic statistics).
* Provide regional support in line with SG and HK working hours and public‑holiday calendars.
* Work collaboratively within a flexible, transversal team; coordinate with internal partners (WM‑COB SG/HK, Compliance, Legal, Front‑Office, Client‑Onboarding \& Due‑Diligence, and other WMHK/WMSG support teams) to resolve complex cases and maintain a smooth support process.

* Must possess strong fundamental and technical skills, awareness of operational risk.

**Technical \& Behavioral Competencies**
* Able to work with large data in excel and suggest process enhancement ideas.
* Knowledge of advanced formulas \& pivot tables in excel is must.
* Demonstrates a strong sense of responsibility for safeguarding the bank’s reputation.
* Proactively seeks root cause solutions to recurring false positive trends.
* Handles high volume alert periods (e.g., sanctions regime updates) while maintaining quality.
* Willing to share knowledge, support peers, and contribute to collective compliance objectives.


**Specific Qualifications**
* Minimum 8\-10 years of experience in Wealth Management, Private Banking, or Client Relationship Management.

title: Shift Manager
description:
**Job Description**
**Job Purpose/Overview**
 Operating within an agile, high\-growth packaging facility, the Shift Leader manages shift\-level packaging operations to safely produce Royal Canin products to the highest standards of safety, quality, and cost efficiency.
   

  

 This role is the critical, hands\-on driver of
 **Mars Supply Excellence (MSE)** 
 on the shopfloor. By integrating core MSE pillars (Safety, FMOS, AM, FI, and E\&T) directly into daily single\-line operations, the Shift Leader builds operator capability, drives asset ownership, and ensures the plant scales efficiently to support India's long\-term business growth.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Daily Operations \& FMOS Pillar**
* Shift Delivery: Lead the single packaging line to execute the production plan on time and in full, optimizing line speed and aiming to maintain an Overall Equipment Effectiveness. Deliver all Safety, Quality and Cost parameters as per the plans.
* FMOS Governance: Serve as the primary floor leader for daily meetings (CP1 and CP2\). Own shift handovers, maintain physical/digital visual boards, and track hourly performance metrics.
* Deviation Management: Rapidly flag operational or performance deviations, implement immediate line adjustments, and escalate systemic technical blocks to the Maintenance Manager and Plant Manager.
* Daily Management System: Lead DMS for the plant.
* B. Safety (MSE Safety Pillar)
* Zero\-Incident Culture: Drive a rigorous safety\-first environment on the floor. Personally execute Daily Safety Confirmations (DSC), lead Safety Conversation Walks (SCW), and enforce Stop\-Assess\-Control (SAC) protocols.
* Q\&FS Compliance: Enforce strict hygiene, GMP\-GHP, and HACCP rules. Immediately isolate and block non\-conforming packaging batches to ensure zero defective products reach the market.
* Audit Readiness: Maintain the packaging floor in a constant "audit\-ready" state for external and internal reviews (ISO, FSSC, QiD).


**Quality ( Quality pillar)**
* Q\&FS Compliance: Enforce strict hygiene, GMP\-GHP, and HACCP rules. Immediately isolate and block non\-conforming packaging batches to ensure zero defective products reach the market.
* Ensure execution of quality control \& Standard Runing condition compliance by operators to deliver Finish Good products Right first time
* In case of deviation: pb solving/root cause analysis
* Apply Quality std in case of blocked products
* Hygiene measures to be implemented.


**Line Ownership \& Autonomous Maintenance (AM)**
* Equipment Ownership: Coach shift operators to treat the single packaging line as their own asset, fostering high levels of pride and care on the floor.
* CIL Standards \& Centerlines: Supervise and verify the execution of daily Clean\-Inspect\-Lubricate (CIL) schedules and strictly monitor equipment Centerlines.
* Abnormality Handling: Establish rapid Abnormality Handling (AH) routines to detect, tag, and resolve minor technical or material defects before they cause critical line breakdowns.


**Problem Solving \& Focused Improvement (FI) (15%)**
* Loss Analysis: Track and analyze packaging floor losses (unplanned downtime, minor stops, material scrap) to prioritize improvement opportunities.
* Operator Troubleshooting: Train and lead shift operators in using basic problem\-solving methodologies (5\-Whys, PDCA, Fishbone) to eliminate chronic line bottlenecks.
* CI Collaboration: Work closely with the Site Maintenance team to implement localized engineering, efficiency\-boosting, and 5S improvement projects.
* Waste control \& optimization Ensure the waste % are as per targets.


**People Management, Education \& Training (E\&T)**
* Shift Leadership: Directly lead, roster, and manage a team of 10 to 12 operators and technicians, managing working hours, overtime, and absenteeism.
* Capability Development: Actively build operator capability using Step\-up\-Cards to develop a multi\-skilled shift workforce. Actively check individual performance to adapt training plan
* Knowledge Capture: Document and transfer on\-the\-floor technical skills through the creation and use of One\-Point Lessons (OPLs) and SOP
* Performance Culture: Conduct honest Performance Development Reviews (PDPs) and drive daily performance accountability using Individual Business Objective (IBO) cards.


**Job Specifications/Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or Production) or a related technical/supply chain field.
* 5 to 8 years of manufacturing experience (Food or Pharma)
* Minimum of 3 years of direct people management or shift leadership experience.
* Highly Preferred: Practical experience implementing or sustaining Lean, TPM, or MSE frameworks on the shopfloor.
* Preferred: Good working knowledge of food safety standards (ISO 22000, HACCP, GMP).
* Excellent verbal and written communication in English and local languages. Proficient in MS Excel and operational data entry.

title: Supervisor - Corporate Card Administrator
description:
**WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands.**
**We unite cutting\-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world\-class creativity, next\-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.**
**We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100\+ markets, with deep local expertise.**
**Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow.**
**For more information, visit WPP.com.**
**Why we're hiring:**
 The Programme Supervisor leads and oversees the successful maintenance, and continuous optimisation of WPP’s Commercial Card programme administration processes. This pivotal role is responsible for ensuring accurate setup, compliant administration, effective cardholder support, and robust operational governance across regions and local entities, often through the supervision and development of a team of Programme Administrators.
   

  

 The Supervisor acts as the primary escalation point and strategic coordination lead between WPP Shared Services, local finance teams, cardholders, Onboarding, Service teams, and Programme Managers. This role combines strategic oversight, advanced operational execution, process development and enforcement, comprehensive user support, and sophisticated system administration.
   

  

**What you'll be doing:**
**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead and oversee the maintenance of cardholder accounts, corporate billing accounts, and programme hierarchies, ensuring data integrity and adherence to global policies.
* Manage and review the monitoring of centrally billed payment processes, ensuring timely settlement, proactive issue identification, and resolution.
* Supervise the administration of complex account updates (e.g., bulk name changes, significant company structure changes, large\-scale hierarchical moves) and ensure operational efficiency.
* Serve as an escalation point for complex guidance on applications, card issuance criteria, credit limits, and transaction limits, ensuring consistent application of policies and risk mitigation.
* Develop and implement strategies to monitor, report, and remediate systemic cardholder delinquency issues, collaborating with relevant stakeholders.
* Lead and project manage rollouts of new divisions, sites, billing accounts, and significant programme expansions, coordinating efforts across multiple internal and external teams.
* Design, deliver, and oversee comprehensive training programs for cardholders and Programme Administrators, fostering continuous improvement and knowledge transfer across the team.
* Mentor and develop a team of Programme Administrators, fostering a culture of high performance, continuous learning, and professional growth.
* Identify, propose, and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency, accuracy, compliance, and cost\-effectiveness within the programme.
* Manage strategic stakeholder relationships with and internal WPP teams, representing the programme in cross\-functional meetings and initiatives.


**What you'll need:**
**Skills \& Competencies**
**Need minimum 8\+ years of experience into Corporate / Commercial Card administration (including team handling)**
**Technical Skills**
* Expert\-level understanding of commercial card processes (T\&E, P Card, Corporate Card), including market best practices, regulatory requirements, and industry trends.
* Advanced proficiency with Card administration, comprehensive reporting, complex applications, and strategic programme maintenance and optimization.
* Deep knowledge of WPP hierarchy setup, MCC controls, advanced card issuance policies, and intricate billing structures, with the ability to interpret and apply these to complex scenarios and guide others.
* Proven ability to manage and ensure data accuracy across multiple integrated systems, driving robust data governance and reporting.
* Experience with data analysis tools (e.g., advanced Excel, Power BI) for reporting, trend analysis, and performance monitoring.


**Behavioural Competencies**
* Exceptional attention to detail with a strong focus on quality assurance, process integrity, and audit readiness.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, capable of influencing diverse stakeholders, negotiating solutions, and delivering clear, concise information to senior management.
* Advanced stakeholder management and negotiation skills, fostering strong, collaborative relationships with internal and external partners.
* Proven ability to lead and champion change initiatives, guiding teams through process transitions effectively and promoting adoption.
* Strategic problem\-solver and critical thinker, capable of resolving complex operational and systemic issues, identifying root causes, and implementing sustainable solutions.
* Strong leadership and team development skills, including mentoring, coaching, performance management, and conflict resolution.
* Robust project management capabilities for programme enhancements, system integrations, and large\-scale rollouts.


**Governance \& Compliance**
* Comprehensive understanding of KYC, complex credit structures, and contracting processes, with the ability to ensure compliance and mitigate operational and financial risks.
* In\-depth knowledge and application of internal cardholder policies, regulatory requirements, and audit standards, leading compliance efforts for the programme.
* Experience in developing, implementing, and monitoring governance frameworks and controls to ensure program integrity.


**Who you are:**
**You're open

 We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open\-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

title: Lead - Banking Operation
description:
* **Commission Management \& Accounting**
* Oversee end\-to\-end commission computation, accounting, payment processing, and reconciliation activities.
* Monitor commission\-related schedules, including SCH\-3, BAP, and other compliance reports.
* Ensure timely and accurate commission payouts in accordance with regulatory and organizational requirements.
* Review commission advances, outstanding provisions, and balances through periodic management reviews.
* Prepare GL reports, perform commission account reconciliations, and pass month\-end accounting entries.
* Present periodic MIS and management review reports on commission operations and financial performance.



  




* **Operational Controls \& Payments** 
 Monitor weekly and monthly payout processes and ensure adherence to defined timelines and controls.
* Approve commission and coinsurance settlement payments within delegated authority limits.
* Manage vendor payments, reconcile vendor accounts periodically, and ensure accuracy of payable balances.
* Oversee cheque bounce monitoring and highlight high\-risk trends and counters for management review.



  




* **Coinsurance Management** 
 Monitor coinsurance receivables and payables balances and ensure timely settlement.
* Manage coinsurance accounting and reconciliation processes to minimize solvency impact.
* Review and track outstanding balances with stakeholders and drive timely resolution.



  




* **Regulatory Compliance \& Reporting** 
 Ensure compliance with MISP certification requirements and related regulatory obligations.
* Ensure timely and accurate submission of all regulatory, statutory, and compliance reports relating to commission payouts, coinsurance transactions, and IMD onboarding activities.
* Monitor compliance with GST, RCM, TDS, and other applicable tax and regulatory requirements.
* Manage invoicing support and related reporting within defined timelines.



  




* **Financial Governance \& Reconciliations**
* Review M2P and P2M reconciliations and collaborate with stakeholders to reduce outstanding balances.
* Ensure accurate financial reporting, account reconciliations, and operational control mechanisms.
* Strengthen governance through periodic reviews and effective exception management.



  




* **Audit \& Risk Management**
* Coordinate with internal auditors, external auditors, and regulatory authorities to ensure smooth completion of audits.
* Drive timely closure of audit observations and implementation of corrective actions.
* Ensure adherence to internal controls, policies, SOPs, and risk management frameworks.



  




* **Process Improvement \& Digital Transformation**
* Actively participate in and drive automation and digital transformation initiatives across Banking Operations.
* Identify opportunities for process optimization, operational efficiency, and control enhancement.
* Support implementation of system\-driven solutions to reduce manual interventions and improve scalability.



  




* **IMD \& Onboarding Oversight**
* Provide oversight of IMD/Agent onboarding processes to ensure compliance with regulatory and company requirements.
* Monitor onboarding controls, documentation, and process adherence for intermediaries.

title: Deputy Manager, Contract Administration & Management, Tenders
description:
**Job Description**
 The role will manage and coordinate the complete tender lifecycle for government hospitals, institutions and centralized rate contracts. This includes pre\-tender assessment, bid preparation, pricing and approval coordination, tender submission, post\-award activities, supply and delivery monitoring, tender MIS, governance and audit readiness.
   

  

 The position will work closely with Commercial, Finance, Supply Chain, Regulatory, QA, Legal, Compliance, Medical and other relevant stakeholders to ensure timely and compliant execution of tender business.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
* Manage end\-to\-end tender activities, from tender identification and qualification through submission and award.
* Review tender requirements and assess company eligibility, highlighting legal, regulatory and compliance concerns.
* Coordinate cross\-functional inputs for bid preparation, including pricing, volumes, product details, terms and documentation.
* Validate tender pricing and ensure adherence to approved pricing and governance guidelines.
* Complete tender compliance checklists, maintain tender logs and obtain required approvals.
* Ensure timely arrangement and tracking of EMD/Bid Security and Performance Security Deposits.
* Ensure accurate and timely bid submission with complete documentation.
* Maintain records of bid submissions, amendments, cancellations, awards and non\-participation decisions.
* Coordinate post\-award pricing validation, invoicing approvals and additional commitment documentation.
* Coordinate with Supply Chain, Logistics and QA to ensure timely product allocation, stamping and delivery as per tender commitments.
* Monitor delivery performance and escalate delays, short shipments, quality issues and supply risks.
* Maintain comprehensive tender MIS, including pipeline, win/loss, award and renewal tracking.
* Prepare management reports covering tender performance, sales, margins, pricing adherence, risks and CAPA status.


**Additional Responsibilities**
* Support distributor appointment and due diligence for tender\-related activities in coordination with Compliance, Legal and TPRM.
* Ensure distributor participation remains aligned with approved governance and competition\-law requirements.
* Maintain complete tender documentation and records for audit purposes.
* Prepare and maintain the tender audit universe and ensure audit readiness.
* Support internal, global and management\-monitoring audits by preparing evidence packs and tracking CAPA closure.
* Ensure local tender processes and SOPs remain aligned with global tender standards.
* Provide regular tender updates and executive summaries to management, highlighting key accounts, lost tenders, margin trends, operational risks and recommendations.


**Qualifications**
**Education**
* Graduate/Postgraduate degree in Business Management, Commerce, Pharmacy, Life Sciences or a related discipline.


**Experience**
* Experience in tender management, institutional business, government business, commercial operations or a related pharmaceutical/healthcare environment.
* Experience managing the end\-to\-end tender lifecycle, including bid preparation, pricing, submission, post\-award management and MIS.
* Experience working with multiple cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Exposure to tender compliance, governance, audit and documentation requirements.


**Skills**
* Strong tender management and execution skills.
* Strong understanding of pricing, commercial and contractual processes.
* Excellent cross\-functional coordination and stakeholder management.
* Strong analytical and MIS/reporting skills.
* Good understanding of compliance, governance and audit requirements.
* Strong attention to detail and documentation discipline.
* Ability to manage multiple tenders and deadlines simultaneously.
* Strong communication, negotiation and problem\-solving skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office/Excel and tender management systems.
* High level of ownership, accountability and integrity.

title: Sys. Integration Sr. Specialist Advisor
description:
**Position Overview**
 TIAA is undertaking AmpliFi, a large\-scale ERP transformation program, and is seeking an experienced, hands\-on Project Manager to assist in managing the Source to Pay (S2P) workstream. This workstream includes the migration of Strategic Sourcing to Oracle, the replacement of the Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) system from Coupa to Aravo, and the implementation of a new Zip orchestration layer designed to unify and simplify the end\-to\-end sourcing, procurement, and payment experience for business users.
   

  

 This is a highly visible role requiring a proactive self\-starter who can manage complex, interdependent workstreams while communicating clearly and confidently with senior TIAA stakeholders, including steering committee members and executive sponsors. The ideal candidate combines strong technical understanding of source\-to\-pay processes with the polish and presence needed to lead discussions with senior audiences.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the project plan, milestones, RAID log, and deliverables for the S2P workstream, spanning Strategic Sourcing (PeopleSoft), TPRM (Aravo), and the Zip orchestration layer.
* Partner with Strategic Sourcing, Accounts Payable, Purchasing, and TPRM teams to define future\-state processes, requirements, and system configurations.
* Coordinate configuration, testing, and validation activities across PeopleSoft Sourcing, Aravo TPRM, and Zip orchestration, ensuring seamless integration and a cohesive end\-to\-end user experience.
* Manage vendor master data cleanup, mapping, and migration activities in close coordination with the Data workstream.
* Proactively identify gaps, dependencies, and risks across the three underlying platforms before they impact timelines, and drive resolution through appropriate program channels.
* Schedule and facilitate S2P status meetings, domain working sessions, workshops, and steering committee updates.
* Prepare clear, executive\-ready status reports and presentation materials, and confidently present progress, risks, and decisions to senior TIAA leadership and steering committee members.
* Track, escalate, and drive resolution of risks and issues per program governance standards.
* Coordinate UAT planning and execution with business process owners across sourcing, AP, and TPRM functions.
* Support organizational change management, stakeholder communications, and training for S2P end users, ensuring adoption of new processes and the Zip orchestration experience.
* Demonstrate meticulous attention to detail in tracking deliverables, documenting decisions, and validating configuration and testing outcomes.


**Program\-Level Responsibilities (applicable To All Six Workstream PM Roles)**
* Adhere to AmpliFi program governance, PMO standards, and reporting templates/cadence.
* Participate in cross\-workstream coordination meetings to proactively identify and manage interdependencies with other AmpliFi workstreams.
* Escalate risks and issues through defined program governance channels in a timely manner.
* Support overall cutover planning, go\-live readiness, and post\-go\-live stabilization for the S2P domain.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, or a related field.
* 6–10 years of project management experience, including at least 3 years leading procurement, sourcing, accounts payable, or TPRM transformation initiatives.
* Direct, hands\-on familiarity with at least two of the following: PeopleSoft (Sourcing/Procurement), Coupa, Aravo, Zip, or comparable sourcing, TPRM, or orchestration platforms.
* Strong working knowledge of end\-to\-end source\-to\-pay processes, including strategic sourcing, purchase order creation, three\-way matching, invoice\-to\-pay, and third\-party/vendor risk management, ideally within a large international financial services organization.
* Demonstrated experience managing multi\-system, multi\-stakeholder workstreams with significant interdependencies.
* PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent certification preferred.
* Proven ability to communicate effectively and with authority to senior/executive audiences, including experience preparing and delivering steering committee\-level presentations.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trust and drive alignment across Sourcing, AP, TPRM, Vendor Management, IT, and Data teams.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to translate complex technical topics into clear business language.
* High attention to detail, particularly in tracking configuration decisions, testing outcomes, and data migration accuracy across multiple platforms.
* Proficiency in project management and collaboration tools (e.g., Jira, Smartsheet, MS Teams, SharePoint).
* Ability to work proactively and independently across time zones with global stakeholders (onshore/offshore coordination).
* Strong facilitation, negotiation, and conflict\-resolution skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Prior experience with ERP transformation programs, particularly upgrades or replacements involving sourcing, procurement, or TPRM systems.
* Experience with orchestration or workflow layers designed to unify disparate procurement systems into a single user experience.
* Experience working within regulated financial services environments, with an understanding of associated compliance and audit requirements.

Mumbai (India) (09 Sep 2026\) JD1582
   

  

 Apply now
   

  

 The Commercial Relationship Manager is responsible for leading the commercial relationship management function for the Fund Administration business, combining strategic client relationship management with revenue growth responsibility across the Group’s fund administration client portfolio. The role is accountable for developing long\-term partnerships with fund managers, asset managers, investment firms, and institutional clients, ensuring exceptional client experience while proactively identifying opportunities for revenue expansion, cross\-selling, new mandates, and increased client value. The role leads and develops a team of Commercial Relationship Managers who are responsible for managing client relationships, strengthening client engagement, and driving commercial outcomes across their assigned portfolios. The Head acts as the senior escalation point for strategic clients and ensures the business maintains strong executive relationships with key clients. The successful candidate will bring a commercial mindset to client management, combining deep understanding of client businesses, investment strategies, growth plans, fundraising activities, geographic expansion, and operational requirements to identify opportunities where the Group can provide additional value. The role holder is responsible for the management of the Fund team in the set\-up and administration of a number of Alternative investment funds, Estate Succession Planning, Trust Structuring, Advising Family Trust clients and underlying investors.
   

  

**Primary Duties And Responsibilities**
**Commercial Leadership \& Revenue Growth**
* Develop and execute the commercial relationship strategy for the Fund Administration business, aligning client management activities with the Group’s revenue growth objectives and strategic priorities
* Own the commercial performance of the client portfolio, driving revenue growth through client retention, cross\-selling, upselling, fee reviews, new fund launches, additional jurisdictions, and expanded service offerings
* Establish commercial targets, monitor portfolio performance, review revenue trends, and implement strategies to maximize client lifetime value and profitability
* Identify opportunities to increase wallet share by understanding client business models, investment strategies, fundraising plans, expansion objectives, and future operational requirements
* Partner with senior management to develop commercial initiatives, market strategies, and growth opportunities across priority client segments


**Strategic Client Relationship Management**
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior executives, fund managers, investment professionals, boards, and key decision\-makers across strategic client accounts
* Act as the executive sponsor for key strategic clients, ensuring senior\-level engagement, strong relationship governance, and alignment between client objectives and Group capabilities
* Develop a deep understanding of client businesses, including investment strategies, fundraising activities, portfolio growth, operational challenges, geographic expansion, and future service requirements
* Conduct regular executive business reviews, strategic account meetings, and relationship assessments to strengthen partnerships and identify opportunities for collaboration
* Manage complex client relationships and commercial escalations, coordinating internal stakeholders to ensure timely resolution and continued client confidence


**Client Growth Planning \& Portfolio Management**
* Establish a structured client growth planning framework across the relationship management team, ensuring each strategic client has a documented commercial development plan
* Ensure Relationship Managers actively identify growth opportunities, including new funds, additional entities, new jurisdictions, additional services, and increased utilization of existing capabilities
* Review client portfolios regularly to assess revenue opportunities, profitability, relationship strength, service quality, retention risks, and strategic importance
* Develop client segmentation strategies to ensure appropriate focus, resources, and engagement models across different client categories
* Monitor client lifecycle management activities from onboarding through expansion and renewal


**Leadership of Commercial Relationship Management Team**
* Lead, mentor, and develop a high\-performing team of Commercial Relationship Managers responsible for managing fund manager and institutional client relationships
* Establish clear objectives, revenue targets, client ownership responsibilities, and performance expectations for the Relationship Management team
* Conduct regular account reviews, pipeline reviews, coaching sessions, and commercial planning meetings to improve team effectiveness

title: Academy Operations Manager
description:
**Role: Academy Operations Manager** 

**Location:** Mumbai – Lower Parel (The Command Center!)

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**Urgency:** High – We’re hiring at the speed of Padel!

**About PadelPark: The Academy Revolution**

We are PadelPark, the engine behind India's fastest\-growing sport. We aren't just building courts; we’re building the future of Indian athletes—from budding young stars to adults looking to master the game—through the **McDonald’s Indian Padel Academy** and our elite **MS Dhoni affiliation**. This isn't just a business; it’s a movement to spark a nationwide obsession.

**The Game Plan: Your Role as Academy Operations Manager**

This is a high\-ownership, zero\-excuses role for someone who loves bringing order to chaos and genuinely cares about delivering a world\-class experience — for students, coaches, and venue partners alike. You will be the operational heartbeat of the academy, making sure every court, coach, and class runs exactly as it should.

**Here is what your day\-to\-day looks like:**

* **Own the courts:** Track court utilisation across all venues and make sure every available hour is generating value — through academy sessions or Pay \& Play.
* **Keep the schedule tight:** Publish every coach's weekly schedule on District at least 7 days in advance — no exceptions.
* **Drive Pay \& Play occupancy:** Monitor P\&P slot bookings and work with the team to optimise pricing and app visibility. Low occupancy is a signal, and you will be the first to catch it and act on it.
* **Minimise disruptions:** Keep session reschedules and cancellations to an absolute minimum. When they do happen, own the communication.
* **Resolve venue issues fast:** Any court damage, equipment fault, or facility issue must be fixed within 24 hours. You will be the first call when something goes wrong, and the person who makes sure it does not happen twice.
* **Stay on budget:** Track operational spend at each venue against budget in real time. Flag overspends early — before they become a P\&L problem. You are the first line of financial accountability on the ground.

**Your scoreboard: what success looks like**

You will be measured on a clear set of KPIs that reflect how well the academy is running. No ambiguity — just results.

**Court Utilisation Rate**

% of available court\-hours actually in use across all venues each month

**Schedule Published 7 Days Out**

Every coach's week must be live on District at least 7 days before it begins

**Pay \& Play Occupancy Rate**

% of P\&P slots booked vs. available on the District app

**Reschedule \& Cancellation Rate**

How often confirmed sessions are changed or cancelled — lower is better

**Venue Issues Resolved in 24hrs**

Same\-day or next\-day resolution of any court or facility issue

**Operational Cost vs Budget**

Are we spending what we planned? Tracked per venue, every month

**Who Are We Looking For:** 

* You have got a bachelor's degree and at least 3\+ years of experience in operations, sports management, or a fast\-paced service environment.
* **Bonus points:** If you have worked in a sports academy, fitness studio, or venue operations setup, you are already one smash ahead.
* **You are a natural organiser:** schedules, systems, and checklists are your love language.
* **You are a problem\-solver:** when something breaks (and things always break), you fix it fast and build a system so it never breaks the same way again.
* **You are a communicator:**  coaches, students, vendors, founders: you know how to talk to all of them clearly and calmly.
* **You are data\-driven:**  you track what matters, spot patterns early, and make decisions backed by numbers, not gut feel alone.
* **You are tech\-comfortable:**  CRM tools, scheduling platforms, and spreadsheets do not intimidate you. Familiarity with District or similar apps is a plus.

**Why You’ll Love Being On Our Team**

* **Be a pioneer:** Get in on the ground floor of a company that is literally building the future of sport in India.
* **Join a rocket ship:** Padel is the fastest\-growing sport in the world. You will be at the operational heart of that growth story.
* **Learn and lead:** This is a role where you will be given real ownership from day one — and the space to grow into something bigger.
* **Work hard, play hard:** We are a high\-energy team that believes great work deserves great fun. Court time included.

title: Ops Manager — Purchase Protection (re-scoped from Ops & Strategy
description:
**Ops Manager , Purchase Protection (re\-scoped from Ops \& Strategy)**
=======================================================================

  



**Location:** Mumbai , hybrid, 3 days a week in office (FinOps operates as one unit in Mumbai)


**Experience:** 4–7 years running day\-to\-day operations in e\-commerce, logistics, fintech or insurance


**Reports to:** COO


**Works with:** Rahul Garale (Asst Manager Ops), Shraddha Pisal (Ops Analyst), Aditya Chauhan \& Yash Alva (Data), Kunal Vinayakiya (Partnerships), Finance (Dhivya Vijayakumar, Yashraj Saha)


**About Assurekit**
-------------------


Assurekit is on a mission to protect the internet's GDP.


Every day, billions of dollars in transactions flow through India's digital economy , across marketplaces, payments, logistics, and commerce platforms. But the protection layer that should sit underneath all of it hasn't kept pace. Buyers worry about what arrives at their door. Sellers absorb losses they didn't cause. Platforms carry risk they were never built to hold.


We're building the infrastructure that fixes this , embedded directly into the platforms people already use, invisible until it's needed, and engineered for the speed and scale of digital commerce. Our partners include some of the largest names in the Indian internet and our reach grows every transaction we protect.


We're backed by tier\-1 investors and are building what we believe will become foundational risk infrastructure for the next billion digital consumers.


**Role Summary**
----------------


You will run operations for Assurekit's **purchase\-protection line of business** , the shipping\-protection, RTO\-protection and e\-commerce purchase\-protection programs we operate for platforms such as Shiprocket (ShipSure), GoKwik, Meesho, Pepperfry and Mokobara, with new programs going live every quarter.


This is an **operator's seat, not a strategy seat**. You own the weekly operating loop for every program in the LOB: the data comes in, plans are enrolled, claims are adjudicated and paid on time, settlements reconcile to the rupee with partners and insurers, and each partner gets a clean, on\-time report. When something breaks you fix it, write down why, and change the process so it doesn't break again. Over time you turn that loop into SOPs and automation with Data and Product so the LOB scales without headcount scaling with it.


**What Success Looks Like (first 6 months)**
--------------------------------------------


* Every live purchase\-protection program runs on a documented weekly cadence , enrolment feed claims adjudication settlement partner report , with a named owner for each step and no step dependent on the COO.
* Claims TAT and settlement accuracy are measured per program, reported weekly, and improving; partner escalations drop.
* Partner\-facing reconciliation (proforma invoices, claim payouts, float/deposit tracking with insurers) closes within the agreed cycle every week, with finance sign\-off.
* At least one new program (e.g. Snapmint, Rupifi or Pidge) is taken live on the same playbook without a bespoke process.
* The automation backlog for the LOB is prioritised, specced with Data/Product, and the first two items are shipped.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


### **Run the programs**


* Own enrolment and data ingestion for each program: partner feeds, plan issuance, exception handling, reverse feeds back to the partner.
* Own claims operations end\-to\-end: intake, adjudication against plan rules and loss caps, fraud/anomaly flags, payout instructions, TAT tracking and partner communication.
* Run weekly settlements and reconciliations , partner invoices and payouts, insurer floats and premium remittances, claim reimbursements , and clear breaks with Finance.
* Produce the weekly and monthly partner MIS; run the operating review with each partner's ops counterpart.

### **Build the operating system**


* Write and maintain the program SOPs and launch checklist; apply them to every new program go\-live.
* Define the LOB's operating metrics (enrolment accuracy, claims TAT, settlement variance, escalation volume) and keep the dashboards current with Data.
* Own the LOB's automation backlog: identify the manual steps that don't scale, spec them with Data/Product, and drive them to closure.
* Run merchant\- and program\-level deep\-dives on loss makers and translate findings into rule, process or product changes.

### **Work across the company**


* Be the operating counterpart to Partnerships for go\-lives and to Finance for settlements and revenue recognition.
* Manage the day\-to\-day work of the ops analysts assigned to the LOB; set priorities, review output, grow them.
* Keep documentation in Notion current and used.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------


* 4–7 years in hands\-on operations roles , e\-commerce, logistics/shipping, payments, lending or insurance operations , where you owned a recurring, high\-volume process end\-to\-end (claims, settlements, reconciliation, fulfilment, disputes).
* You have personally run a weekly or monthly reconciliation or payout cycle against partners or insurers and closed the breaks yourself.
* Strong with spreadsheets at scale (tens of thousands of rows) and comfortable with SQL or BI tools to pull your own data.
* Track record of writing SOPs and getting a team to follow them; you have improved a TAT or error rate and can quantify it.
* Clear written communication , partner emails, MIS commentary, incident write\-ups.
* Mumbai\-based and comfortable with 3 days a week in office.

**Skills and Competencies**
---------------------------


* Operating discipline: cadences, checklists, exception loops, follow\-through.
* Numerical rigour and a low tolerance for unreconciled numbers.
* Calm under partner pressure; escalates early with facts.
* Process design instinct , sees the manual step that will break at 3× volume and fixes it before it does.
* Comfortable using AI tools (Claude/ChatGPT) in daily work for drafting, analysis and documentation.

**Nice to Have**
----------------


* Direct experience with RTO / shipping\-protection, extended warranty, device protection or embedded\-insurance operations.
* Exposure to insurer\-side processes (premium bordereaux, claims MIS, float accounting).
* Familiarity with Notion, ClickUp, Metabase, Zoho.

**Not this role**
-----------------


* A founder's\-office / strategy generalist seat , that scope has been split into specialist roles.
* A VAS / aftercare ecosystem role , that sits in the Servicing \& Support vertical (Bangalore).
* A finance or data\-science role , FinOps accounting sits with Finance; modelling sits with Data \& Risk.

**Interview Process**
---------------------


* HR screen (Megha Panchasara) , daily\-ops depth, band, notice, Mumbai 3\-day WFO, tenure.


* COO round (Avinash Ramachandran) , how you have run a claims/settlement loop; live case.


* Take\-home: ShipSure weekly settlement case (3 pages), followed by a walkthrough with Avinash.


* Judgement round (Adarsh Chokhani or Rishi Iyer).

title: Cluster Manager Asset Management Solar
description:
**Company Description** 
 The client is an established organization operating in the renewable energy sector, with a strong focus on solar power generation and asset performance. The company manages multiple solar plants and clusters, working to optimize energy output, ensure regulatory compliance, and improve operational efficiency. It emphasizes safety, sustainability, and long\-term value creation for stakeholders and project partners. Team members collaborate closely with engineering, operations, and finance functions to maintain high\-performing assets and support business growth. The organization encourages continuous improvement, transparent communication, and data\-driven decision\-making across its portfolio.
 



**Role Description** 
 This is a contract, on\-site role for a Cluster Manager Asset Management Solar, based in the Rajula Gujarat. The role involves overseeing the performance, reliability, and maintenance of a cluster of solar assets, ensuring optimal energy generation and adherence to safety and regulatory standards. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include monitoring plant performance data, coordinating with site operations teams, managing maintenance schedules, and supervising contractors and vendors as required. The Cluster Manager will prepare regular performance reports, track key performance indicators, and support root cause analysis for technical and operational issues. The role also includes budget monitoring, risk identification, implementing improvement initiatives, and collaborating with internal stakeholders to support compliance, audits, and long\-term asset value.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Strong background in solar power or renewable energy operations, including asset management or plant management experience.
* Proficiency in performance monitoring, data analysis, and reporting tools related to solar plants or industrial assets.
* Experience coordinating on\-site operations, maintenance activities, and vendor or contractor management.
* Knowledge of safety standards, regulatory requirements, and quality assurance practices in the energy or infrastructure sector.
* Excellent organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to lead cross\-functional collaboration.
* Ability to work on\-site in the Pune Division, conduct regular plant visits, and respond promptly to operational issues.
* Engineering or technical degree in a relevant field (e.g., Electrical, Mechanical, Renewable Energy) preferred; equivalent experience considered.
* Familiarity with project documentation, asset lifecycle management, and budgeting or cost control for operational assets.

title: General Manager ( Real Estate Accounts )
description:
**Company Description** 
 Rohit Joshi Group is a premium real estate developer shaping Pune’s residential landscape through thoughtful development and uncompromising execution. The group focuses on landmark residential communities in well\-established neighborhoods, integrating planning, design, compliance, and construction within a single accountable framework. This approach enables consistent delivery of projects defined by quality, transparency, and long\-term value for homeowners. With over 22 lakh sq. ft. under development across 9 active projects and more than 5 lakh sq. ft. already delivered, the company continues to contribute to Pune’s evolving urban fabric. As it expands its footprint, Rohit Joshi Group is committed to being one of the city’s most trusted and respected developers, recognized for excellence in execution.
 



**Role Description** 
 The General Manager (Real Estate Accounts) will oversee end\-to\-end financial management for multiple real estate projects, ensuring accurate accounting, compliance, and timely reporting. This full\-time, on\-site role is based in Pune and involves managing project\-wise budgeting, cash flows, and cost tracking, as well as supervising accounts teams and coordinating with project, sales, and leadership stakeholders. Daily responsibilities include reviewing ledgers, monitoring receivables and payables, ensuring statutory compliance (such as GST, TDS, and RERA\-related financial requirements), and preparing MIS reports and dashboards for management review. The role will also drive process improvements in accounting systems, support audits, manage banking relationships, and contribute to financial planning for new and ongoing developments.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Candidates should possess strong real estate accounting and finance skills, including project accounting, budgeting, cash flow management, and cost control. ( CA or CFO level preferred )
* Candidates should possess solid compliance and regulatory skills, covering tax (GST, TDS), statutory reporting, and familiarity with real estate\-specific regulations and audit processes.
* Candidates should possess team leadership and stakeholder management skills, with experience in supervising accounts staff and collaborating with project, sales, and senior management teams.
* Candidates should possess analytical and reporting skills, including proficiency in MIS reporting, financial analysis, and use of accounting software and Excel.
* Candidates should possess strong communication and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects, meet deadlines, and maintain high standards of accuracy and integrity.
* Professional qualification such as CA, CMA, MBA (Finance), or equivalent relevant degree is preferred; prior experience in real estate or construction accounting will be an advantage.
* Ability to work on\-site in Pune, with a hands\-on approach, problem\-solving mindset, and openness to improving systems and processes.
* Real estate industry is preferred.

title: Technical Executive
description:
**Designation: Technical Executive**
 Educational Qualification: BE Electrical
   

  

 Experience: 4\-8 years in relevant utilities and facility management
   

  

**Work Arrangements:**
 Work Schedule: 6 days/week
   

  

 Shifts Timings : Rotational Shifts
   

  

**Essential Technical Experience \& Expertise:**
 The ideal candidate must possess comprehensive hands\-on experience in managing critical utility infrastructure and building services. This includes operational knowledge and maintenance expertise across diverse technical systems:
   

  

**Power \& Electrical Systems:** 
 Proficient management of DG (Diesel Generator) yard operations including generator maintenance, fuel management, load testing, and emergency backup protocols. Strong understanding of UPS (Uninterruptible Power Supply) systems, battery management, and power distribution networks.
   

  

**HVAC \& Cooling Infrastructure:** 
 Extensive experience with chiller plant operations, including water\-cooled and air\-cooled systems, chiller efficiency optimization, and preventive maintenance protocols. Thorough knowledge of air conditioning systems, AHU (Air Handling Units), HVAC controls, temperature regulation, and climate control management across facility spaces.
   

  

**Water \& Environmental Systems:** 
 Hands\-on operational experience with Sewage Treatment Plants (STP) including biological treatment processes, effluent quality monitoring, and compliance management. Proficiency in Water Treatment Plant (WTP) operations covering raw water treatment, filtration systems, chemical dosing, water quality testing, and potable water distribution.
   

  

**Supporting Infrastructure:** 
 Working knowledge of related utility systems including fire fighting systems, plumbing networks, drainage management, and building management systems (BMS) integration.
   

  

**What this job involves:**
 Executing flawless technical activities
   

  

 As the go\-to person in all things technical, you’ll keep the Company up to speed on operating and utilities costs. Together with the building manager, you will monitor the invoices for technical services rendered. Aside from these, you’ll keep an eye out on the maintenance practices of our contractors to ensure that their scope of work is aligned with manufacturer recommendations and our own preventive maintenance standards.
   

  

 You’ll also oversee the repair and maintenance of cooling and heating systems, plumbing and water supply, electricity and lighting fixtures, and other equipment and supplies. Moreover, you’ll be in charge of performing routine inspection, inventory and documentation of these systems.
   

  

 Providing sound leadership to boost results
   

  

 Ensuring smooth day\-to\-day operation is a responsibility that requires impeccable leadership skills. You’ll demonstrate this by overseeing our electricians and their scope of work. You’ll also work closely with pretty much everyone across the board\-\-from superiors to peers and subordinates.
   

  

 Aside from our internal teams, you’ll also be the main point of contact for our vendors for all maintenance services. Churning out reports will also be part of your mandate. In this role, you’ll monitor our maintenance activities, and produce daily and weekly summary reports on these activities.
   

  

**Sound like you? To apply you need to have:**
 Technical competence like no other
   

  

 Working for a global real estate leader like JLL, you must demonstrate technical expertise that will help you go head\-to\-head with some of the industry’s most brilliant minds.
   

  

 Having said so, the ideal candidate must be a degree holder with at least three years’ experience in the field. Likewise, you must possess a strong working knowledge of policies, building maintenance and people management. Proven expertise in the principles and techniques of carpentry, electrical, plumbing, and general property management may also give you an edge in getting the job.

title: Test Management Lead - Telecom BSS/OSS Testing - VOIS
description:
**Who We Are**
 VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.
   

  

 As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry\-first model which brings together the best of in\-house and 3rd party capability.
   

  

 We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
   

  

 \#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture
   

  

**About This Role**
 We are seeking an experienced Test Management professional to lead Acceptance Testing services for Vodafone Germany programmes within VOIS. This role will be responsible for defining and executing testing strategies, managing end\-to\-end testing delivery, and ensuring high\-quality releases across Telecom BSS/OSS landscapes. The successful candidate will oversee multiple projects simultaneously, manage sizeable testing teams, collaborate with Vodafone and vendor stakeholders, and drive continuous improvement in testing methodologies, governance, quality, and operational efficiency. The role is based in Pune and offers opportunities to work within a global, multicultural environment with periodic international travel.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**

title: Manufacturing Shop Operations Team Manager - Senior
description:
### **Job Summary**



The Senior Manager / Manager – Camshaft Manufacturing Operations is responsible for leading day\-to\-day manufacturing operations for camshafts across QSK, KV, NT, ISX, and other engine platforms at Kothrud Engine Plant. The role focuses on ensuring safe, efficient, and high\-quality production through effective management of machining processes, manpower, equipment performance, automation systems, and continuous improvement initiatives.



The incumbent will lead operations involving cam milling, grinding, induction hardening, straightening, superfinishing, washing, inspection, and packaging processes while ensuring achievement of safety, quality, delivery, cost, and productivity targets. The role also requires strong coordination with cross\-functional teams including Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Maintenance, Planning, and Supply Chain.


### **Key Responsibilities**


**Production \& Operations Management**


* Execute and monitor daily production plans to meet customer delivery schedules and operational targets.
* Ensure smooth operation of manufacturing lines with focus on safety, quality, productivity, and cost optimization.
* Manage manpower deployment, shift planning, absenteeism control, and resource utilization.
* Coordinate with planning, quality, maintenance, and manufacturing engineering teams to minimize downtime and production losses.
* Drive production stability across multiple camshaft variants and engine platforms.
* Lead and manage daily operations of cylinder head machining lines.
* Drive high\-mix, high\-volume production while maintaining flexibility and efficiency.
* Optimize manpower utilization, line balancing, and throughput.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including Supply Chain, Quality, Maintenance, and Engineering to ensure seamless operations.


**Equipment \& Process Management**


* Oversee end\-to\-end machining processes including:
* Oversee operation and performance of critical manufacturing equipment including:
* Cam Milling Machines
* Journal \& Cam Lobe Grinding Machines
* Induction Hardening Systems
* Straightening Machines
* Superfinishing Machines
* BHN Testing \& Crack Detection Systems
* Washing, Laser Marking \& Final Inspection Machines
* Ensure adherence to preventive and predictive maintenance schedules for improved equipment reliability.
* Support machine trials, process validation, commissioning, and production ramp\-up activities.
* Monitor process capability and implement corrective actions to sustain process stability.


**Automation \& Manufacturing Systems**


* Support implementation and stabilization of automation systems such as robotic handling, gantry systems, and automated inspection systems.
* Drive CMS (Cummins Manufacturing System) implementation and sustainment across the shop floor.
* Participate in Industry 4\.0 and digital manufacturing initiatives to improve operational visibility and machine utilization.
* Promote data\-based decision\-making through operational reviews and KPI tracking.


**Quality, Safety \& Compliance**


* Ensure adherence to Cummins quality standards and customer requirements.
* Lead root cause analysis and implementation of corrective/preventive actions for process and quality issues.
* Drive reduction in scrap, rework, and customer complaints.
* Ensure compliance with HSE, environmental, ergonomic, and statutory requirements.
* Support audits, VPCR activities, layered process audits, and quality improvement initiatives.


**Team Leadership \& Development**


* Lead and develop supervisors, operators, technicians, and support staff.
* Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, discipline, and continuous improvement.
* Conduct training, skill development, performance reviews, and competency enhancement initiatives.
* Encourage employee involvement in Kaizen, safety, and productivity improvement activities.


**Continuous Improvement \& Cost Optimization**


* Improve OEE, productivity, cycle time, and process efficiency.
* Drive Lean Manufacturing initiatives including 5S, TPM, Kaizen, SMED, and waste elimination.
* Support cost reduction initiatives related to tooling, consumables, utilities, and manpower optimization.
* Participate in CAPEX execution, operational budgeting, and resource planning activities.


**Competencies:**


**Core Competencies**


* Operations Management
* Manufacturing Excellence
* Team Leadership
* Continuous Improvement
* Lean Manufacturing \& TPM
* Problem Solving \& Root Cause Analysis
* Decision Making
* Collaboration \& Cross\-functional Coordination
* Health, Safety \& Environmental Awareness
* Technical Expertise in Precision Machining


Builds effective teams \- Building strong\-identity teams that apply their diverse skills and perspectives to achieve common goals.



Collaborates \- Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.



Communicates effectively \- Developing and delivering multi\-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.



Decision quality \- Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.



Develops talent \- Developing people to meet both their career goals and the organization’s goals.



Directs work \- Providing direction, delegating, and removing obstacles to get work done.



Drives engagement \- Creating a climate where people are motivated to do their best to help the organization achieve its objectives.



Drives results \- Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.



Manages conflict \- Handling conflict situations effectively, with a minimum of noise.



Health and Safety Fundamentals \- Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury\-free workplace.



Health, Safety and Environment Incident Investigation and Root Cause Analysis \- Examines HSE incidents by completing quality, evidence based investigations with accurate root cause analysis, resulting in effective corrective actions, accurate reporting and avoiding repeated incidents.



Continuous Process Improvement \- Recognizes areas in which a process can be improved by properly implementing process improvement and waste reduction methodologies to reduce process cost and improve quality in current manufacturing processes.



Values differences \- Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.


**Education, Licenses, Certifications:**



College, university, or equivalent degree required.



This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.


### **Experience**



Intermediate level of supervisory experience required.


**Qualifications \& Experience**


* Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering, or equivalent.
* Minimum 18\+ years of experience in precision machining/manufacturing operations, preferably in camshaft, crankshaft, or powertrain component manufacturing.
* Strong understanding of grinding, milling, induction hardening, inspection systems, and machining operations.
* Experience in managing automated and semi\-automated production environments.
* Hands\-on exposure to robotics, automation systems, and Industry 4\.0 initiatives is preferred.
* Familiarity with ERP systems, production planning tools, quality systems, and manufacturing KPIs.

Cummins is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and high\-performance workplace. We value diversity, innovation, teamwork, and continuous improvement while creating opportunities for professional growth and operational excellence.

* Establish and standardize local operational SOPs; optimize cross\-department (non\-production) workflows

* Maintain relationships with local banks, credit insurance institutions, regulators, and third\-party service providers
* Build and mentor a local corporate team; not responsible for factory/manufacturing staff



**You are:** 



* A hands\-on entity operations leader with 20\+ years in Telecom, Semiconductor, or Appliance/Electronics
 *companies* 
 — in corporate office, HR, finance, or compliance leadership,
 **not** 
 production/manufacturing management and
 **not** 
 sales/BD.
* Substantive, hands\-on experience with India government agencies and local policy bodies with the judgment to interpret policy shifts and flag risk early is essential.
* Experience supporting or reporting to a China HQ, and a working understanding of how a China\-headquartered organization operates is essential.
* Local EMS senior business relationships or supplier resources are a strong plus.
* Bachelor's in Business Administration or related field (MBA preferred); fluent English, Mandarin a strong plus.

title: Supply Chain Manager, Product Distribution Operations
description:
Location\-Noida/ Gurgaon/ Mumbai/ Bangalore
   

  

 Domain\-B2C supply chain
   

  

 Industry preference\- FMCG/ Electronics
   

  

 Relevant experience\-7\-13 years
   

  

**About Us**
 We’re Adobe’s Product Distribution Operations (PDO) team, and we run the worldwide production, fulfilment and distribution behind Adobe’s physical and point\-of\-sale products — from demand planning all the way to the invoice. We love getting the details right at global scale! Ready to own an operation and keep it running across every region?
   

  

**About The Role**
 This role leads PDO for the Singapore hub. It is the main point of contact for production, turnkey and distribution, and owns our SAP S/4HANA planning coordinator responsibilities. It suits someone who enjoys both the detail of daily operations and the wider picture of cost, compliance and vendor relationships.
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

 Day to day, the role runs the flow of orders and shipments worldwide — reviewing demand and supply, and issuing EDI purchase orders to our turnkey partner. When order, shipment or customs questions arise, you’ll resolve them with Sales, Order Management and logistics partners across NA, EMEA, APAC and Japan.
   

  

 On the cost side, the role owns COGS for print, production and distribution, approves freight and vendor invoices, and issues monthly invoices for our entities. It also runs quarter\-end closure, sets excess\-and\-obsolete reserves, reconciles inventory and manages returns.
   

  

 Product launches fill a big part of the year. The role sets up new term license, subscription and POSA SKUs, checks test\-card and link\-map readiness, and partners with the Product, Sales and turnkey teams so every launch lands on schedule.
   

  

 Compliance runs through all of it: SOX controls, tax and environmental reporting for EMEA (Green Dot, EUDR, PPWR), and on\-site vendor audits that confirm modern\-slavery and labour requirements are met.
   

  

 What you’ll bring
   

  

* Solid experience in supply chain, production planning or distribution operations
* Hands\-on SAP (S/4HANA) and EDI order\-to\-cash knowledge
* Comfort managing COGS, freight and invoices
* A careful, accurate approach to compliance and audit (SOX a plus)
* A track record of managing vendors and external partners
* Clear communication across regions and teams


 Bonus points
   

  

 Familiarity with POSA or Livecard fulfilment, Power BI or Tableau reporting, or APAC regional operations is a real plus.
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

 This is a truly global role with real ownership and a supportive team behind it. We back our people with strong benefits and the freedom to shape how the operation runs as we grow. We’d love to have you on the team — come and build it with us! We can’t wait to see what you’ll do!
   

  

**About Adobe**
 Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry\-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.
   

  

 Our 30,000\+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.
   

  

**Let’s Adobe together**

Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.
   

  

 Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.
   

  

 Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com.

You'll drive strong operational governance, audit readiness, and continuous improvement while building team capability through coaching and process standardization, all while enhancing the customer and colleague experience across the Procure\-to\-Pay landscape.

title: FCS People Leader
description:
Embark on a transformative journey as FCS People Leader at Barclays, where you'll play a pivotal role in shaping the future. In this pivotal role you will manage operations within a business area and maintain processes, risk management initiatives, and compliance with relevant regulators. You will take ownership of your work, ensuring it aligns with the relevant rules \& regulations, and codes of conduct. With competitive benefits and opportunities for career advancement, Barclays is a great place to grow your career in the banking industry.
   

  

**Key Critical Skills Required For This Role Include**
* Experience in Team management.
* Knowledge of KYC, AML, Sanctions, Adverse Media, Payment, and customer screening process to ensure adherence to internal policies and regulatory standards.
* Identify and report quality gaps or process deviations, work with relevant teams to drive corrective actions.
* Develop and maintain MIS dashboards and reports related to financial crime controls, customer due diligence, and alert handling.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly reports for internal stakeholders and compliance leadership.
* Ensure reports reflect accurate status of KYC, AML alerts, and sanctions screening metrics.
* Support the monitoring of transactions and customer data against global sanctions list.
* Assist in maintaining and updating watchlist filtering tools and screening logic.
* Work closely with Screening operations teams to identify and resolve data issues.
* Ensure people related issues are handled.
* Clear understanding of Risk \& Controls.
* Should have basic MS Excel knowledge.


 You may be assessed on key essential skills relevant to succeed in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking, and digital technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 This role is based out of Gurugram.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To support Screening with day\-to\-day processing, reviewing, reporting, trading and issue resolution, making decisions in line with comply with relevant regulatory and industry standards.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Support with day\-to\-day screening initiatives including processing, reviewing, reporting, trading and issue resolution through lending technical expertise.
* Execution of screening checks on customers, transactions, and other activities to identify potential risks and comply with regulatory requirements.
* Collaboration with teams across the bank to align and integrate screening processes.
* Identification of areas for improvement and providing recommendations for change in screening processes.
* Development and implementation of screening procedures and controls to mitigate risks and maintain operational efficiency.
* Development of reports and presentations on screening performance.
* Identification of industry trends and developments to implement best practice in screening Services.
* Participation in projects and initiatives to improve screening efficiency and effectiveness.

* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise

The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub\-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.

 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right.
